name: LightCondensed.Solid.Classical.precomp_bijective_of_retractArrow
statement:
lemma precomp_bijective_of_retractArrow {X Y Z W A : LightCondAb}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Z ⟶ W} (h : RetractArrow f g)
    (hg : Function.Bijective (fun k : W ⟶ A => g ≫ k)) :
    Function.Bijective (fun k : Y ⟶ A => f ≫ k)
proof:
:= by
  let iL : X ⟶ Z := h.i.left
  let iR : Y ⟶ W := h.i.right
  let rL : Z ⟶ X := h.r.left
  let rR : W ⟶ Y := h.r.right
  have hiw : iL ≫ g = f ≫ iR := h.i_w
  have hrw : rL ≫ f = g ≫ rR := h.r_w
  have hretL : iL ≫ rL = 𝟙 X := h.retract_left
  have hretR : iR ≫ rR = 𝟙 Y := h.retract_right
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    change f ≫ a = f ≫ b at hab
    have hc : rR ≫ a = rR ≫ b := by
      apply hg.1
      calc
        g ≫ (rR ≫ a) = (g ≫ rR) ≫ a := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
        _ = (rL ≫ f) ≫ a := by rw [hrw]
        _ = rL ≫ (f ≫ a) := Category.assoc _ _ _
        _ = rL ≫ (f ≫ b) := by rw [hab]
        _ = (rL ≫ f) ≫ b := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
        _ = (g ≫ rR) ≫ b := by rw [hrw]
        _ = g ≫ (rR ≫ b) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    calc
      a = (iR ≫ rR) ≫ a := by rw [hretR, Category.id_comp]
      _ = iR ≫ (rR ≫ a) := by rw [Category.assoc]
      _ = iR ≫ (rR ≫ b) := by rw [hc]
      _ = (iR ≫ rR) ≫ b := by rw [Category.assoc]
      _ = b := by rw [hretR, Category.id_comp]
  · intro a
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hg.2 (rL ≫ a)
    refine ⟨iR ≫ c, ?_⟩
    change g ≫ c = rL ≫ a at hc
    calc
      f ≫ (iR ≫ c) = (f ≫ iR) ≫ c := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (iL ≫ g) ≫ c := by rw [hiw]
      _ = iL ≫ (g ≫ c) := Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = iL ≫ (rL ≫ a) := by rw [hc]
      _ = (iL ≫ rL) ≫ a := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = a := by rw [hretL, Category.id_comp]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.Classical.precomp_bijective_of_doubleDualEvaluation
statement:
lemma precomp_bijective_of_doubleDualEvaluation {X A : LightCondAb} (f : X ⟶ X)
    [IsIso (doubleInternalDualMap f)]
    (heval : Function.Bijective
      (fun k : doubleInternalDual X ⟶ A => doubleDualEvaluation X ≫ k)) :
    Function.Bijective (fun k : X ⟶ A => f ≫ k)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := heval.2 a
    obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := heval.2 b
    have hev : doubleDualEvaluation X ≫ (doubleInternalDualMap f ≫ a') =
        doubleDualEvaluation X ≫ (doubleInternalDualMap f ≫ b') := by
      simp only [← Category.assoc]
      rw [doubleDualEvaluation_naturality]
      simpa only [Category.assoc, ha', hb'] using hab
    have hdual : doubleInternalDualMap f ≫ a' = doubleInternalDualMap f ≫ b' :=
      heval.1 hev
    have hab' : a' = b' := (cancel_epi (doubleInternalDualMap f)).1 hdual
    rw [← ha', ← hb', hab']
  · intro a
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := heval.2 a
    change doubleDualEvaluation X ≫ a' = a at ha'
    refine ⟨doubleDualEvaluation X ≫ inv (doubleInternalDualMap f) ≫ a', ?_⟩
    change f ≫ ((doubleDualEvaluation X ≫ inv (doubleInternalDualMap f)) ≫ a') = a
    calc
      f ≫ ((doubleDualEvaluation X ≫ inv (doubleInternalDualMap f)) ≫ a') =
          (f ≫ doubleDualEvaluation X) ≫ (inv (doubleInternalDualMap f) ≫ a') := by
            simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = (doubleDualEvaluation X ≫ doubleInternalDualMap f) ≫
          (inv (doubleInternalDualMap f) ≫ a') := by
            rw [doubleDualEvaluation_naturality]
      _ = doubleDualEvaluation X ≫ a' := by simp only [Category.assoc,
        IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
      _ = a := ha'

name: LightCondensed.Solid.Classical.isSolid_of_doubleDualExtensionProperty
statement:
lemma isSolid_of_doubleDualExtensionProperty (A : LightCondAb)
    (hA : doubleDualExtensionProperty A) :
    isSolid A
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSolid]
  rw [← isIso_iff_of_reflects_iso _
    (sheafToPresheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ))]
  rw [NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  intro T
  rcases T with ⟨T⟩
  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  change Function.Bijective
    ((((MonoidalClosed.pre (oneMinusShift ℤ)).app A).hom.app ⟨T⟩))
  let F := (free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed
  let f : P ℤ ⊗ F ⟶ P ℤ ⊗ F := (oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ F
  let rTensor : Retract (P ℤ ⊗ F)
      ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed ⊗ F) :=
    { i := (P_retract ℤ).i ▷ F
      r := (P_retract ℤ).r ▷ F
      retract := by
        rw [← comp_whiskerRight, (P_retract ℤ).retract]
        simp }
  let r : Retract (P ℤ ⊗ F)
      ((free ℤ).obj (((ℕ∪{∞}) : LightProfinite) ⊗ T).toCondensed) :=
    rTensor.trans (Retract.ofIso (IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt (ℕ∪{∞}) T))
  have hevalY : Function.Bijective
      (fun k : doubleInternalDual
          ((free ℤ).obj (((ℕ∪{∞}) : LightProfinite) ⊗ T).toCondensed) ⟶ A =>
        doubleDualEvaluation
          ((free ℤ).obj (((ℕ∪{∞}) : LightProfinite) ⊗ T).toCondensed) ≫ k) := by
    exact hA (((ℕ∪{∞}) : LightProfinite) ⊗ T)
  have hevalX : Function.Bijective
      (fun k : doubleInternalDual (P ℤ ⊗ F) ⟶ A =>
        doubleDualEvaluation (P ℤ ⊗ F) ≫ k) :=
    precomp_bijective_of_retractArrow (doubleDualEvaluationRetract r) hevalY
  have hfLocal : isSolid.isLocal f := by
    exact isSolid.isLocal.whiskerRight_mem (oneMinusShift ℤ)
      ProjectiveGeneratorProof.oneMinusShift_mem_isLocal F
  letI : IsIso (doubleInternalDualMap f) :=
    isIso_doubleInternalDualMap_of_isLocal f hfLocal
  have hf : Function.Bijective (fun k : P ℤ ⊗ F ⟶ A => f ≫ k) :=
    precomp_bijective_of_doubleDualEvaluation f hevalX
  let e := ihomPoints ℤ (P ℤ) A T
  let m := ((((MonoidalClosed.pre (oneMinusShift ℤ)).app A).hom.app ⟨T⟩))
  have hcompat : ∀ x, e (m x) = f ≫ e x := by
    intro x
    exact IntProof.ihomPoints_pre_app (oneMinusShift ℤ) T x
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    apply e.injective
    apply hf.1
    change f ≫ e x = f ≫ e y
    rw [← hcompat, ← hcompat, hxy]
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hf.2 (e z)
    change f ≫ g = e z at hg
    refine ⟨e.symm g, ?_⟩
    apply e.injective
    rw [hcompat, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, hg]

name: CategoryTheory.enoughProjectives_of_projective_separator_shrink
statement:
lemma enoughProjectives_of_projective_separator_shrink {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    [LocallySmall.{w} C] (G : C) [Projective G] (hG : IsSeparator G)
    [∀ X : C, HasCoproduct (fun _ : Shrink (G ⟶ X) => G)] : EnoughProjectives C
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun X => ⟨{
    p := ∐ fun _ : Shrink (G ⟶ X) => G,
    projective := by
      constructor
      intro E Y f e he
      letI : Epi e := he
      refine ⟨Sigma.desc fun i : Shrink (G ⟶ X) =>
        Projective.factorThru (Sigma.ι (fun _ : Shrink (G ⟶ X) => G) i ≫ f) e, ?_⟩
      apply colimit.hom_ext
      intro i
      simp
    f := Sigma.desc fun i : Shrink (G ⟶ X) => (equivShrink (G ⟶ X)).symm i,
    epi := by
      constructor
      intro Y u v huv
      refine hG.def u v ?_
      intro h
      have hh := congrArg (fun e => Sigma.ι (fun _ : Shrink (G ⟶ X) => G)
        (equivShrink (G ⟶ X) h) ≫ e) huv
      simpa [Category.assoc] using hh }⟩⟩

name: LightCondensed.LightSolidFilteredScaffold.isSheaf_pointwiseFilteredColimit_presheaf
statement:
lemma isSheaf_pointwiseFilteredColimit_presheaf
    {I : Type} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (F : I ⥤ LightCondAb) :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite)
      (pointwiseCocone (F ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ))).pt
proof:
:= by
  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_preservesFiniteProducts_and_equalizerCondition]
  constructor
  · apply +allowSynthFailures comp_preservesFiniteProducts
    have : ∀ (i : I), PreservesFiniteProducts ((F ⋙ sheafToPresheaf _ _).obj i) := fun i => by
      exact inferInstanceAs (PreservesFiniteProducts (F.obj i).obj)
    exact ⟨fun _ ↦ preservesLimitsOfShape_of_evaluation _ _ fun d ↦
      inferInstanceAs (PreservesLimitsOfShape _ ((F ⋙ sheafToPresheaf _ _).obj d))⟩
  · intro X B π hπ pb hpb
    let Fp := F ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)
    let G : WalkingParallelPair ⥤ I ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ :=
      parallelPair
        (Functor.whiskerLeft Fp
          ((evaluation LightProfiniteᵒᵖ (ModuleCat ℤ)).map pb.fst.op))
        (Functor.whiskerLeft Fp
          ((evaluation LightProfiniteᵒᵖ (ModuleCat ℤ)).map pb.snd.op))
    let K : Cone G := Fork.ofι
      (Functor.whiskerLeft Fp ((evaluation LightProfiniteᵒᵖ (ModuleCat ℤ)).map π.op))
      (by
        ext i x
        change ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((F.obj i).obj.map π.op ≫
            (F.obj i).obj.map pb.fst.op) x =
          ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((F.obj i).obj.map π.op ≫
            (F.obj i).obj.map pb.snd.op) x
        simpa using congrArg
          (fun f : (F.obj i).obj.obj (Opposite.op B) ⟶
              (F.obj i).obj.obj (Opposite.op pb.pt) => ModuleCat.Hom.hom f x)
          (regularTopology.equalizerCondition_w (F.obj i).obj pb))
    have hK : IsLimit K := by
      apply evaluationJointlyReflectsLimits
      intro i
      let ii : G ⋙ (evaluation I (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj i ≅
          parallelPair ((F.obj i).obj.map pb.fst.op) ((F.obj i).obj.map pb.snd.op) :=
        parallelPair.ext (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (by rfl) (by rfl)
      let e : (Cone.postcompose ii.hom).obj (((evaluation I (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj i).mapCone K) ≅
          Fork.ofι ((F.obj i).obj.map π.op)
            (regularTopology.equalizerCondition_w (F.obj i).obj pb) := by
        refine Cone.ext (Iso.refl _) ?_
        rintro (_ | _) <;> rfl
      have hsheaf := (F.obj i).property
      rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_preservesFiniteProducts_and_equalizerCondition] at hsheaf
      exact (IsLimit.equivOfNatIsoOfIso ii _ _ e).symm (hsheaf.2 π pb hpb).some
    have hcolim : IsLimit ((colim (J := I) (C := ModuleCat ℤ)).mapCone K) :=
      isLimitOfPreserves (colim (J := I) (C := ModuleCat ℤ)) hK
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    let i : parallelPair
        ((pointwiseCocone Fp).pt.map pb.fst.op)
        ((pointwiseCocone Fp).pt.map pb.snd.op) ≅ G ⋙ colim :=
      parallelPair.ext (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (by rfl) (by rfl)
    let e : (Cone.postcompose i.hom).obj
        (Fork.ofι ((pointwiseCocone Fp).pt.map π.op)
          (regularTopology.equalizerCondition_w (pointwiseCocone Fp).pt pb)) ≅
        (colim (J := I) (C := ModuleCat ℤ)).mapCone K := by
      refine Cone.ext (Iso.refl _) ?_
      rintro (_ | _)
      · change (pointwiseCocone Fp).pt.map π.op =
          colimMap (Functor.whiskerLeft Fp ((evaluation LightProfiniteᵒᵖ (ModuleCat ℤ)).map π.op))
        rfl
      · change (pointwiseCocone Fp).pt.map π.op ≫ (pointwiseCocone Fp).pt.map pb.fst.op =
          colimMap (Functor.whiskerLeft Fp ((evaluation LightProfiniteᵒᵖ (ModuleCat ℤ)).map π.op) ≫
            Functor.whiskerLeft Fp ((evaluation LightProfiniteᵒᵖ (ModuleCat ℤ)).map pb.fst.op))
        rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.whiskerLeft_comp, ← Functor.map_comp]
        rfl
    exact (IsLimit.equivOfNatIsoOfIso i _ _ e).symm hcolim

name: LightCondensed.LightSolidFilteredScaffold.preservesFilteredColimits_hom_free_tensor_free

name: LightCondensed.LightSolidFilteredScaffold.lim_preservesFilteredColimitsOfSize_type1
statement:
lemma lim_preservesFilteredColimitsOfSize_type1 (K : Type) [SmallCategory K] [FinCategory K] :
    PreservesFilteredColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (lim : (K ⥤ Type 1) ⥤ Type 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun J _ _ => ?_⟩
  constructor
  intro F
  haveI : IsIso (colimit.post F (lim : (K ⥤ Type 1) ⥤ Type 1)) := by
    rw [show colimit.post F (lim : (K ⥤ Type 1) ⥤ Type 1) =
        (HasColimit.isoOfNatIso (limitFlipIsoCompLim F).symm ≪≫ colimitLimitIso F.flip).hom by
      apply colimit.hom_ext
      intro j
      apply limit.hom_ext
      intro k
      rw [colimit.ι_post]
      simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
      erw [HasColimit.isoOfNatIso_ι_hom_assoc]
      change lim.map (colimit.ι F j) ≫ limit.π (colimit F.flip.flip) k =
        (limitFlipIsoCompLim F).symm.hom.app j ≫
          (colimit.ι (limit F.flip) j ≫ (colimitLimitIso F.flip).hom ≫
            limit.π (colimit F.flip.flip) k)
      rw [ι_colimitLimitIso_limit_π (F.flip) j k]
      have hflip : (limitFlipIsoCompLim F).symm.hom.app j ≫ (limit.π F.flip k).app j =
          limit.π (F.obj j) k := by
        change (limitFlipIsoCompLim F).inv.app j ≫ (limit.π F.flip k).app j =
          limit.π (F.obj j) k
        rw [limitFlipIsoCompLim_inv_app]
        rw [Category.assoc]
        rw [limitObjIsoLimitCompEvaluation_inv_π_app]
        rw [HasLimit.isoOfNatIso_inv_π]
        rfl
      rw [← Category.assoc, hflip]
      change lim.map (colimit.ι F j) ≫ limit.π (colimit F) k =
        limit.π (F.obj j) k ≫ (colimit.ι F j).app k
      exact limMap_π (colimit.ι F j) k]
    infer_instance
  exact preservesColimit_of_isIso_post (lim : (K ⥤ Type 1) ⥤ Type 1) F

name: LightCondensed.LightSolidFilteredScaffold.preservesFilteredColimits_hom_cokernel_of_preserves_hom
statement:
lemma preservesFilteredColimits_hom_cokernel_of_preserves_hom {X Y : LightCondAb} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [PreservesFilteredColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (coyoneda.obj (Opposite.op X))]
    [PreservesFilteredColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (coyoneda.obj (Opposite.op Y))] :
    PreservesFilteredColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (coyoneda.obj (Opposite.op (cokernel f)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun J _ _ => ?_⟩
  letI : PreservesFilteredColimitsOfSize.{0, 0}
      (lim : (WalkingParallelPairᵒᵖ ⥤ Type 1) ⥤ Type 1) :=
    lim_preservesFilteredColimitsOfSize_type1 WalkingParallelPairᵒᵖ
  letI : PreservesColimitsOfShape J (lim : (WalkingParallelPairᵒᵖ ⥤ Type 1) ⥤ Type 1) :=
    PreservesFilteredColimitsOfSize.preserves_filtered_colimits J
  let H : WalkingParallelPairᵒᵖ ⥤ LightCondAb ⥤ Type 1 := (parallelPair f 0).op ⋙ coyoneda
  have hH : PreservesColimitsOfShape J H.flip := by
    apply preservesColimitsOfShape_of_evaluation
    intro i
    have hi : PreservesColimitsOfShape J (H.obj i) := by
      cases i using Opposite.rec
      rename_i i
      cases i
      · change PreservesColimitsOfShape J (coyoneda.obj (Opposite.op X))
        infer_instance
      · change PreservesColimitsOfShape J (coyoneda.obj (Opposite.op Y))
        infer_instance
    exact preservesColimitsOfShape_of_natIso (flipCompEvaluation H i).symm
  letI : PreservesColimitsOfShape J H.flip := hH
  have hlim : PreservesColimitsOfShape J (limit H) := by
    exact preservesColimitsOfShape_of_natIso (limitFlipIsoCompLim H.flip).symm
  letI : PreservesColimitsOfShape J (limit H) := hlim
  exact preservesColimitsOfShape_of_natIso
    (coyonedaOpColimitIsoLimitCoyoneda (parallelPair f 0)).symm

name: LightCondensed.LightSolidFilteredScaffold.preservesFilteredColimits_hom_P_tensor_free
LightCondensed.LightSolidFilteredScaffold.preservesFilteredColimits_ihom_P_of_pointwise_hom
statement:
lemma preservesFilteredColimits_ihom_P_of_pointwise_hom
    (h : ∀ T : LightProfinite,
      PreservesFilteredColimitsOfSize.{0, 0}
        (coyoneda.obj (Opposite.op (P ℤ ⊗ (LightCondensed.free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)))) :
    PreservesFilteredColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (ihom (P ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun J _ _ => ?_⟩
  letI : CreatesColimitsOfShape J
      (sheafToPresheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)) :=
    lightCondAb_sheafToPresheaf_createsFilteredColimitsOfShape J
  have hpresheaf : PreservesColimitsOfShape J
      (ihom (P ℤ) ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)) := by
    apply preservesColimitsOfShape_of_evaluation
    intro T
    cases T with
    | op T =>
      have hpoints_forget : PreservesColimitsOfShape J
          ((ihom (P ℤ) ⋙ lightCondAbPoints T) ⋙
            CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat ℤ) ⋙ uliftFunctor.{1, 0}) := by
        letI : PreservesColimitsOfShape J
            (coyoneda.obj (Opposite.op (P ℤ ⊗ (LightCondensed.free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed))) :=
          PreservesFilteredColimitsOfSize.preserves_filtered_colimits J
        exact preservesColimitsOfShape_of_natIso (ihomP_points_forget_iso T).symm
      letI : PreservesColimitsOfShape J
          ((ihom (P ℤ) ⋙ lightCondAbPoints T) ⋙
            CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat ℤ) ⋙ uliftFunctor.{1, 0}) := hpoints_forget
      exact preservesColimitsOfShape_of_reflects_of_preserves
        (F := ihom (P ℤ) ⋙ lightCondAbPoints T)
        (G := CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat ℤ) ⋙ uliftFunctor.{1, 0})
  letI : PreservesColimitsOfShape J
      (ihom (P ℤ) ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)) := hpresheaf
  exact preservesColimitsOfShape_of_reflects_of_preserves (F := ihom (P ℤ))
    (G := sheafToPresheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ))

name: LightCondensed.numeratorHomEquiv_oneMinusShift'_apply
statement:
lemma numeratorHomEquiv_oneMinusShift'_apply (S : LightProfinite)
    (g : (((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ⊗
      (free ℤ).obj S.toCondensed ⟶ Solid.IntProof.Zdisc))
    (s : S) (n : ℕ) :
    Solid.IntProof.numeratorHomEquiv S
        ((oneMinusShift' ℤ ▷ (free ℤ).obj S.toCondensed) ≫ g) ((n : ℕ∪{∞}), s) =
      Solid.IntProof.numeratorHomEquiv S g ((n : ℕ∪{∞}), s) -
        Solid.IntProof.numeratorHomEquiv S g (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∪{∞}), s)
proof:
:= by
  have hwhisk : oneMinusShift' ℤ ▷ (free ℤ).obj S.toCondensed =
      (𝟙 ((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞})) ▷
          (free ℤ).obj S.toCondensed) -
        (((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map LightProfinite.shift) ▷
          (free ℤ).obj S.toCondensed) := by
    dsimp [oneMinusShift']
    exact Solid.IntProof.sub_whiskerRight (𝟙 _) _
  rw [hwhisk]
  rw [Preadditive.sub_comp]
  change Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv (ℕ∪{∞}) S
      (((𝟙 ((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞})) ▷
          (free ℤ).obj S.toCondensed) ≫ g) -
        ((((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map LightProfinite.shift) ▷
          (free ℤ).obj S.toCondensed) ≫ g))
      ((n : ℕ∪{∞}), s) =
    Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv (ℕ∪{∞}) S g ((n : ℕ∪{∞}), s) -
      Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv (ℕ∪{∞}) S g (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∪{∞}), s)
  rw [Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv_sub_apply]
  have hid : Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv (ℕ∪{∞}) S
        ((𝟙 ((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞})) ▷
          (free ℤ).obj S.toCondensed) ≫ g) =
      Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv (ℕ∪{∞}) S g := by
    simp only [id_whiskerRight]
    change Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv (ℕ∪{∞}) S
        (𝟙 ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed ⊗ (free ℤ).obj S.toCondensed) ≫ g) =
      Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv (ℕ∪{∞}) S g
    rw [Category.id_comp]
  have hshift : Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv (ℕ∪{∞}) S
        ((((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map LightProfinite.shift) ▷
          (free ℤ).obj S.toCondensed) ≫ g) =
      (Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv (ℕ∪{∞}) S g).comap
        (LightProfinite.shift ▷ S).hom.hom := by
    simpa using Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv_precomp_left (S := S) LightProfinite.shift g
  rw [hid, hshift]
  rw [LocallyConstant.coe_comap_apply]
  change ((Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv (ℕ∪{∞}) S) g) ((n : ℕ∪{∞}), s) -
      ((Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv (ℕ∪{∞}) S) g) (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∪{∞}), s) =
    ((Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv (ℕ∪{∞}) S) g) ((n : ℕ∪{∞}), s) -
      ((Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv (ℕ∪{∞}) S) g) (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∪{∞}), s)
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.oneMinusShift_component_bijective
statement:
lemma oneMinusShift_component_bijective (S : LightProfinite) :
    Function.Bijective
      (((((MonoidalClosed.pre (oneMinusShift ℤ)).app Solid.IntProof.Zdisc).hom.app ⟨S⟩) :
        ((ihom (P ℤ)).obj Solid.IntProof.Zdisc).obj.obj ⟨S⟩ ⟶
          ((ihom (P ℤ)).obj Solid.IntProof.Zdisc).obj.obj ⟨S⟩))
proof:
:= by
  let E : ((ihom (P ℤ)).obj Solid.IntProof.Zdisc).obj.obj ⟨S⟩ ≃
      LocallyConstant S Solid.IntProof.SeqZ :=
    (ihomPoints ℤ (P ℤ) Solid.IntProof.Zdisc S).trans (Solid.IntProof.nullSeqPointsEquiv S)
  let D := Solid.IntProof.locallyConstantSeqDiffEquiv S
  let m := ((((MonoidalClosed.pre (oneMinusShift ℤ)).app Solid.IntProof.Zdisc).hom.app ⟨S⟩) :
        ((ihom (P ℤ)).obj Solid.IntProof.Zdisc).obj.obj ⟨S⟩ ⟶
          ((ihom (P ℤ)).obj Solid.IntProof.Zdisc).obj.obj ⟨S⟩)
  have hcompat : ∀ x, E (m x) = D (E x) := by
    intro x
    exact component_nullSeqPointsEquiv_oneMinusShift S x
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    apply E.injective
    have h := congrArg E hxy
    rw [hcompat x, hcompat y] at h
    exact D.injective h
  · intro y
    refine ⟨E.symm (D.symm (E y)), ?_⟩
    apply E.injective
    rw [hcompat]
    simp [E, D]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.isSolid_iff_isLocal
statement:
private lemma isSolid_iff_isLocal (A : LightCondAb) :
    isSolid A ↔ solidGeneratingMaps.isLocal A
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSolid, ← isIso_iff_of_reflects_iso _ (equivSmall (ModuleCat ℤ)).functor,
    ← isIso_iff_of_reflects_iso _ (sheafToPresheaf _ _), NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  have h (S : SmallModel.{0} LightProfinite) :
      IsIso ((((MonoidalClosed.pre (oneMinusShift ℤ)).app A).hom.app
        ⟨(equivSmallModel LightProfinite).inverse.obj S⟩)) ↔
      Function.Bijective (fun (g : P ℤ ⊗ (free ℤ).obj
          ((equivSmallModel LightProfinite).inverse.obj S).toCondensed ⟶ A) ↦
        (oneMinusShift ℤ ▷ _) ≫ g) := by
    rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
    let e := ihomPoints ℤ (P ℤ) A ((equivSmallModel LightProfinite).inverse.obj S)
    rw [← Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff _ e.bijective,
      ← Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff' e.bijective]
    apply Iff.of_eq
    congr 1
    funext x
    exact IntProof.ihomPoints_pre_app (oneMinusShift ℤ) _ x
  constructor
  · intro hA X Y f hf
    cases hf with
    | mk S => exact (h S).1 (hA ⟨S⟩)
  · intro hA S
    exact (h S.unop).2 (hA _ (.mk S.unop))

name: LightCondensed.Solid.isSolid_internalHom
statement: lemma isSolid_internalHom (A B : LightCondAb) (hB : isSolid B) : isSolid ((ihom A).obj B)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [isSolid] at hB ⊢
  have : IsIso <| (ihomFlipIso A (P ℤ) B).inv ≫
    (MonoidalClosed.internalHom.obj ⟨A⟩).map ((MonoidalClosed.pre (oneMinusShift ℤ)).app B) ≫
    (ihomFlipIso A (P ℤ) B).hom := inferInstance
  convert this
  rw [Iso.eq_inv_comp]
  simp [ihomFlipIso, ihomAdjunctionIso]
  apply Yoneda.fullyFaithful.map_injective
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Functor.FullyFaithful.map_preimage]
  ext ⟨W⟩
  dsimp
  erw [MonoidalClosed.homEquiv_apply_eq, MonoidalClosed.homEquiv_apply_eq,
    MonoidalClosed.homEquiv_apply_eq, MonoidalClosed.homEquiv_apply_eq,
    MonoidalClosed.homEquiv_apply_eq, MonoidalClosed.homEquiv_apply_eq,
    MonoidalClosed.homEquiv_symm_apply_eq, MonoidalClosed.homEquiv_symm_apply_eq,
    MonoidalClosed.homEquiv_symm_apply_eq, MonoidalClosed.homEquiv_symm_apply_eq,
    MonoidalClosed.homEquiv_symm_apply_eq, MonoidalClosed.homEquiv_symm_apply_eq]
  erw [curry_pre_app, curry_pre_app, curry_pre_app]
  simp only [uncurry_curry]
  congr
  simp [curry_eq, uncurry_eq]
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [← associator_naturality_right_assoc, ← whisker_exchange_assoc,
    ← associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc]
  simp only [← whiskerLeft_comp_assoc (W := A), ← whisker_exchange]
  simp only [whiskerLeft_comp, Category.assoc, associator_inv_naturality_middle_assoc,
    ← MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight_assoc,
    BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_right]
  rw [MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight_assoc, associator_naturality_left_assoc,
    whisker_exchange_assoc]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.intModuleCatModuleSMulComm
proof:
:= by
  let d : DistribMulAction ℤ (↑M) := M.isModule.toDistribMulAction
  refine @SMulCommClass.mk ℤ ℤ (↑M) d.toSMul d.toSMul ?_
  intro a b x
  show d.smul a (d.smul b x) = d.smul b (d.smul a x)
  calc
    d.smul a (d.smul b x) = d.smul (a * b) x := (d.mul_smul a b x).symm
    _ = d.smul (b * a) x := by rw [mul_comm]
    _ = d.smul b (d.smul a x) := d.mul_smul b a x

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorDescLin_fac
statement:
lemma freeTensorDescLin_fac (X : LightProfinite.{0}) (B C : LightCondAb)
    (b : ∀ S : LightProfinite.{0}, (S ⟶ X) → (B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩ →ₗ[ℤ] C.obj.obj ⟨S⟩))
    (hnat : ∀ {S T : LightProfinite.{0}} (g : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ X)
      (m : B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩),
      C.obj.map g.op (b S f m) = b T (g ≫ f) (B.obj.map g.op m)) :
    let L := presheafToSheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)
    let F : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ := X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ
    let G : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ := B.obj
    let α : F ⊗ G ⟶ C.obj := freeTensorPresheafDescLin X B C b hnat
    let cB : L.obj G ⟶ B :=
      (sheafificationAdjunction (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)).counit.app B
    let cC : L.obj C.obj ⟶ C :=
      (sheafificationAdjunction (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)).counit.app C
    (L.obj F ◁ cB) ≫ freeTensorDescLin X B C b hnat =
      (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).hom ≫ L.map α ≫ cC
proof:
:= by
  intro L F G α cB cC
  haveI : IsIso cB := by
    dsimp [cB, G, L]
    exact isIso_sheafificationAdjunction_counit B
  dsimp [freeTensorDescLin]
  simp [cB, cC, L, F, G, α]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorDescLin_sheafify_fac
statement:
lemma freeTensorDescLin_sheafify_fac (X : LightProfinite.{0}) (B C : LightCondAb)
    (b : ∀ S : LightProfinite.{0}, (S ⟶ X) → (B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩ →ₗ[ℤ] C.obj.obj ⟨S⟩))
    (hnat : ∀ {S T : LightProfinite.{0}} (g : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ X)
      (m : B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩),
      C.obj.map g.op (b S f m) = b T (g ≫ f) (B.obj.map g.op m)) :
    let L := presheafToSheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)
    let F : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ := X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ
    let G : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ := B.obj
    let α : F ⊗ G ⟶ C.obj := freeTensorPresheafDescLin X B C b hnat
    let cC : L.obj C.obj ⟶ C :=
      (sheafificationAdjunction (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)).counit.app C
    CategoryTheory.toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (F ⊗ G) ≫
      ((L.map α ≫ cC).hom) = α
proof:
:= by
  intro L F G α cC
  change CategoryTheory.toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (F ⊗ G) ≫
      CategoryTheory.sheafifyMap (coherentTopology LightProfinite) α ≫ cC.hom = α
  rw [← CategoryTheory.toSheafify_naturality_assoc]
  dsimp [cC]
  rw [CategoryTheory.sheafificationAdjunction_counit_app_val]
  rw [CategoryTheory.toSheafify_sheafifyLift]
  simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeHomEquivPoints_map

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeHomEquivPoints_sub
statement:
lemma freeHomEquivPoints_sub (T : LightProfinite) (A : LightCondAb)
    (f g : (free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed ⟶ A) :
    freeHomEquivPoints T A (f - g) =
      freeHomEquivPoints T A f - freeHomEquivPoints T A g
proof:
:= by
  change (show A.obj.obj ⟨T⟩ from (coherentTopology LightProfinite).yonedaEquiv
      (((freeForgetAdjunction ℤ).homEquiv T.toCondensed A) (f - g))) =
    (show A.obj.obj ⟨T⟩ from (coherentTopology LightProfinite).yonedaEquiv
      (((freeForgetAdjunction ℤ).homEquiv T.toCondensed A) f)) -
    (show A.obj.obj ⟨T⟩ from (coherentTopology LightProfinite).yonedaEquiv
      (((freeForgetAdjunction ℤ).homEquiv T.toCondensed A) g))
  rw [GrothendieckTopology.yonedaEquiv_apply]
  rw [GrothendieckTopology.yonedaEquiv_apply]
  rw [GrothendieckTopology.yonedaEquiv_apply]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply]
  let u := (((freeForgetAdjunction ℤ).unit.app T.toCondensed).hom.app ⟨T⟩ (𝟙 T))
  change (show A.obj.obj ⟨T⟩ from ((forget ℤ).map (f - g)).hom.app ⟨T⟩ u) =
    (show A.obj.obj ⟨T⟩ from ((forget ℤ).map f).hom.app ⟨T⟩ u) -
    (show A.obj.obj ⟨T⟩ from ((forget ℤ).map g).hom.app ⟨T⟩ u)
  change (f - g).hom.app ⟨T⟩ u = f.hom.app ⟨T⟩ u - g.hom.app ⟨T⟩ u
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeMap_topologicalFree_apply
statement:
lemma freeMap_topologicalFree_apply {S T : LightProfinite} (f : S ⟶ T) (s : S) :
    (show C(↑S.toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
      (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨S⟩
        (freeHomEquivPoints S ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)
          ((free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map f)))) s =
      Finsupp.single (f s) (1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := (freeHomEquivPoints_comp S
    ((free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map f))
    (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T)).symm
  have hsec : (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨S⟩
        (freeHomEquivPoints S ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)
          ((free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map f))) =
      freeHomEquivPoints S (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed T)
        (((free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map f)) ≫
          LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T) := by
    simpa using hcomp
  rw [hsec]
  change (show C(↑S.toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
      freeHomEquivPoints S (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed T)
        (((free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map f)) ≫
          LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T)) s = _
  rw [LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree_naturality]
  have hcomp2 := (freeHomEquivPoints_comp S (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree S)
    (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensedMap f)).symm
  have hsec2 : freeHomEquivPoints S (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed T)
      (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree S ≫ LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensedMap f) =
      (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensedMap f).hom.app ⟨S⟩
        (freeHomEquivPoints S (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed S)
          (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree S)) := by
    simpa using hcomp2.symm
  rw [hsec2]
  have hfree : freeHomEquivPoints S (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed S)
      (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree S) =
      (coherentTopology LightProfinite).yonedaEquiv (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeDiracSection S) := by
    simp [LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree, freeHomEquivPoints, Equiv.trans_apply]
    rfl
  rw [hfree]
  change (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap f).hom
      ((show C(↑S.toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree S).toModuleCat) from
        (coherentTopology LightProfinite).yonedaEquiv (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeDiracSection S)) s) = _
  rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeDiracSection_yoneda_apply]
  rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap_single]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeToTopologicalFree_id_apply
statement:
lemma freeToTopologicalFree_id_apply (T : LightProfinite) (t : T) :
    (show C(↑T.toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
      (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨T⟩
        (freeHomEquivPoints T ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) (𝟙 _))) t =
      Finsupp.single t (1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := (freeHomEquivPoints_comp T (𝟙 ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed))
    (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T)).symm
  have hsec : (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨T⟩
        (freeHomEquivPoints T ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) (𝟙 _)) =
      freeHomEquivPoints T (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed T)
        (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T) := by
    simpa using hcomp
  rw [hsec]
  have hfree : freeHomEquivPoints T (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed T)
      (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T) =
      (coherentTopology LightProfinite).yonedaEquiv (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeDiracSection T) := by
    simp [LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree, freeHomEquivPoints, Equiv.trans_apply]
    rfl
  rw [hfree]
  exact LightCondAb.topologicalFreeDiracSection_yoneda_apply T t

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.curry'_pre_app
statement:
lemma curry'_pre_app {X Y Z : LightCondAb} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    MonoidalClosed.curry' (f ≫ g) =
      MonoidalClosed.curry' g ≫ (MonoidalClosed.pre f).app Z
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [MonoidalClosed.curry']
  rw [MonoidalClosed.curry_pre_app]
  congr 1
  simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.oneMinusShift_mem_isLocal
statement: lemma oneMinusShift_mem_isLocal : isSolid.isLocal (oneMinusShift ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  intro Z hZ
  dsimp [isSolid] at hZ
  let φ := ((MonoidalClosed.pre (oneMinusShift ℤ)).app Z)
  haveI : IsIso φ := hZ
  have hcompat : ∀ g : P ℤ ⟶ Z,
      MonoidalClosed.curry' ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ≫ g) = MonoidalClosed.curry' g ≫ φ := by
    intro g
    exact curry'_pre_app (oneMinusShift ℤ) g
  constructor
  · intro g₁ g₂ h
    apply MonoidalClosed.curry'_injective
    apply (cancel_mono φ).1
    rw [← hcompat, ← hcompat]
    exact congrArg MonoidalClosed.curry' h
  · intro g
    let a : 𝟙_ LightCondAb ⟶ (ihom (P ℤ)).obj Z := MonoidalClosed.curry' g ≫ inv φ
    refine ⟨MonoidalClosed.uncurry' a, ?_⟩
    apply MonoidalClosed.curry'_injective
    rw [hcompat]
    dsimp [a, φ]
    simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.solidification_map_oneMinusShift_tensor_isIso
statement:
lemma solidification_map_oneMinusShift_tensor_isIso (M : LightCondAb) :
    IsIso (solidification.map ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ M))
proof:
:= by
  apply Localization.inverts solidification isSolid.isLocal
  exact isSolid.isLocal.whiskerRight_mem (oneMinusShift ℤ) oneMinusShift_mem_isLocal M

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.solidifiedFreeHomEquiv_comp
statement:
lemma solidifiedFreeHomEquiv_comp
    (T : LightProfinite) {A B : Solid}
    (k : solidification.obj ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) ⟶ A)
    (f : A ⟶ B) :
    solidifiedFreeHomEquiv T B (k ≫ f) =
      ((isSolid.ι.map f).hom.app ⟨T⟩)
        (solidifiedFreeHomEquiv T A k)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [solidifiedFreeHomEquiv]
  erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  erw [GrothendieckTopology.yonedaEquiv_comp]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.solidifiedFree_hom_ext
statement:
lemma solidifiedFree_hom_ext
    {X Y : Solid} (f g : X ⟶ Y)
    (h : ∀ (T : LightProfinite)
      (k : solidification.obj ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) ⟶ X),
      k ≫ f = k ≫ g) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply isSolid.ι.map_injective
  ext S x
  rcases S with ⟨T⟩
  let k : solidification.obj ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) ⟶ X :=
    (solidifiedFreeHomEquiv T X).symm x
  have hk := h T k
  have hpoint := congrArg (solidifiedFreeHomEquiv T Y) hk
  change solidifiedFreeHomEquiv T Y (k ≫ f) = solidifiedFreeHomEquiv T Y (k ≫ g) at hpoint
  rw [solidifiedFreeHomEquiv_comp, solidifiedFreeHomEquiv_comp] at hpoint
  have hx : (solidifiedFreeHomEquiv T X) k = x := by
    dsimp [k]
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [hx] at hpoint
  exact hpoint

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.P_proj_comp_P_homMk
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma P_proj_comp_P_homMk (A : LightCondAb)
    (f : (free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed ⟶ A) (hf : P_map ℤ ≫ f = 0) :
    P_proj ℤ ≫ P_homMk ℤ A f hf = f
proof:
:= by
  change cokernel.π (P_map ℤ) ≫ cokernel.desc (P_map ℤ) f hf = f
  exact cokernel.π_desc (P_map ℤ) f hf

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pBasis_comp_infinitePToFree
statement:
lemma pBasis_comp_infinitePToFree (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T] (i : ℕ) :
    pBasis i ≫ infinitePToFree T = freePointIsoUnit.inv ≫ infinitePToFreeFiniteValue T i
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [pBasis, infinitePToFree]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [P_proj_comp_P_homMk]
  dsimp [freeNatBasis]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  change freePointIsoUnit.inv ≫
      freeNatValue ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) i (infinitePToFreeNumerator T) =
    freePointIsoUnit.inv ≫ infinitePToFreeFiniteValue T i
  rw [infinitePToFreeNumerator_finite]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.finiteDifferenceIndexMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma finiteDifferenceIndexMap_apply (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T] (n : ℕ)

    finiteDifferenceIndexMap T n a =
      (finiteDifferenceIndex T ⟨n, a⟩ : ℕ∪{∞})
proof: := rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeNatMap_comp_infinitePToFree
statement:
lemma freeNatMap_comp_infinitePToFree (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T] (i : ℕ) :
    (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (natPoint i)) ≫ P_proj ℤ ≫
      infinitePToFree T = infinitePToFreeFiniteValue T i
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [infinitePToFree]
  rw [P_proj_comp_P_homMk]
  change freeNatValue ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) i (infinitePToFreeNumerator T) =
    infinitePToFreeFiniteValue T i
  rw [infinitePToFreeNumerator_finite]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freePointMap_comp_infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice
statement:
lemma freePointMap_comp_infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T]
    (n : ℕ) (t : T) :
    freePointMap T t ≫ infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice T n =
      (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map
        (natPoint (finiteDifferenceIndex T ⟨n, T.proj n t⟩))) ≫ P_proj ℤ
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [freePointMap, infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice]
  change (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map (pointMap T t) ≫
      ((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map
        (T.proj n ≫ finiteDifferenceIndexMap T n) ≫ P_proj ℤ) =
      (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map
        (natPoint (finiteDifferenceIndex T ⟨n, T.proj n t⟩)) ≫ P_proj ℤ
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freePointMap_comp_infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice_comp
statement:
lemma freePointMap_comp_infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice_comp (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T]
    (n : ℕ) (t : T) :
    freePointMap T t ≫ infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice T n ≫ infinitePToFree T =
      finiteDifferenceValue T n (T.proj n t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [freePointMap_comp_infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [freeNatMap_comp_infinitePToFree]
  rw [infinitePToFreeFiniteValue_index]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freePointMap_comp_freeFiniteApproxRetraction
statement:
lemma freePointMap_comp_freeFiniteApproxRetraction (T : LightProfinite) (n : ℕ) (t : T) :
    freePointMap T t ≫ freeFiniteApproxRetraction T n =
      freePointMap T (LightProfinite.finiteApproxRetraction T n t)
proof:
:= by
  exact freePointMap_comp T T (LightProfinite.finiteApproxRetraction T n) t

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.finiteApproxRetraction_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma finiteApproxRetraction_apply (T : LightProfinite) (n : ℕ) (t : T) :
    LightProfinite.finiteApproxRetraction T n t = LightProfinite.projSection T n (T.proj n t)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.finiteDifferenceValue_eq_point_tail_diff
statement:
lemma finiteDifferenceValue_eq_point_tail_diff (T : LightProfinite) (n : ℕ) (t : T) :
    finiteDifferenceValue T n (T.proj n t) =
      freePointMap T t ≫ (freeTailEndomorphism T n - freeTailEndomorphism T (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      dsimp [finiteDifferenceValue, freeTailEndomorphism]
      change freePointMap T (LightProfinite.projSection T 0 (T.proj 0 t)) =
        freePointMap T t - (freePointMap T t -
          freePointMap T t ≫ freeFiniteApproxRetraction T 0)
      rw [freePointMap_comp_freeFiniteApproxRetraction]
      rw [finiteApproxRetraction_apply]
      abel
  | succ m =>
      dsimp [finiteDifferenceValue, freeTailEndomorphism]
      change freePointMap T (LightProfinite.projSection T (m + 1) (T.proj (m + 1) t)) -
          freePointMap T (LightProfinite.projSection T m (T.transitionMap m (T.proj (m + 1) t))) =
        (freePointMap T t - freePointMap T t ≫ freeFiniteApproxRetraction T m) -
          (freePointMap T t - freePointMap T t ≫ freeFiniteApproxRetraction T (m + 1))
      rw [freePointMap_comp_freeFiniteApproxRetraction]
      rw [freePointMap_comp_freeFiniteApproxRetraction]
      rw [finiteApproxRetraction_apply]
      rw [finiteApproxRetraction_apply]
      have hproj : T.proj m t = T.transitionMap m (T.proj (m + 1) t) := by
        have hmap := congrArg (fun f : T ⟶ T.component m => f t)
          (T.proj_comp_transitionMap m)
        simpa using hmap.symm
      rw [hproj]
      abel

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice_comp_pointwise
statement:
lemma infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice_comp_pointwise (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T]
    (n : ℕ) (t : T) :
    freePointMap T t ≫ (infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice T n ≫ infinitePToFree T) =
      freePointMap T t ≫ (freeTailEndomorphism T n - freeTailEndomorphism T (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [freePointMap_comp_infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice_comp]
  rw [finiteDifferenceValue_eq_point_tail_diff]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice_comp
statement:
lemma infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice_comp (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T] (n : ℕ) :
    infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice T n ≫ infinitePToFree T =
      freeTailEndomorphism T n - freeTailEndomorphism T (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply freeTarget_hom_ext_of_points
  intro t
  exact infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice_comp_pointwise T n t

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun_fiber_eq
statement:
lemma finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun_fiber_eq (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T] (i : ℕ) :
    {x : ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) |
      finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun T x = (i : ℕ∪{∞})} =
    {x : ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) |
      x.1 = (((nullFiniteDifferenceEnumeration T).seq i).1 : ℕ∪{∞}) ∧
        T.proj (((nullFiniteDifferenceEnumeration T).seq i).1) x.2 =
          ((nullFiniteDifferenceEnumeration T).seq i).2}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m0, b0, hseqi⟩ : ∃ m0 : ℕ, ∃ b0 : T.component m0,
      (nullFiniteDifferenceEnumeration T).seq i = (⟨m0, b0⟩ : finiteDifferencePoint T) := by
    rcases (nullFiniteDifferenceEnumeration T).seq i with ⟨m0, b0⟩
    exact ⟨m0, b0, rfl⟩
  ext x
  rcases x with ⟨a, t⟩
  cases a using OnePoint.rec with
  | infty =>
      simp [finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun, hseqi]
  | coe n0 =>
      constructor
      · intro h
        have hidx : finiteDifferenceIndex T ⟨n0, T.proj n0 t⟩ = i := by
          simpa [finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun] using h
        have hseq := nullFiniteDifferenceEnumeration_seq_index T ⟨n0, T.proj n0 t⟩
        rw [hidx, hseqi] at hseq
        cases hseq
        exact ⟨by simp [hseqi], by rw [hseqi]⟩
      · rintro ⟨hfst, hsnd⟩
        have hn : n0 = m0 := by
          simpa [hseqi] using hfst
        cases hn
        have hp : (⟨m0, T.proj m0 t⟩ : finiteDifferencePoint T) =
            (nullFiniteDifferenceEnumeration T).seq i := by
          have hsnd' : T.proj m0 t = b0 := by
            rw [hseqi] at hsnd
            exact hsnd
          rw [hseqi]
          exact congrArg (fun b : T.component m0 ↦ (⟨m0, b⟩ : finiteDifferencePoint T)) hsnd'
        have hidx := congrArg (finiteDifferenceIndex T) hp
        rw [finiteDifferenceIndex_seq] at hidx
        simpa [finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun] using hidx

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.isOpen_finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun_fiber
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun_fiber_eq]
  obtain ⟨m, b, hseq⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ b : T.component m,
      (nullFiniteDifferenceEnumeration T).seq i = (⟨m, b⟩ : finiteDifferencePoint T) := by
    rcases (nullFiniteDifferenceEnumeration T).seq i with ⟨m, b⟩
    exact ⟨m, b, rfl⟩
  rw [hseq]
  have hfirst : IsOpen {x : ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) |
      x.1 = (m : ℕ∪{∞})} := by
    have hopen : IsOpen ({(m : ℕ∪{∞})} : Set ℕ∪{∞}) := by
      simpa using (OnePoint.isOpen_image_coe (X := ℕ) (s := ({m} : Set ℕ))).2
        (isOpen_discrete _)
    simpa [IntProof.fstMap, Set.preimage, Set.setOf_eq_eq_singleton] using
      hopen.preimage (IntProof.fstMap T).continuous
  have hsecond : IsOpen {x : ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) |
      T.proj m x.2 = b} := by
    letI : DiscreteTopology (T.component m) := Finite.instDiscreteTopology
    have hopen : IsOpen ({b} : Set (T.component m)) := isOpen_discrete _
    have hcont : Continuous
        (fun x : ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) => T.proj m x.2) :=
      (T.proj m).hom.hom.continuous.comp (IntProof.sndMap T).continuous
    simpa [Set.preimage, Set.setOf_eq_eq_singleton] using hopen.preimage hcont
  simpa [Set.setOf_and] using hfirst.inter hsecond

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.isClosed_finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun_fiber
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun_fiber_eq]
  obtain ⟨m, b, hseq⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ b : T.component m,
      (nullFiniteDifferenceEnumeration T).seq i = (⟨m, b⟩ : finiteDifferencePoint T) := by
    rcases (nullFiniteDifferenceEnumeration T).seq i with ⟨m, b⟩
    exact ⟨m, b, rfl⟩
  rw [hseq]
  have hfirst : IsClosed {x : ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) |
      x.1 = (m : ℕ∪{∞})} := by
    have hclosed : IsClosed ({(m : ℕ∪{∞})} : Set ℕ∪{∞}) := isClosed_singleton
    simpa [IntProof.fstMap, Set.preimage, Set.setOf_eq_eq_singleton] using
      hclosed.preimage (IntProof.fstMap T).continuous
  have hsecond : IsClosed {x : ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) |
      T.proj m x.2 = b} := by
    have hclosed : IsClosed ({b} : Set (T.component m)) := isClosed_singleton
    have hcont : Continuous
        (fun x : ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) => T.proj m x.2) :=
      (T.proj m).hom.hom.continuous.comp (IntProof.sndMap T).continuous
    simpa [Set.preimage, Set.setOf_eq_eq_singleton] using hclosed.preimage hcont
  simpa [Set.setOf_and] using hfirst.inter hsecond

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.continuous_finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun
statement:
lemma continuous_finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T] :
    Continuous (finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_def]
  intro s hs
  by_cases hinfty : (∞ : ℕ∪{∞}) ∈ s
  · let F : Set ℕ := (((↑) : ℕ → ℕ∪{∞}) ⁻¹' s)ᶜ
    have hcompact : IsCompact F := by
      dsimp [F]
      exact ((OnePoint.isOpen_iff_of_mem' (X := ℕ) hinfty).mp hs).1
    have hF : Set.Finite F := isCompact_iff_finite.mp hcompact
    have hpre : finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun T ⁻¹' s =
        (⋃ i ∈ F, {x : ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) |
          finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun T x = (i : ℕ∪{∞})})ᶜ := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx hmem
        simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hmem
        rcases hmem with ⟨i, hiF, hxi⟩
        have hi_not : (i : ℕ∪{∞}) ∉ s := hiF
        exact hi_not (hxi ▸ hx)
      · intro hx
        by_cases hfx : finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun T x = (∞ : ℕ∪{∞})
        · change finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun T x ∈ s
          rw [hfx]
          exact hinfty
        · rcases (OnePoint.ne_infty_iff_exists.mp hfx) with ⟨i, hi⟩
          have hnotF : i ∉ F := by
            intro hiF
            apply hx
            simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
            exact ⟨i, hiF, hi.symm⟩
          have hiA : i ∈ ((↑) : ℕ → ℕ∪{∞}) ⁻¹' s := by
            simpa [F] using hnotF
          change finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun T x ∈ s
          rw [← hi]
          exact hiA
    rw [hpre]
    exact (hF.isClosed_biUnion fun i _ =>
      isClosed_finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun_fiber T i).isOpen_compl
  · let A : Set ℕ := ((↑) : ℕ → ℕ∪{∞}) ⁻¹' s
    have hpre : finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun T ⁻¹' s =
        ⋃ i ∈ A, {x : ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) |
          finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun T x = (i : ℕ∪{∞})} := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        by_cases hfx : finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun T x = (∞ : ℕ∪{∞})
        · change finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun T x ∈ s at hx
          rw [hfx] at hx
          exact False.elim (hinfty hx)
        · rcases (OnePoint.ne_infty_iff_exists.mp hfx) with ⟨i, hi⟩
          simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
          refine ⟨i, ?_, hi.symm⟩
          change finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun T x ∈ s at hx
          rw [← hi] at hx
          exact hx
      · intro hx
        simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx
        rcases hx with ⟨i, hiA, hxi⟩
        change finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun T x ∈ s
        rw [hxi]
        exact hiA
    rw [hpre]
    exact isOpen_biUnion fun i _ => isOpen_finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinfFun_fiber T i

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.free_constInftyMap_comp_P_proj
statement:
lemma free_constInftyMap_comp_P_proj (T : LightProfinite) :
    (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (constInftyMap T)) ≫ P_proj ℤ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [constInftyMap_eq]
  change (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map (toPointMap T ≫ ι) ≫ P_proj ℤ = 0
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  change ((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map (toPointMap T) ≫ P_map ℤ) ≫
    P_proj ℤ = 0
  have hzero : P_map ℤ ≫ P_proj ℤ = 0 := by
    change P_map ℤ ≫ cokernel.π (P_map ℤ) = 0
    exact cokernel.condition (P_map ℤ)
  calc
    ((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map (toPointMap T) ≫ P_map ℤ) ≫ P_proj ℤ
        = (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map (toPointMap T) ≫
            (P_map ℤ ≫ P_proj ℤ) := by
          rw [Category.assoc]
    _ = (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map (toPointMap T) ≫ 0 := by
          exact congrArg
            (fun q => (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map (toPointMap T) ≫ q) hzero
    _ = 0 := by simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.exists_infiniteDifferenceElement
statement:
lemma exists_infiniteDifferenceElement (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T] :
    ∃ x : (P ℤ).obj.obj ⟨((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite)⟩,
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        (freeHomEquivPoints T (P ℤ)).symm
          ((P ℤ).obj.map (finiteTensorPoint T n).op x) =
            infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice T n) ∧
      (freeHomEquivPoints T (P ℤ)).symm
        ((P ℤ).obj.map (inftyTensorPoint T).op x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let f : (free ℤ).obj (((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite).toCondensed) ⟶ P ℤ :=
    (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinf T)) ≫ P_proj ℤ
  let x := freeHomEquivPoints (((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite)) (P ℤ) f
  refine ⟨x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n
    dsimp [x, f]
    rw [← freeHomEquivPoints_symm_map]
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    change (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map (finiteTensorPoint T n) ≫
        ((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map (finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinf T) ≫
          P_proj ℤ) = infiniteDifferenceFiniteSlice T n
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    rw [← Functor.map_comp]
    rw [finiteTensorPoint_comp_finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinf]
    rfl
  · dsimp [x, f]
    rw [← freeHomEquivPoints_symm_map]
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    change (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map (inftyTensorPoint T) ≫
        ((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map (finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinf T) ≫
          P_proj ℤ) = 0
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    rw [← Functor.map_comp]
    rw [inftyTensorPoint_comp_finiteDifferenceIndexOverNinf]
    exact free_constInftyMap_comp_P_proj T

statement:
lemma infiniteShiftRetract_comm (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T] :
    ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ (free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) ≫ infiniteTailMap T =
      infiniteDifferenceMap T ≫ infinitePToFree T
proof:
:= by
  let M := (free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed
  haveI : Epi (P_proj ℤ ▷ M) := epi_P_proj_tensor M
  apply (cancel_epi (P_proj ℤ ▷ M)).1
  dsimp [infiniteTailMap, infiniteDifferenceMap, M]
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [P_proj_tensor_oneMinusShift]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [pTensorDesc_comp_proj]
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [pTensorDesc_comp_proj]
  exact infiniteShiftRetract_numerator_comm T

name: CategoryTheory.isSeparator_of_iso
statement:
lemma isSeparator_of_iso {C : Type*} [Category C]
    {G H : C} (e : G ≅ H) (hG : IsSeparator G) :
    IsSeparator H
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSeparator_def] at hG ⊢
  exact fun _ _ f g hH ↦ hG f g fun k ↦ by simpa using e.hom ≫= hH (e.inv ≫ k)

name: CategoryTheory.isSeparator_of_retracts_of_hom_ext
statement:
lemma isSeparator_of_retracts_of_hom_ext {C : Type*} [Category C] {I : Type*} (F : I → C) (G : C)
    (hjoint : ∀ {X Y : C} (f g : X ⟶ Y), (∀ i (k : F i ⟶ X), k ≫ f = k ≫ g) → f = g)
    (r : ∀ i, Retract (F i) G) : IsSeparator G
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSeparator_def]
  exact fun _ _ f g hG ↦ hjoint f g fun i k ↦ by simpa using (r i).i ≫= hG ((r i).r ≫ k)

name: CategoryTheory.projective_of_internallyProjective_of_projective_unit
statement:
lemma projective_of_internallyProjective_of_projective_unit
    {C : Type*} [Category* C] [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalClosed C]
    (P : C) [Projective (𝟙_ C)] [InternallyProjective P] : Projective P where
  factors {E X} f e he
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ := Projective.factors (MonoidalClosed.curry ((ρ_ P).hom ≫ f)) ((ihom P).map e)
    refine ⟨(ρ_ P).inv ≫ MonoidalClosed.uncurry g', ?_⟩
    simpa [MonoidalClosed.uncurry_natural_right] using (ρ_ P).inv ≫=
      (congrArg MonoidalClosed.uncurry hg')

name: CategoryTheory.ShiftRetractData.isIso_map_g

    IsIso (L.map d.g)
proof:
:= by
  letI := d.inverted
  exact ⟨(d.retract).i, hidempotent, d.retract.retract⟩

name: LightProfinite.exists_section_of_epi_to_finite
statement:
lemma exists_section_of_epi_to_finite {X Y : LightProfinite} [Finite Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [Epi f] : ∃ s : Y ⟶ X, s ≫ f = 𝟙 Y
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Function.Surjective f := (LightProfinite.epi_iff_surjective f).mp inferInstance
  let sFun : Y → X := fun y => (hf y).choose
  have hsFun : ∀ y, f (sFun y) = y := fun y => (hf y).choose_spec
  letI : DiscreteTopology Y := Finite.instDiscreteTopology
  let s : Y ⟶ X := ConcreteCategory.ofHom ⟨sFun, continuous_of_discreteTopology⟩
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  ext y
  exact hsFun y

name: LightProfinite.finiteApproxRetraction_proj_le
statement:
lemma finiteApproxRetraction_proj_le (T : LightProfinite) {k n : ℕ} (h : k ≤ n) :
    finiteApproxRetraction T n ≫ T.proj k = T.proj k
proof:
:= by
  calc
    finiteApproxRetraction T n ≫ T.proj k
        = T.proj n ≫ (projSection T n ≫ T.proj k) := by
          rw [finiteApproxRetraction, Category.assoc]
    _ = T.proj n ≫ T.transitionMapLE h := by
          rw [projSection_proj_le]
    _ = T.proj k := T.proj_comp_transitionMapLE h

proof:

  obtain ⟨j, g, hg⟩ := Profinite.exists_locallyConstant
    (C := lightToProfinite.mapCone T.asLimitCone) hlim f

name: LightProfinite.exists_clopen_avoiding_finset
statement:
lemma exists_clopen_avoiding_finset (T : LightProfinite)
    (s : Finset T) {t : T} (ht : t ∉ s) :
    ∃ U : Set T, IsClopen U ∧ t ∈ U ∧ ∀ u ∈ s, u ∉ U
proof:
:= by
  have hsclosed : IsClosed ((s : Set T)) := s.finite_toSet.isClosed
  have hopen : IsOpen ((s : Set T)ᶜ) := hsclosed.isOpen_compl
  have htmem : t ∈ ((s : Set T)ᶜ) := by simpa using ht
  obtain ⟨U, hU, htU, hUsub⟩ := compact_exists_isClopen_in_isOpen hopen htmem
  refine ⟨U, hU, htU, ?_⟩
  intro u hus huU
  exact hUsub huU hus

    (((LightCondMod.LocallyConstant.functorIsoDiscrete ℤ).inv.app M ≫
        (LightCondMod.LocallyConstant.functor ℤ).map f).hom.app ⟨S⟩) x

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv_symm_apply (S : LightProfinite)
    (x : ∀ _ : ℕ, LocallyConstant S ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    zdiscSectionsEquiv S
      (((productIntLightIsoProductZdisc.hom ≫
        Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => Zdisc) n).hom.app ⟨S⟩)
          ((productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S).symm x)) = x n
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun
    (LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply (productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S) x) n
  rw [productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv_apply] at h
  exact h

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.productIntSectionsEquiv_map

lemma productIntSectionsEquiv_map {S S' : LightProfinite} (φ : S' ⟶ S)

      fun n : ℕ => Zdisc.obj.map φ.op (productIntSectionsEquiv S x n)
proof:
:= by

  exact LightCondMod.hom_naturality_apply ℤ
    (productIntLightIsoProductZdisc.hom ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => Zdisc) n) φ.op x

statement:
lemma productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv_map {S S' : LightProfinite} (φ : S' ⟶ S)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorPointUnit_eq
statement:
lemma freeTensorPointUnit_eq (X : LightProfinite.{0})
    (x : LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1} ⟶ X) :
    freeTensorPointUnit X x =
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε
        ((Functor.whiskeringRight LightProfiniteᵒᵖ (Type 0) (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj (ModuleCat.free ℤ)) ≫
      𝟙 (𝟙_ (LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ Type) ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ) ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε lightProfiniteToLightCondSet).hom
        (ModuleCat.free ℤ) ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map x).hom (ModuleCat.free ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  ext S
  change Finsupp.single (toPointMap S.unop ≫ x) (1 : ℤ) =
    (ConcreteCategory.hom ((ModuleCat.free ℤ).map ((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map x).hom.app S)))
      ((ConcreteCategory.hom ((ModuleCat.free ℤ).map
        ((Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε lightProfiniteToLightCondSet).hom.app S)))
        ((ConcreteCategory.hom (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (ModuleCat.free ℤ))) 1))
  rw [ModuleCat.free_ε_one]
  rw [ModuleCat.free_map_apply]
  rw [ModuleCat.free_map_apply]
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorPointUnit_sheafify
statement:
lemma freeTensorPointUnit_sheafify (X : LightProfinite.{0})
    (x : LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1} ⟶ X) :
    let L := presheafToSheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)
    Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε L ≫ L.map (freeTensorPointUnit X x) =
      freePointIsoUnit.inv ≫ (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map x)
proof:
:= by
  intro L
  rw [freeTensorPointUnit_eq]
  dsimp [freePointIsoUnit, LightCondensed.free, CategoryTheory.Sheaf.composeAndSheafify]
  simp only [Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_inv, Functor.Monoidal.εIso_hom,
    Functor.LaxMonoidal.comp_ε, ObjectProperty.ι_obj,
    CartesianMonoidalCategory.fullSubcategory_tensorUnit_obj, ObjectProperty.ι_ε,
    Functor.comp_map, Functor.whiskeringRight_obj_map, Functor.whiskerRight_id',
    Category.assoc, Functor.mapIso_hom, ObjectProperty.ι_map]
  rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorPresheafPoint_eq
statement:
lemma freeTensorPresheafPoint_eq (X : LightProfinite.{0}) (B : LightCondAb)
    (x : LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1} ⟶ X) :
    freeTensorPresheafPoint X B x =
      (λ_ B.obj).inv ≫ (freeTensorPointUnit X x ▷ B.obj)
proof:
:= by
  ext S m
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorPresheafPoint_sheafify_comp
statement:
lemma freeTensorPresheafPoint_sheafify_comp (X : LightProfinite.{0}) (B : LightCondAb)
    (x : LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1} ⟶ X) :
    let L := presheafToSheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)
    let F : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ := X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ
    let G : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ := B.obj
    CategoryTheory.toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) G ≫
      (((λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫
        (freePointIsoUnit.inv ≫ (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map x)) ▷ L.obj G ≫
        (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).hom).hom) =
      freeTensorPresheafPoint X B x ≫
        CategoryTheory.toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (F ⊗ G)
proof:
:= by
  intro L F G
  have hunit := freeTensorPointUnit_sheafify X x
  dsimp only at hunit
  rw [← hunit]
  have hsheaf :
      (λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫
          (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε L ≫ L.map (freeTensorPointUnit X x)) ▷ L.obj G ≫
          (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).hom =
        L.map (freeTensorPresheafPoint X B x) := by
    rw [freeTensorPresheafPoint_eq]
    simp only [comp_whiskerRight, Category.assoc, Functor.Monoidal.μIso_hom]
    slice_lhs 3 4 => rw [Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_left L (freeTensorPointUnit X x) G]
    slice_lhs 1 3 => rw [Functor.LaxMonoidal.left_unitality_inv L G]
    rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [hsheaf]
  rw [← CategoryTheory.toSheafify_naturality]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorPresheafPoint_desc
statement:
lemma freeTensorPresheafPoint_desc (X : LightProfinite.{0}) (B C : LightCondAb)
    (b : ∀ S : LightProfinite.{0}, (S ⟶ X) → (B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩ →ₗ[ℤ] C.obj.obj ⟨S⟩))
    (hnat : ∀ {S T : LightProfinite.{0}} (g : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ X)
      (m : B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩),
      C.obj.map g.op (b S f m) = b T (g ≫ f) (B.obj.map g.op m))
    (x : LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1} ⟶ X) :
    freeTensorPresheafPoint X B x ≫ freeTensorPresheafDescLin X B C b hnat =
      (freeTensorFamilyMap X B C b hnat x).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext S m
  letI hC : @SMulCommClass ℤ ℤ (↑(C.obj.obj S))
      (C.obj.obj S).isModule.toDistribMulAction.toSMul
      (C.obj.obj S).isModule.toDistribMulAction.toSMul :=
    intModuleCatModuleSMulComm (C.obj.obj S)
  letI : Module ℤ (B.obj.obj S →ₗ[ℤ] C.obj.obj S) :=
    @LinearMap.module ℤ ℤ ℤ (B.obj.obj S) (C.obj.obj S) _ _ _ _ _ _
      (RingHom.id ℤ) _ _ hC
  change (TensorProduct.lift
      ((Finsupp.lift (B.obj.obj S →ₗ[ℤ] C.obj.obj S) ℤ (X.toCondensed.obj.obj S)) fun f =>
        b S.unop (freeTensorSectionHom X S f)))
      ((Finsupp.single (toPointMap S.unop ≫ x) (1 : ℤ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) =
    b S.unop (toPointMap S.unop ≫ x) m
  rw [TensorProduct.lift.tmul]
  rw [Finsupp.lift_apply]
  rw [Finsupp.sum_single_index]
  · simp [freeTensorSectionHom]
  · apply LinearMap.ext
    intro y
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply]
    let mod : Module ℤ (C.obj.obj S) := (C.obj.obj S).isModule
    change mod.toDistribMulAction.smul 0
        ((b S.unop (freeTensorSectionHom X S (toPointMap S.unop ≫ x))) y) = 0
    exact mod.zero_smul ((b S.unop (freeTensorSectionHom X S (toPointMap S.unop ≫ x))) y)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.sheafification_counit_inv_hom
proof:
:= by
  intro L cB
  haveI : IsIso cB := by
    dsimp [cB, L]
    exact isIso_sheafificationAdjunction_counit B
  apply (cancel_mono cB.hom).1
  change (inv cB ≫ cB).hom =
    CategoryTheory.toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) B.obj ≫ cB.hom
  rw [IsIso.inv_hom_id]
  dsimp [cB]
  rw [CategoryTheory.sheafificationAdjunction_counit_app_val]
  rw [CategoryTheory.toSheafify_sheafifyLift]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorDescLin_point
statement:
lemma freeTensorDescLin_point (X : LightProfinite.{0}) (B C : LightCondAb)
    (b : ∀ S : LightProfinite.{0}, (S ⟶ X) → (B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩ →ₗ[ℤ] C.obj.obj ⟨S⟩))
    (hnat : ∀ {S T : LightProfinite.{0}} (g : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ X)
      (m : B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩),
      C.obj.map g.op (b S f m) = b T (g ≫ f) (B.obj.map g.op m))
    (x : LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1} ⟶ X) :
    (λ_ B).inv ≫
      (freePointIsoUnit.inv ≫ (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map x)) ▷ B ≫
      freeTensorDescLin X B C b hnat =
    freeTensorFamilyMap X B C b hnat x
proof:
:= by
  let L := presheafToSheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)
  let F : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ := X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ
  let G : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ := B.obj
  let α : F ⊗ G ⟶ C.obj := freeTensorPresheafDescLin X B C b hnat
  let cB : L.obj G ⟶ B :=
    (sheafificationAdjunction (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)).counit.app B
  let cC : L.obj C.obj ⟶ C :=
    (sheafificationAdjunction (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)).counit.app C
  haveI : IsIso cB := by
    dsimp [cB, G, L]
    exact isIso_sheafificationAdjunction_counit B
  haveI : IsIso cC := by
    dsimp [cC, L]
    exact isIso_sheafificationAdjunction_counit C
  let p : 𝟙_ LightCondAb ⟶ L.obj F :=
    freePointIsoUnit.inv ≫ (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map x)
  have hmove :
      (λ_ B).inv ≫ p ▷ B ≫ (L.obj F ◁ inv cB) =
        inv cB ≫ (λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫ p ▷ L.obj G := by
    calc
      (λ_ B).inv ≫ p ▷ B ≫ (L.obj F ◁ inv cB)
          = (λ_ B).inv ≫ (𝟙_ LightCondAb ◁ inv cB) ≫ p ▷ L.obj G := by
              rw [MonoidalCategory.whisker_exchange p (inv cB)]
      _ = inv cB ≫ (λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫ p ▷ L.obj G := by
              rw [← MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor_inv_naturality_assoc (inv cB)]
  calc
    (λ_ B).inv ≫
        (freePointIsoUnit.inv ≫ (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map x)) ▷ B ≫
        freeTensorDescLin X B C b hnat
        = inv cB ≫ ((λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫ p ▷ L.obj G ≫
            (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).hom) ≫ L.map α ≫ cC := by
            dsimp [freeTensorDescLin]
            change (λ_ B).inv ≫ p ▷ B ≫
                ((L.obj F ◁ inv cB) ≫ (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).hom ≫
                  L.map α ≫ cC) =
              inv cB ≫ ((λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫ p ▷ L.obj G ≫
                (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).hom) ≫ L.map α ≫ cC
            slice_lhs 1 3 => rw [hmove]
            simp [Category.assoc]
    _ = freeTensorFamilyMap X B C b hnat x := by
            apply Sheaf.hom_ext
            change (inv cB).hom ≫
                (((λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫ p ▷ L.obj G ≫
                  (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).hom).hom) ≫
                ((L.map α ≫ cC).hom) =
              (freeTensorFamilyMap X B C b hnat x).hom
            have hcinv := sheafification_counit_inv_hom B
            dsimp only at hcinv
            rw [hcinv]
            have hcompat := freeTensorPresheafPoint_sheafify_comp X B x
            dsimp only at hcompat
            change CategoryTheory.toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) G ≫
                (((λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫ p ▷ L.obj G ≫
                  (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).hom).hom) =
              freeTensorPresheafPoint X B x ≫
                CategoryTheory.toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (F ⊗ G) at hcompat
            change CategoryTheory.toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) G ≫
                (((λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫ p ▷ L.obj G ≫
                  (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).hom).hom) ≫
                ((L.map α ≫ cC).hom) =
              (freeTensorFamilyMap X B C b hnat x).hom
            rw [← Category.assoc]
            rw [hcompat]
            rw [Category.assoc]
            have hfac := freeTensorDescLin_sheafify_fac X B C b hnat
            dsimp only at hfac
            change CategoryTheory.toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (F ⊗ G) ≫
                ((L.map α ≫ cC).hom) = α at hfac
            rw [hfac]
            exact freeTensorPresheafPoint_desc X B C b hnat x

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorHom_ext
statement:
lemma freeTensorHom_ext (X : LightProfinite.{0}) (B C : LightCondAb)
    (g₁ g₂ : ((free ℤ).obj X.toCondensed) ⊗ B ⟶ C)
    (h : ∀ (S : LightProfinite.{0}) (f : S ⟶ X) (r : ℤ) (m : B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩),
      freeTensorHomEval X B C g₁ S f r m = freeTensorHomEval X B C g₂ S f r m) :
    g₁ = g₂
proof:
:= by
  let L := presheafToSheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)
  let F : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ := X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ
  let G : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ := B.obj
  let cB : L.obj G ⟶ B :=
    (sheafificationAdjunction (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)).counit.app B
  haveI : IsIso cB := by
    dsimp [cB, G, L]
    exact isIso_sheafificationAdjunction_counit B
  let e : L.obj (F ⊗ G) ⟶ L.obj F ⊗ B :=
    (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).inv ≫ (L.obj F ◁ cB)
  haveI : Epi e := by
    dsimp [e]
    infer_instance
  apply (cancel_epi e).1
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  apply CategoryTheory.sheafify_hom_ext _ _ _ C.property
  ext S z
  change (freeTensorHomPresheafComposite X B C g₁).app S z =
    (freeTensorHomPresheafComposite X B C g₂).app S z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a m =>
      induction a using Finsupp.induction_linear with
      | zero => simp
      | add a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ =>
          simpa [TensorProduct.add_tmul] using congrArg₂ HAdd.hAdd ha₁ ha₂
      | single f r =>
          simpa [freeTensorHomEval, freeTensorSectionHom] using h S.unop
            (freeTensorSectionHom X S f) r m
  | add z₁ z₂ hz₁ hz₂ =>
      simpa [map_add] using congrArg₂ HAdd.hAdd hz₁ hz₂

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorHomPresheafComposite_desc
statement:
lemma freeTensorHomPresheafComposite_desc (X : LightProfinite.{0}) (B C : LightCondAb)
    (b : ∀ S : LightProfinite.{0}, (S ⟶ X) → (B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩ →ₗ[ℤ] C.obj.obj ⟨S⟩))
    (hnat : ∀ {S T : LightProfinite.{0}} (g : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ X)
      (m : B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩),
      C.obj.map g.op (b S f m) = b T (g ≫ f) (B.obj.map g.op m)) :
    freeTensorHomPresheafComposite X B C (freeTensorDescLin X B C b hnat) =
      freeTensorPresheafDescLin X B C b hnat
proof:
:= by
  let L := presheafToSheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)
  let F : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ := X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ
  let G : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ := B.obj
  let α : F ⊗ G ⟶ C.obj := freeTensorPresheafDescLin X B C b hnat
  let cB : L.obj G ⟶ B :=
    (sheafificationAdjunction (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)).counit.app B
  let cC : L.obj C.obj ⟶ C :=
    (sheafificationAdjunction (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)).counit.app C
  have hfac := freeTensorDescLin_fac X B C b hnat
  dsimp only at hfac
  change (L.obj F ◁ cB) ≫ freeTensorDescLin X B C b hnat =
    (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).hom ≫ L.map α ≫ cC at hfac
  dsimp [freeTensorHomPresheafComposite]
  have hsheaf := freeTensorDescLin_sheafify_fac X B C b hnat
  dsimp only at hsheaf
  change CategoryTheory.toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (F ⊗ G) ≫
      ((L.map α ≫ cC).hom) = α at hsheaf
  change CategoryTheory.toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (F ⊗ G) ≫
      (((Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).inv ≫
        ((L.obj F ◁ cB) ≫ freeTensorDescLin X B C b hnat)).hom) = α
  rw [hfac]
  have hμ : (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).inv ≫
      ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).hom ≫ L.map α ≫ cC) = L.map α ≫ cC := by
    simp
  rw [hμ]
  exact hsheaf

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorHomEval_desc
statement:
lemma freeTensorHomEval_desc (X : LightProfinite.{0}) (B C : LightCondAb)
    (b : ∀ S : LightProfinite.{0}, (S ⟶ X) → (B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩ →ₗ[ℤ] C.obj.obj ⟨S⟩))
    (hnat : ∀ {S T : LightProfinite.{0}} (g : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ X)
      (m : B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩),
      C.obj.map g.op (b S f m) = b T (g ≫ f) (B.obj.map g.op m))
    (S : LightProfinite.{0}) (f : S ⟶ X) (r : ℤ) (m : B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :
    freeTensorHomEval X B C (freeTensorDescLin X B C b hnat) S f r m = r • b S f m
proof:
:= by
  rw [freeTensorHomEval, freeTensorHomPresheafComposite_desc]
  letI hC : @SMulCommClass ℤ ℤ (↑(C.obj.obj ⟨S⟩))
      (C.obj.obj ⟨S⟩).isModule.toDistribMulAction.toSMul
      (C.obj.obj ⟨S⟩).isModule.toDistribMulAction.toSMul :=
    intModuleCatModuleSMulComm (C.obj.obj ⟨S⟩)
  letI : Module ℤ (B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩ →ₗ[ℤ] C.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :=
    @LinearMap.module ℤ ℤ ℤ (B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) (C.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) _ _ _ _ _ _
      (RingHom.id ℤ) _ _ hC
  change (TensorProduct.lift
      ((Finsupp.lift (B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩ →ₗ[ℤ] C.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) ℤ
        (X.toCondensed.obj.obj ⟨S⟩)) fun f' => b S (freeTensorSectionHom X ⟨S⟩ f')))
      ((Finsupp.single f r) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = r • b S f m
  rw [TensorProduct.lift.tmul]
  rw [Finsupp.lift_apply]
  rw [Finsupp.sum_single_index]
  · have hf : freeTensorSectionHom X (Opposite.op S) f = f := rfl
    rw [hf]
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply]
    simpa [RingHom.id_apply] using
      (Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul (R := ℤ) r ((b S f) m))
  · apply LinearMap.ext
    intro y
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply]
    let mod : Module ℤ (C.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) := (C.obj.obj ⟨S⟩).isModule
    change mod.toDistribMulAction.smul 0 ((b S f) y) = 0
    exact mod.zero_smul ((b S f) y)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorHomEval_point_one
statement:
lemma freeTensorHomEval_point_one (X : LightProfinite.{0}) (B C : LightCondAb)
    (g : ((free ℤ).obj X.toCondensed) ⊗ B ⟶ C)
    (x : LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1} ⟶ X)
    (S : LightProfinite.{0}) (m : B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :
    freeTensorHomEval X B C g S (toPointMap S ≫ x) 1 m =
      (((λ_ B).inv ≫
        (freePointIsoUnit.inv ≫ (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map x)) ▷ B ≫
          g).hom.app ⟨S⟩ m)
proof:
:= by
  let L := presheafToSheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)
  let F : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ := X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ
  let G : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ := B.obj
  let cB : L.obj G ⟶ B :=
    (sheafificationAdjunction (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)).counit.app B
  let p : 𝟙_ LightCondAb ⟶ L.obj F :=
    freePointIsoUnit.inv ≫ (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map x)
  have hmove :
      (λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫ p ▷ L.obj G ≫ (L.obj F ◁ cB) =
        cB ≫ (λ_ B).inv ≫ p ▷ B := by
    calc
      (λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫ p ▷ L.obj G ≫ (L.obj F ◁ cB)
          = (λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫ (𝟙_ LightCondAb ◁ cB) ≫ p ▷ B := by
              rw [MonoidalCategory.whisker_exchange p cB]
      _ = cB ≫ (λ_ B).inv ≫ p ▷ B := by
              rw [← MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor_inv_naturality_assoc cB]
  have hcompat := freeTensorPresheafPoint_sheafify_comp X B x
  dsimp only at hcompat
  change CategoryTheory.toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) G ≫
      (((λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫ p ▷ L.obj G ≫
        (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).hom).hom) =
    freeTensorPresheafPoint X B x ≫
      CategoryTheory.toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (F ⊗ G) at hcompat
  have hpresheaf :
      freeTensorPresheafPoint X B x ≫ freeTensorHomPresheafComposite X B C g =
        ((λ_ B).inv ≫ p ▷ B ≫ g).hom := by
    dsimp [freeTensorHomPresheafComposite]
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    rw [← hcompat]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    have hμ : ((λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫ p ▷ L.obj G ≫
        (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).hom ≫
        (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).inv ≫ (L.obj F ◁ cB) ≫ g) =
        ((λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫ p ▷ L.obj G ≫ (L.obj F ◁ cB) ≫ g) := by
      simp [Category.assoc]
    change CategoryTheory.toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) G ≫
        (((λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫ p ▷ L.obj G ≫
          (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).hom ≫
          (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F G).inv ≫ (L.obj F ◁ cB) ≫ g).hom) =
      ((λ_ B).inv ≫ p ▷ B ≫ g).hom
    rw [hμ]
    have hmove_g :
        (λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫ p ▷ L.obj G ≫ (L.obj F ◁ cB) ≫ g =
          cB ≫ (λ_ B).inv ≫ p ▷ B ≫ g := by
      simpa [Category.assoc] using congrArg (fun q => q ≫ g) hmove
    calc
      CategoryTheory.toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) G ≫
          (((λ_ (L.obj G)).inv ≫ p ▷ L.obj G ≫ (L.obj F ◁ cB) ≫ g).hom)
          = CategoryTheory.toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) G ≫
              ((cB ≫ (λ_ B).inv ≫ p ▷ B ≫ g).hom) := by
              exact congrArg (fun q => CategoryTheory.toSheafify
                (coherentTopology LightProfinite) G ≫ q.hom) hmove_g
      _ = ((λ_ B).inv ≫ p ▷ B ≫ g).hom := by
              change CategoryTheory.toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) G ≫ cB.hom ≫
                  (((λ_ B).inv ≫ p ▷ B ≫ g).hom) =
                ((λ_ B).inv ≫ p ▷ B ≫ g).hom
              dsimp [cB]
              rw [CategoryTheory.sheafificationAdjunction_counit_app_val]
              rw [← Category.assoc]
              rw [CategoryTheory.toSheafify_sheafifyLift]
              rw [Category.id_comp]
  dsimp [freeTensorHomEval]
  have happ := congrArg (fun η => η.app ⟨S⟩ m) hpresheaf
  let fS : X.toCondensed.obj.obj ⟨S⟩ := toPointMap S ≫ x
  change (freeTensorHomPresheafComposite X B C g).app ⟨S⟩
      (((TensorProduct.mk ℤ ((X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ).obj ⟨S⟩)
        (B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩)) (Finsupp.single fS (1 : ℤ))) m) = _
  exact happ

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorHomEval_naturality_one
statement:
lemma freeTensorHomEval_naturality_one (X : LightProfinite.{0}) (B C : LightCondAb)
    (g : ((free ℤ).obj X.toCondensed) ⊗ B ⟶ C)
    {S T : LightProfinite.{0}} (u : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ X)
    (m : B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :
    C.obj.map u.op (freeTensorHomEval X B C g S f 1 m) =
      freeTensorHomEval X B C g T (u ≫ f) 1 (B.obj.map u.op m)
proof:
:= by
  let η := freeTensorHomPresheafComposite X B C g
  let fS : X.toCondensed.obj.obj ⟨S⟩ := f
  let fT : X.toCondensed.obj.obj ⟨T⟩ := u ≫ f
  have hn := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (η.naturality u.op)
      ((Finsupp.single fS (1 : ℤ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)
  dsimp [freeTensorHomEval]
  calc
    C.obj.map u.op (η.app ⟨S⟩ ((Finsupp.single fS (1 : ℤ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m))
        = η.app ⟨T⟩
            ((((ModuleCat.free ℤ).map (X.toCondensed.obj.map u.op)) ⊗ₘ B.obj.map u.op)
              ((Finsupp.single fS (1 : ℤ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) := by
            exact hn.symm
    _ = η.app ⟨T⟩ ((Finsupp.single fT (1 : ℤ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (B.obj.map u.op m)) := by
            change η.app ⟨T⟩
              (((Finsupp.lmapDomain ℤ ℤ (X.toCondensed.obj.map u.op))
                  (Finsupp.single fS (1 : ℤ))) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (B.obj.map u.op m)) =
                η.app ⟨T⟩ ((Finsupp.single fT (1 : ℤ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (B.obj.map u.op m))
            rw [Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply]
            rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
            rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorHomEval_zsmul
statement:
lemma freeTensorHomEval_zsmul (X : LightProfinite.{0}) (B C : LightCondAb)
    (g : ((free ℤ).obj X.toCondensed) ⊗ B ⟶ C)
    (S : LightProfinite.{0}) (f : S ⟶ X) (r : ℤ) (m : B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :
    freeTensorHomEval X B C g S f r m =
      r • freeTensorHomEval X B C g S f 1 m
proof:
:= by
  let η := freeTensorHomPresheafComposite X B C g
  let fS : X.toCondensed.obj.obj ⟨S⟩ := f
  dsimp [freeTensorHomEval]
  change η.app ⟨S⟩ ((Finsupp.single fS r) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) =
    r • η.app ⟨S⟩ ((Finsupp.single fS (1 : ℤ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)
  have hsingle :
      (Finsupp.single fS r : (X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ).obj ⟨S⟩) =
      r • (Finsupp.single fS (1 : ℤ) :
        (X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ).obj ⟨S⟩) := by
    ext y
    by_cases hy : y = fS <;> simp [hy]
  rw [hsingle]
  change η.app ⟨S⟩
      (((r • (Finsupp.single fS (1 : ℤ) :
        (X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ).obj ⟨S⟩)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) =
    r • η.app ⟨S⟩ ((Finsupp.single fS (1 : ℤ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)
  rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
  change (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (η.app ⟨S⟩))
      (r • ((Finsupp.single fS (1 : ℤ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) =
    r • η.app ⟨S⟩ ((Finsupp.single fS (1 : ℤ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)
  rw [LinearMap.map_smul]
  simpa [RingHom.id_apply] using
    (Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul (R := ℤ) r
      (η.app ⟨S⟩ ((Finsupp.single fS (1 : ℤ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)))

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pTailTruncFun_finite_finite
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pTailTruncFun_finite_finite (n k : ℕ) :

      if n ≤ k then (k : ℕ∪{∞}) else ∞
