name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pTailTruncFun_preimage_finite
statement:
lemma pTailTruncFun_preimage_finite (k : ℕ) :
    pTailTruncFun ⁻¹' ({(k : ℕ∪{∞})} : Set (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) =
      Set.prod ({a : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) |
        ∃ n : ℕ, n ≤ k ∧ a = (n : ℕ∪{∞})})
        ({(k : ℕ∪{∞})} : Set (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite))
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  rcases p with ⟨a, b⟩
  constructor
  · intro hp
    cases a using OnePoint.rec with
    | infty =>
        change (∞ : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) = (k : ℕ∪{∞}) at hp
        cases hp
    | coe n =>
        cases b using OnePoint.rec with
        | infty =>
            change (∞ : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) = (k : ℕ∪{∞}) at hp
            cases hp
        | coe l =>
            change (if n ≤ l then (l : ℕ∪{∞}) else ∞) = (k : ℕ∪{∞}) at hp
            by_cases hnl : n ≤ l
            · simp [hnl] at hp
              have hlk : l = k := by simpa using hp
              subst l
              exact ⟨⟨n, hnl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
            · simp [hnl] at hp
  · intro hp
    rcases hp with ⟨ha, hb⟩
    rcases ha with ⟨n, hnle, rfl⟩
    simp at hb
    subst hb
    change (if n ≤ k then (k : ℕ∪{∞}) else ∞) = (k : ℕ∪{∞})
    simp [hnle]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pTailTruncFun_fiber_finite
statement:
lemma pTailTruncFun_fiber_finite (k : ℕ) :
    (pTailTruncFun ⁻¹' ({(k : ℕ∪{∞})} : Set (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite))).Finite
proof:
:= by
  rw [pTailTruncFun_preimage_finite k]
  have hleft : ({a : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) |
      ∃ n : ℕ, n ≤ k ∧ a = (n : ℕ∪{∞})}).Finite := by
    let s : Set ℕ := {n : ℕ | n ≤ k}
    have hs : s.Finite := Set.finite_le_nat k
    have himg : ((fun n : ℕ => (n : ℕ∪{∞})) '' s).Finite := hs.image _
    refine himg.subset ?_
    intro a ha
    rcases ha with ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
  have hright : ({(k : ℕ∪{∞})} : Set (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).Finite :=
    Set.finite_singleton _
  exact hleft.prod hright

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pTailTruncFun_fiber_open
statement:
lemma pTailTruncFun_fiber_open (k : ℕ) :
    IsOpen (pTailTruncFun ⁻¹' ({(k : ℕ∪{∞})} : Set (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pTailTruncFun_preimage_finite k]
  apply IsOpen.prod
  · have hleft : {a : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) |
        ∃ n : ℕ, n ≤ k ∧ a = (n : ℕ∪{∞})} =
        ⋃ n : {n : ℕ // n ≤ k}, ({(n.1 : ℕ∪{∞})} : Set (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) := by
      ext a
      constructor
      · intro ha
        rcases ha with ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨n, hn⟩, rfl⟩
      · intro ha
        rcases Set.mem_iUnion.1 ha with ⟨n, hnmem⟩
        exact ⟨n.1, n.2, by simpa using hnmem⟩
    rw [hleft]
    apply isOpen_iUnion
    intro n
    simpa using finite_nat_singleton_open n.1
  · simpa using finite_nat_singleton_open k

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pTailTruncFun_continuous
statement: lemma pTailTruncFun_continuous : Continuous pTailTruncFun
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_def]
  intro U hU
  by_cases hinfty : (∞ : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) ∈ U
  · have hcompact : IsCompact (OnePoint.some ⁻¹' U)ᶜ :=
      ((OnePoint.isOpen_iff_of_mem' hinfty).1 hU).1
    have hfinNat : ((OnePoint.some ⁻¹' U)ᶜ : Set ℕ).Finite := by
      simpa using (isCompact_iff_finite.mp hcompact)
    have hpre_subset : pTailTruncFun ⁻¹' Uᶜ ⊆
        ⋃ k : {k : ℕ // k ∈ (OnePoint.some ⁻¹' U)ᶜ},
          pTailTruncFun ⁻¹' ({(k.1 : ℕ∪{∞})} : Set (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) := by
      intro p hp
      have hout_ne : pTailTruncFun p ≠ (∞ : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) := by
        intro h
        exact hp (by simpa [h] using hinfty)
      cases hval : pTailTruncFun p using OnePoint.rec with
      | infty => exact False.elim (hout_ne hval)
      | coe k =>
          have hk : k ∈ (OnePoint.some ⁻¹' U)ᶜ := by
            change (k : ℕ∪{∞}) ∉ U
            intro hkU
            exact hp (by simpa [hval] using hkU)
          exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨k, hk⟩, by simp [hval]⟩
    have hfinite_pre : (pTailTruncFun ⁻¹' Uᶜ).Finite := by
      letI : Fintype {k : ℕ // k ∈ (OnePoint.some ⁻¹' U)ᶜ} := hfinNat.fintype
      exact (Set.finite_iUnion (fun k : {k : ℕ // k ∈ (OnePoint.some ⁻¹' U)ᶜ} =>
        pTailTruncFun_fiber_finite k.1)).subset hpre_subset
    have hclosed : IsClosed (pTailTruncFun ⁻¹' Uᶜ) := hfinite_pre.isClosed
    simpa [Set.preimage_compl] using hclosed.isOpen_compl
  · have hpre_eq : pTailTruncFun ⁻¹' U =
        ⋃ k : {k : ℕ // (k : ℕ∪{∞}) ∈ U},
          pTailTruncFun ⁻¹' ({(k.1 : ℕ∪{∞})} : Set (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) := by
      ext p
      constructor
      · intro hp
        cases hval : pTailTruncFun p using OnePoint.rec with
        | infty => exact False.elim (hinfty (by simpa [hval] using hp))
        | coe k =>
            exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨k, by simpa [hval] using hp⟩, by simp [hval]⟩
      · intro hp
        rcases Set.mem_iUnion.1 hp with ⟨k, hk⟩
        have hout : pTailTruncFun p = (k.1 : ℕ∪{∞}) := by simpa using hk
        change pTailTruncFun p ∈ U
        rw [hout]
        exact k.2
    rw [hpre_eq]
    apply isOpen_iUnion
    intro k
    exact pTailTruncFun_fiber_open k.1

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.free_constInfty_comp_P_proj
statement:
lemma free_constInfty_comp_P_proj (T : LightProfinite) :
    (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (toPointMap T ≫ ι)) ≫ P_proj ℤ = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map (toPointMap T ≫ ι) ≫ P_proj ℤ = 0
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  change ((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map (toPointMap T) ≫ P_map ℤ) ≫
    P_proj ℤ = 0
  have hzero : P_map ℤ ≫ P_proj ℤ = 0 := by
    change P_map ℤ ≫ cokernel.π (P_map ℤ) = 0
    exact cokernel.condition (P_map ℤ)
  calc
    ((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map (toPointMap T) ≫ P_map ℤ) ≫ P_proj ℤ
        = (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map (toPointMap T) ≫
            (P_map ℤ ≫ P_proj ℤ) := by
          rw [Category.assoc]
    _ = (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map (toPointMap T) ≫ 0 := by
          exact congrArg
            (fun q => (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map (toPointMap T) ≫ q) hzero
    _ = 0 := by simp

    (S : LightProfinite.{0}) (f : S ⟶ X) (r : ℤ) (m : B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorIsoInt_hom_naturality_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma freeTensorIsoInt_hom_naturality_right {A S' S : LightProfinite} (φ : S' ⟶ S) :
    (((free ℤ).obj A.toCondensed) ◁ (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map φ)) ≫
        (IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt A S).hom =
      (IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt A S').hom ≫
        (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (𝟙 A ⊗ₘ φ))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.Monoidal.μIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_right_assoc (free ℤ)
    A.toCondensed (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map φ)
    ((free ℤ).map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ lightProfiniteToLightCondSet A S))]
  slice_lhs 2 4 => rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  slice_rhs 2 4 => rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_right lightProfiniteToLightCondSet]
  simp [MonoidalCategory.id_tensorHom]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pTailFreeFree_kills_right
statement:
lemma pTailFreeFree_kills_right :
    (((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ◁ P_map ℤ) ≫ pTailFreeFree = 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [pTailFreeFree, pTailFreeFreeLift, P_map]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [freeTensorIsoInt_hom_naturality_right_assoc (φ := ι)]
  slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [MonoidalCategory.id_tensorHom]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [pTailTruncMap_right_infty]
  rw [free_constInfty_comp_P_proj]
  simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pTailFreeFree_kills_left
statement:
lemma pTailFreeFree_kills_left :
    (P_map ℤ ▷ ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed)) ≫ pTailFreeFree = 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [pTailFreeFree, pTailFreeFreeLift, P_map]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pTensorDescRight_comp_proj

@[reassoc]
lemma pTensorDescRight_comp_proj (M N : LightCondAb)

    (hf : (M ◁ P_map ℤ) ≫ f = 0) :
    (M ◁ P_proj ℤ) ≫ pTensorDescRight M N f hf = f
proof:
:= by

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pTailNumerator_kills
statement:
lemma pTailNumerator_kills :
    (P_map ℤ ▷ P ℤ) ≫ pTailNumerator = 0
proof:
:= by
  let freePointObj : LightCondAb := (free ℤ).obj (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}).toCondensed
  let freeNinfObj : LightCondAb := (free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed
  let e : freePointObj ⊗ freeNinfObj ⟶ freePointObj ⊗ P ℤ :=
    (β_ freePointObj freeNinfObj).hom ≫ (P_proj ℤ ▷ freePointObj) ≫
      (β_ (P ℤ) freePointObj).hom
  have he : e = freePointObj ◁ (P_proj ℤ) := by
    apply (cancel_mono (β_ freePointObj (P ℤ)).hom).1
    dsimp [e, freeNinfObj]
    rw [Category.assoc]
    rw [BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_right]
    simp
  haveI : Epi (P_proj ℤ ▷ freePointObj) := epi_P_proj_tensor freePointObj
  haveI : Epi e := by dsimp [e]; infer_instance
  haveI : Epi (freePointObj ◁ (P_proj ℤ)) := by
    rw [← he]
    infer_instance
  apply (cancel_epi (freePointObj ◁ (P_proj ℤ))).1
  calc
    (freePointObj ◁ (P_proj ℤ)) ≫ ((P_map ℤ ▷ P ℤ) ≫ pTailNumerator)
        = (P_map ℤ ▷ freeNinfObj) ≫ ((freeNinfObj ◁ P_proj ℤ) ≫ pTailNumerator) := by
          dsimp [freeNinfObj]
          rw [← Category.assoc]
          rw [whisker_exchange]
          simp [Category.assoc]
    _ = (P_map ℤ ▷ freeNinfObj) ≫ pTailFreeFree := by
          dsimp [pTailNumerator, freeNinfObj]
          rw [pTensorDescRight_comp_proj]
    _ = 0 := by
          rw [pTailFreeFree_kills_left]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pTailProjection_zero
statement: lemma pTailProjection_zero : pTailProjection 0 = 𝟙 (P ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Epi (P_proj ℤ) := by
    change Epi (cokernel.π (P_map ℤ))
    infer_instance
  apply (cancel_epi (P_proj ℤ)).1
  rw [P_proj_comp_pTailProjection]
  dsimp [pTailProjectionNumerator, pTailProjectionPointMap]
  have hmap : finiteTensorPoint (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) 0 ≫ pTailTruncMap =
      𝟙 (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) := by
    ext a
    change pTailTruncMap (((0 : ℕ) : ℕ∪{∞}), a) = a
    rw [pTailTruncMap_apply]
    cases a using OnePoint.rec with
    | infty => rfl
    | coe k =>
        change (if 0 ≤ k then (k : ℕ∪{∞}) else ∞) = (k : ℕ∪{∞})
        simp
  rw [hmap]
  simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pTailFreeFree_slice

      pTailProjectionNumerator n
proof:

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pTailNumerator_slice
statement:
lemma pTailNumerator_slice (n : ℕ) :
    numeratorSlice (P ℤ) (P ℤ) n pTailNumerator = pTailProjection n
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Epi (P_proj ℤ) := by
    change Epi (cokernel.π (P_map ℤ))
    infer_instance
  apply (cancel_epi (P_proj ℤ)).1
  rw [P_proj_comp_pTailProjection]
  dsimp [numeratorSlice]
  calc
    P_proj ℤ ≫ (λ_ (P ℤ)).inv ≫ freeNatBasis n ▷ P ℤ ≫ pTailNumerator
        = (λ_ ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed)).inv ≫
            freeNatBasis n ▷ ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ≫
              (((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ◁ P_proj ℤ) ≫ pTailNumerator := by
          rw [leftUnitor_inv_naturality_assoc]
          rw [whisker_exchange_assoc]
    _ = (λ_ ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed)).inv ≫
          freeNatBasis n ▷ ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ≫ pTailFreeFree := by
          dsimp [pTailNumerator]
          rw [pTensorDescRight_comp_proj]
    _ = pTailProjectionNumerator n := pTailFreeFree_slice n

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceFreeSection_naturality
statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceFreeSection_naturality {S T : LightProfinite}
    (g : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) (x : BoundedIntSeqSection S) :
    ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed).obj.map g.op (boundedDifferenceFreeSection f x) =
      boundedDifferenceFreeSection (g ≫ f) (boundedIntSeqSectionComap g x)
proof:

          (boundedDifferenceFreeFamilyLinear S f m) =

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceFreeNumerator_slice
statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceFreeNumerator_slice (n : ℕ) :
    numeratorSlice boundedIntSequences ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) n
      boundedDifferenceFreeNumerator =
      freeTensorFamilyMap (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences
        ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed)
        boundedDifferenceFreeFamilyLinear boundedDifferenceFreeFamilyLinear_naturality'
        (natPoint n)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [numeratorSlice, freeNatBasis, boundedDifferenceFreeNumerator]
  rw [freeTensorDescLin_point]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceFreeFamilyMap_infty
statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceFreeFamilyMap_infty :
    freeTensorFamilyMap (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences
      ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed)
      boundedDifferenceFreeFamilyLinear boundedDifferenceFreeFamilyLinear_naturality' ι =
    0
proof:
:= by
  ext S x
  change boundedDifferenceFreeFamilyLinear S.unop (toPointMap S.unop ≫ ι) x =
    (0 : boundedIntSequences ⟶ (free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed).hom.app S x
  dsimp [boundedDifferenceFreeFamilyLinear, boundedDifferenceFreeSection]
  have htop : boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection (toPointMap S.unop ≫ ι)
      (show BoundedIntSeqSection S.unop from x) = 0 := by
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro s
    change boundedDifferenceMeasure (toPointMap S.unop ≫ ι)
        (show BoundedIntSeqSection S.unop from x) s = 0
    dsimp [boundedDifferenceMeasure, boundedDifferenceCoeff]
    have hf : (ConcreteCategory.hom (toPointMap S.unop ≫ ι)) s =
        (∞ : ℕ∪{∞}) := rfl
    rw [hf]
    rw [topologicalFreeDiracDiff_self]
    change (0 : ℤ) • (0 : LightCondAb.topologicalFree (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) = 0
    exact zero_smul ℤ (0 : LightCondAb.topologicalFree (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite))
  rw [htop]
  simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceFreeNumerator_infty

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceFreeNumerator_comp_P_proj
statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceFreeNumerator_comp_P_proj :
    boundedDifferenceFreeNumerator ≫ P_proj ℤ = boundedDifferenceNumerator
proof:
:= by
  apply freeTensorHom_ext
  intro S f r m
  rw [freeTensorHomEval_comp]
  dsimp [boundedDifferenceFreeNumerator, boundedDifferenceNumerator]
  rw [freeTensorHomEval_desc]
  rw [freeTensorHomEval_desc]
  dsimp [boundedDifferenceFreeFamilyLinear, boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear,
    boundedDifferenceFreeSection, boundedDifferencePSection]
  change (P_proj ℤ).hom.app ⟨S⟩
      (r • ((LightCondAb.freeTopologicalFreeIso (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).inv.hom.app ⟨S⟩
        (boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection f (show BoundedIntSeqSection S from m)))) =
    r • (P_proj ℤ).hom.app ⟨S⟩
      ((LightCondAb.freeTopologicalFreeIso (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).inv.hom.app ⟨S⟩
        (boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection f (show BoundedIntSeqSection S from m)))
  exact map_zsmul ((P_proj ℤ).hom.app ⟨S⟩).hom r _

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.basisMapNumerator_comp_boundedDifferenceFreeFamilyMap_natPoint
statement:
lemma basisMapNumerator_comp_boundedDifferenceFreeFamilyMap_natPoint (n : ℕ) :
    basisMapNumerator ≫
      freeTensorFamilyMap (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences
        ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed)
        boundedDifferenceFreeFamilyLinear boundedDifferenceFreeFamilyLinear_naturality'
        (natPoint n) =
      (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (pTailProjectionPointMap n)) -
        (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (pTailProjectionPointMap (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  apply (freeHomEquivPoints (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)
    ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed)).injective
  apply LightCondAb.freeSection_map_eq_of_pointwise_measure_eq
    (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)
  intro t
  rw [freeHomEquivPoints_comp]
  rw [freeHomEquivPoints_sub]
  dsimp [freeTensorFamilyMap, boundedDifferenceFreeFamilyLinear, basisMapNumerator]
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  dsimp [boundedDifferenceFreeSection]
  change (show C(↑(ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite).toTop,
      ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).toModuleCat) from
      (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).hom.app
        ⟨(ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)⟩
        ((LightCondAb.freeTopologicalFreeIso (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).symm.hom.hom.app
          ⟨(ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)⟩
          (boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection (toPointMap (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ≫ natPoint n)
            ((boundedIntSequencesSectionsEquiv (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).symm
              boundedStandardBasisSection)))) t = _
  rw [LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree_app_section_of_iso_symm]
  rw [map_sub]
  change (show C(↑(ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite).toTop,
        ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).toModuleCat) from
        boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection (toPointMap (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ≫ natPoint n)
          ((boundedIntSequencesSectionsEquiv (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).symm
            boundedStandardBasisSection)) t =
      (show C(↑(ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite).toTop,
        ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).toModuleCat) from
        (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).hom.app
          ⟨(ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)⟩
          (freeHomEquivPoints (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed)
            ((free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (pTailProjectionPointMap n))))) t -
      (show C(↑(ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite).toTop,
        ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).toModuleCat) from
        (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).hom.app
          ⟨(ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)⟩
          (freeHomEquivPoints (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed)
            ((free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (pTailProjectionPointMap (n + 1)))))) t
  rw [freeMap_topologicalFree_apply, freeMap_topologicalFree_apply]
  change boundedDifferenceMeasure (toPointMap (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ≫ natPoint n)
      boundedStandardBasisSection t =
    Finsupp.single ((ConcreteCategory.hom (pTailProjectionPointMap n)) t) 1 -
      Finsupp.single ((ConcreteCategory.hom (pTailProjectionPointMap (n + 1))) t) 1
  cases t using OnePoint.rec with
  | infty =>
      change boundedDifferenceMeasure (toPointMap (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ≫ natPoint n)
          boundedStandardBasisSection (∞ : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) =
        Finsupp.single (pTailTruncFun (((n : ℕ) : ℕ∪{∞}), (∞ : ℕ∪{∞}))) 1 -
          Finsupp.single (pTailTruncFun ((((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∪{∞})), (∞ : ℕ∪{∞}))) 1
      simp [boundedDifferenceMeasure, boundedDifferenceCoeff, boundedStandardBasisSection,
        boundedStandardBasisCoord, topologicalFreeDiracDiff, toPointMap, natPoint, pTailTruncFun]
  | coe k =>
      change boundedDifferenceMeasure (toPointMap (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ≫ natPoint n)
          boundedStandardBasisSection (k : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) =
        Finsupp.single (pTailTruncFun (((n : ℕ) : ℕ∪{∞}), ((k : ℕ) : ℕ∪{∞}))) 1 -
          Finsupp.single (pTailTruncFun ((((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∪{∞})), ((k : ℕ) : ℕ∪{∞}))) 1
      by_cases hnk : n = k
      · subst k
        simp [boundedDifferenceMeasure, boundedDifferenceCoeff, boundedStandardBasisSection,
          boundedStandardBasisCoord, topologicalFreeDiracDiff, toPointMap, natPoint, pTailTruncFun]
      · have hkn : k ≠ n := fun hk => hnk hk.symm
        by_cases hlt : n < k
        · have hnle : n ≤ k := Nat.le_of_lt hlt
          have hsucc : n + 1 ≤ k := by omega
          simp [boundedDifferenceMeasure, boundedDifferenceCoeff, boundedStandardBasisSection,
            boundedStandardBasisCoord, topologicalFreeDiracDiff, toPointMap, natPoint, pTailTruncFun,
            hkn, hnle, hsucc]
        · have hnle : ¬ n ≤ k := by omega
          have hsucc : ¬ n + 1 ≤ k := by omega
          simp [boundedDifferenceMeasure, boundedDifferenceCoeff, boundedStandardBasisSection,
            boundedStandardBasisCoord, topologicalFreeDiracDiff, toPointMap, natPoint, pTailTruncFun,
            hkn, hnle, hsucc]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceFreeNumerator_basisMapNumerator
statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceFreeNumerator_basisMapNumerator :
    (((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ◁ basisMapNumerator) ≫
        boundedDifferenceFreeNumerator =
      (oneMinusShift' ℤ ▷ ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed)) ≫ pTailFreeFreeLift
proof:
:= by
  apply freeTarget_numerator_ext_of_slices (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)
  · intro n
    rw [numeratorSlice_whiskerRight]
    rw [boundedDifferenceFreeNumerator_slice]
    rw [basisMapNumerator_comp_boundedDifferenceFreeFamilyMap_natPoint n]
    rw [numeratorSlice_oneMinusShift']
    rw [pTailFreeFreeLift_slice]
    rw [pTailFreeFreeLift_slice]
  · rw [inftySlice_whiskerRight]
    rw [boundedDifferenceFreeNumerator_infty]
    rw [inftySlice_oneMinusShift']
    simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.epi_tensor_P_proj
statement: lemma epi_tensor_P_proj (M : LightCondAb) : Epi (M ◁ P_proj ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let freeNinfObj : LightCondAb := (free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed
  let e : M ⊗ freeNinfObj ⟶ M ⊗ P ℤ :=
    (β_ M freeNinfObj).hom ≫ (P_proj ℤ ▷ M) ≫ (β_ (P ℤ) M).hom
  have he : e = M ◁ (P_proj ℤ) := by
    apply (cancel_mono (β_ M (P ℤ)).hom).1
    dsimp [e, freeNinfObj]
    rw [Category.assoc]
    rw [BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_right]
    simp
  haveI : Epi (P_proj ℤ ▷ M) := epi_P_proj_tensor M
  haveI : Epi e := by dsimp [e]; infer_instance
  rw [← he]
  infer_instance

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeFreeBasisMap_square
statement:
lemma freeFreeBasisMap_square :
    (((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ◁ P_proj ℤ) ≫
      (P_proj ℤ ▷ P ℤ) ≫ (P ℤ ◁ basisMap) =
    (((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ◁ basisMapNumerator) ≫
      (P_proj ℤ ▷ boundedIntSequences)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [whisker_exchange]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [← whiskerLeft_comp]
  rw [P_proj_comp_basisMap]
  rw [whisker_exchange]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pDifferenceMap_freeFree_lift
statement:
lemma pDifferenceMap_freeFree_lift :
    (((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ◁ P_proj ℤ) ≫
      (P_proj ℤ ▷ P ℤ) ≫ pDifferenceMap =
    (oneMinusShift' ℤ ▷ ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed)) ≫
      pTailFreeFreeLift ≫ P_proj ℤ
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [pDifferenceMap, pTailMap]
  slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [P_proj_tensor_oneMinusShift]
  slice_lhs 1 2 => rw [whisker_exchange]
  slice_lhs 3 4 => rw [pTensorDesc_comp_proj]
  dsimp [pTailNumerator]
  slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [pTensorDescRight_comp_proj]
  dsimp [pTailFreeFree]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pDifferenceMap_compat
statement:
lemma pDifferenceMap_compat :
    (P ℤ ◁ basisMap) ≫ boundedDifferenceMap = pDifferenceMap
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Epi (P_proj ℤ ▷ P ℤ) := epi_P_proj_tensor (P ℤ)
  apply (cancel_epi (P_proj ℤ ▷ P ℤ)).1
  haveI : Epi (((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ◁ P_proj ℤ) :=
    epi_tensor_P_proj ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed)
  apply (cancel_epi (((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ◁ P_proj ℤ)).1
  dsimp [boundedDifferenceMap]
  calc
    (((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ◁ P_proj ℤ) ≫
        ((P_proj ℤ ▷ P ℤ) ≫ ((P ℤ ◁ basisMap) ≫
          pTensorDesc boundedIntSequences (P ℤ) boundedDifferenceNumerator boundedDifferenceNumerator_kills))
        = ((((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ◁ basisMapNumerator) ≫
            (P_proj ℤ ▷ boundedIntSequences)) ≫
              pTensorDesc boundedIntSequences (P ℤ) boundedDifferenceNumerator boundedDifferenceNumerator_kills := by
          rw [← freeFreeBasisMap_square]
          simp [Category.assoc]
    _ = (((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ◁ basisMapNumerator) ≫
            boundedDifferenceNumerator := by
          rw [Category.assoc]
          rw [pTensorDesc_comp_proj]
    _ = (((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ◁ basisMapNumerator) ≫
            boundedDifferenceFreeNumerator ≫ P_proj ℤ := by
          rw [boundedDifferenceFreeNumerator_comp_P_proj]
    _ = (oneMinusShift' ℤ ▷ ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed)) ≫
            pTailFreeFreeLift ≫ P_proj ℤ := by
          simpa [Category.assoc] using
            congrArg (fun q => q ≫ P_proj ℤ) boundedDifferenceFreeNumerator_basisMapNumerator
    _ = (((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ◁ P_proj ℤ) ≫
        ((P_proj ℤ ▷ P ℤ) ≫ pDifferenceMap) := by
          simpa [Category.assoc] using pDifferenceMap_freeFree_lift.symm

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.basisMap_boundedTailSection
statement:
lemma basisMap_boundedTailSection :
    basisMap ≫ boundedTailSection = pTailSection ≫ (P ℤ ◁ basisMap)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [boundedTailSection, pTailSection]
  rw [leftUnitor_inv_naturality_assoc]
  slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [whisker_exchange]
  simp [Category.assoc]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.solidification_whiskerRight_basisMap_inv_comm
statement:
lemma solidification_whiskerRight_basisMap_inv_comm :
    solidification.map (P ℤ ◁ basisMap) ≫
        inv (solidification.map ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ boundedIntSequences)) =
      inv (solidification.map ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ P ℤ)) ≫
        solidification.map (P ℤ ◁ basisMap)
proof:
:= by
  let σP : P ℤ ⊗ P ℤ ⟶ P ℤ ⊗ P ℤ := (oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ P ℤ
  let σB : P ℤ ⊗ boundedIntSequences ⟶ P ℤ ⊗ boundedIntSequences :=
    (oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ boundedIntSequences
  let w : P ℤ ⊗ P ℤ ⟶ P ℤ ⊗ boundedIntSequences := P ℤ ◁ basisMap
  have hcomm : σP ≫ w = w ≫ σB := by
    dsimp [σP, σB, w]
    rw [whisker_exchange]
  have hL : solidification.map σP ≫ solidification.map w =
      solidification.map w ≫ solidification.map σB := by
    simpa [Functor.map_comp] using congrArg (fun f => solidification.map f) hcomm
  haveI : IsIso (solidification.map σP) := solidification_map_oneMinusShift_tensor_isIso (P ℤ)
  haveI : IsIso (solidification.map σB) :=
    solidification_map_oneMinusShift_tensor_isIso boundedIntSequences
  change solidification.map w ≫ inv (solidification.map σB) =
      inv (solidification.map σP) ≫ solidification.map w
  calc
    solidification.map w ≫ inv (solidification.map σB)
        = inv (solidification.map σP) ≫
            (solidification.map σP ≫ solidification.map w) ≫
              inv (solidification.map σB) := by simp [Category.assoc]
    _ = inv (solidification.map σP) ≫
            (solidification.map w ≫ solidification.map σB) ≫
              inv (solidification.map σB) := by rw [hL]
    _ = inv (solidification.map σP) ≫ solidification.map w := by simp [Category.assoc]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedShiftRetract_idempotent_eq_identity_of_pDifferenceMap_compat
statement:
lemma boundedShiftRetract_idempotent_eq_identity_of_pDifferenceMap_compat
    (hcompat : (P ℤ ◁ basisMap) ≫ boundedDifferenceMap = pDifferenceMap) :
    solidification.map basisMap ≫ (boundedShiftRetractData.retract).i =
      𝟙 (solidification.obj (P ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  change solidification.map basisMap ≫
      (solidification.map boundedTailSection ≫
        inv (solidification.map ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ boundedIntSequences)) ≫
          solidification.map boundedDifferenceMap) = 𝟙 (solidification.obj (P ℤ))
  calc
    solidification.map basisMap ≫
        (solidification.map boundedTailSection ≫
          inv (solidification.map ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ boundedIntSequences)) ≫
            solidification.map boundedDifferenceMap)
        = solidification.map pTailSection ≫ solidification.map (P ℤ ◁ basisMap) ≫
          inv (solidification.map ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ boundedIntSequences)) ≫
            solidification.map boundedDifferenceMap := by
          rw [← Category.assoc]
          rw [← Functor.map_comp]
          rw [basisMap_boundedTailSection]
          simp [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    _ = solidification.map pTailSection ≫
          inv (solidification.map ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ P ℤ)) ≫
            solidification.map (P ℤ ◁ basisMap) ≫
              solidification.map boundedDifferenceMap := by
          slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [solidification_whiskerRight_basisMap_inv_comm]
          simp [Category.assoc]
    _ = solidification.map pTailSection ≫
          inv (solidification.map ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ P ℤ)) ≫
            solidification.map pDifferenceMap := by
          rw [← Functor.map_comp]
          rw [hcompat]
    _ = 𝟙 (solidification.obj (P ℤ)) := by
          dsimp [pDifferenceMap]
          rw [Functor.map_comp]
          calc
            solidification.map pTailSection ≫
                inv (solidification.map ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ P ℤ)) ≫
                  (solidification.map ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ P ℤ) ≫ solidification.map pTailMap)
                = solidification.map pTailSection ≫ solidification.map pTailMap := by simp
            _ = solidification.map (pTailSection ≫ pTailMap) := by rw [Functor.map_comp]
            _ = 𝟙 (solidification.obj (P ℤ)) := by simp [pTailSection_fac]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedShiftRetract_idempotent_eq_identity
statement:
lemma boundedShiftRetract_idempotent_eq_identity :
    solidification.map basisMap ≫ (boundedShiftRetractData.retract).i =
      𝟙 (solidification.obj (P ℤ))
proof:
:=
  boundedShiftRetract_idempotent_eq_identity_of_pDifferenceMap_compat pDifferenceMap_compat

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedShiftRetract_idempotent_eq_identity_of_solidified_basisMap_mono
statement:
lemma boundedShiftRetract_idempotent_eq_identity_of_solidified_basisMap_mono
    [Mono (solidification.map basisMap)] :
    solidification.map basisMap ≫ (boundedShiftRetractData.retract).i =
      𝟙 (solidification.obj (P ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (solidification.map basisMap)).1
  calc
    (solidification.map basisMap ≫ (boundedShiftRetractData.retract).i) ≫
        solidification.map basisMap
        = solidification.map basisMap ≫
            ((boundedShiftRetractData.retract).i ≫ solidification.map basisMap) := by
          exact Category.assoc (solidification.map basisMap) _ _
    _ = solidification.map basisMap ≫ 𝟙 (solidification.obj boundedIntSequences) := by
          change solidification.map basisMap ≫
            ((boundedShiftRetractData.retract).i ≫ (boundedShiftRetractData.retract).r) =
              solidification.map basisMap ≫ 𝟙 (solidification.obj boundedIntSequences)
          exact congrArg (fun q => solidification.map basisMap ≫ q)
            boundedShiftRetractData.retract.retract
    _ = 𝟙 (solidification.obj (P ℤ)) ≫ solidification.map basisMap := by
          simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.zdiscMapOfLocallyConstant_eq_freeToTopologicalFree_eval
statement:
lemma zdiscMapOfLocallyConstant_eq_freeToTopologicalFree_eval (T : LightProfinite)
    (f : LocallyConstant T ℤ) :
    zdiscMapOfLocallyConstant T f =
      LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T ≫ LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete T f
proof:
:= by
  apply (freeHomEquivPoints T Zdisc).injective
  apply (zdiscSectionsEquiv T).injective
  rw [freeHomEquivPoints_zdiscMapOfLocallyConstant]
  rw [freeHomEquivPoints_comp]
  have hfree : freeHomEquivPoints T (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed T)
      (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T) =
      (coherentTopology LightProfinite).yonedaEquiv (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeDiracSection T) := by
    simp [LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree, freeHomEquivPoints]
    rfl
  rw [hfree]
  simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change f = zdiscSectionsEquiv T
    ((LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete T f).hom.app ⟨T⟩
      ((coherentTopology LightProfinite).yonedaEquiv (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeDiracSection T)))
  have hz : zdiscSectionsEquiv T
      ((LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete T f).hom.app ⟨T⟩
        ((coherentTopology LightProfinite).yonedaEquiv (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeDiracSection T))) = f := by
    dsimp [zdiscSectionsEquiv]
    exact LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete_diracSection T f
  rw [hz]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.zdiscSectionsEquiv_topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete_apply
statement:
lemma zdiscSectionsEquiv_topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete_apply (T S : LightProfinite)
    (f : LocallyConstant T ℤ)
    (x : (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed T).obj.obj ⟨S⟩) (s : S) :
    zdiscSectionsEquiv S ((LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete T f).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x) s =
      (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEval T f).hom
        ((show C(↑S.toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from x) s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete T f =
    LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalCondensed T f ≫
      LightCondAb.discreteIntTopModuleCondensedIso.hom by rfl]
  change (show LocallyConstant S ℤ from
    ((LightCondMod.LocallyConstant.functorIsoDiscrete ℤ).inv.app (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).hom.app ⟨S⟩
      (LightCondAb.discreteIntTopModuleCondensedIso.hom.hom.app ⟨S⟩
        ((LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalCondensed T f).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x))) s = _
  rw [LightCondAb.discreteIntTopModuleCondensedIso_sections]
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.zdisc_hom_factors_freeProj
statement:
lemma zdisc_hom_factors_freeProj (T : LightProfinite)
    (φ : (free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed ⟶ Zdisc) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ ψ : (free ℤ).obj (T.component k).toCondensed ⟶ Zdisc,
      freeProj T k ≫ ψ = φ
proof:
:= by
  let f : LocallyConstant T ℤ := zdiscSectionsEquiv T (freeHomEquivPoints T Zdisc φ)
  obtain ⟨k, g, hg⟩ := LightProfinite.exists_locallyConstant_factor_proj T f
  let ψ : (free ℤ).obj (T.component k).toCondensed ⟶ Zdisc :=
    (freeHomEquivPoints (T.component k) Zdisc).symm
      ((zdiscSectionsEquiv (T.component k)).symm g)
  refine ⟨k, ψ, ?_⟩
  apply (freeHomEquivPoints T Zdisc).injective
  change freeHomEquivPoints T Zdisc
      (((free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (T.proj k))) ≫ ψ) =
    freeHomEquivPoints T Zdisc φ
  rw [freeHomEquivPoints_map]
  apply (zdiscSectionsEquiv T).injective
  rw [zdiscSectionsEquiv_map]
  dsimp [ψ, f] at hg ⊢
  rw [hg]
  simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.zdisc_hom_ext_of_points
statement:
lemma zdisc_hom_ext_of_points (T : LightProfinite)
    (f g : (free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed ⟶ Zdisc)
    (h : ∀ t : T, freePointMap T t ≫ f = freePointMap T t ≫ g) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply (freeHomEquivPoints T Zdisc).injective
  apply (zdiscSectionsEquiv T).injective
  ext t
  let pt : LightProfinite := LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}
  have hp := congrArg (freeHomEquivPoints pt Zdisc) (h t)
  dsimp [freePointMap] at hp
  rw [freeHomEquivPoints_map, freeHomEquivPoints_map] at hp
  have hz := congrArg (zdiscSectionsEquiv pt) hp
  rw [zdiscSectionsEquiv_map, zdiscSectionsEquiv_map] at hz
  exact congrFun (congrArg LocallyConstant.toFun hz) PUnit.unit

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.ninf_tail_open
statement:
lemma ninf_tail_open (N : ℕ) :
    IsOpen ({a : ℕ∪{∞} | a = ∞ ∨ ∃ n : ℕ, a = (n : ℕ∪{∞}) ∧ N ≤ n} :
      Set ℕ∪{∞})
proof:
:= by
  let A : Set (ℕ∪{∞}) := {a | a = ∞ ∨ ∃ n : ℕ, a = (n : ℕ∪{∞}) ∧ N ≤ n}
  have hinfty : (∞ : ℕ∪{∞}) ∈ A := by simp [A]
  have hpre : ((↑) : ℕ → ℕ∪{∞}) ⁻¹' A = {n : ℕ | N ≤ n} := by
    ext n
    simp [A]
  have hcompact : IsCompact (((↑) : ℕ → ℕ∪{∞}) ⁻¹' A)ᶜ := by
    rw [hpre]
    have hfin : Set.Finite ({n : ℕ | n < N}) := Set.finite_lt_nat N
    have hset : ({n : ℕ | N ≤ n} : Set ℕ)ᶜ = {n : ℕ | n < N} := by
      ext n
      simp [not_le]
    rw [hset]
    exact isCompact_iff_finite.mpr hfin
  have hopenpre : IsOpen (((↑) : ℕ → ℕ∪{∞}) ⁻¹' A) := by
    rw [hpre]
    exact isOpen_discrete _
  have hA : IsOpen A := (OnePoint.isOpen_iff_of_mem' hinfty).2 ⟨hcompact, hopenpre⟩
  simpa [A] using hA

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.continuous_ninfTensor_of_eventually_eq_zero
statement:
lemma continuous_ninfTensor_of_eventually_eq_zero
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] [Zero Y]
    (T : LightProfinite) (f : ℕ → C(↑T.toTop, Y))
    (hf : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, f n = 0) :
    Continuous (fun x : ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) =>
      match x.1 with
      | ∞ => (0 : Y)
      | OnePoint.some n => f n x.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro x
  rcases x with ⟨a, t⟩
  cases a using OnePoint.rec with
  | infty =>
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 hf
      let A : Set (ℕ∪{∞}) :=
        {a | a = ∞ ∨ ∃ n : ℕ, a = (n : ℕ∪{∞}) ∧ N ≤ n}
      have hmem : ((∞ : ℕ∪{∞}), t) ∈ Set.prod A Set.univ := by
        exact ⟨by simp [A], trivial⟩
      have hAopen : IsOpen A := by simpa [A] using ninf_tail_open N
      have hopen : IsOpen (Set.prod A (Set.univ : Set T)) := hAopen.prod isOpen_univ
      have h_event : (fun x : ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) =>
          match x.1 with
          | ∞ => (0 : Y)
          | OnePoint.some n => f n x.2) =ᶠ[nhds ((∞ : ℕ∪{∞}), t)] fun _ => (0 : Y) := by
        filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds hmem] with y hy
        rcases y with ⟨a', t'⟩
        rcases hy with ⟨ha', _⟩
        rcases ha' with h_inf | ⟨n, hn_eq, hn_le⟩
        · cases h_inf
          rfl
        · cases hn_eq
          change f n t' = 0
          rw [hN n hn_le]
          rfl
      exact continuousAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_event
  | coe n =>
      have hmem : ((n : ℕ∪{∞}), t) ∈
          Set.prod ({(n : ℕ∪{∞})} : Set ℕ∪{∞}) (Set.univ : Set T) := by
        exact ⟨rfl, trivial⟩
      have hopen : IsOpen (Set.prod ({(n : ℕ∪{∞})} : Set ℕ∪{∞}) (Set.univ : Set T)) := by
        exact (finite_nat_singleton_open n).prod isOpen_univ
      have h_event : (fun y : ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) =>
          match y.1 with
          | ∞ => (0 : Y)
          | OnePoint.some m => f m y.2) =ᶠ[nhds ((n : ℕ∪{∞}), t)] fun y => f n y.2 := by
        filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds hmem] with y hy
        rcases y with ⟨a', t'⟩
        have ha' : a' = (n : ℕ∪{∞}) := by simpa using hy.1
        cases ha'
        rfl
      exact (((f n).continuous.comp continuous_snd).continuousAt).congr h_event.symm

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.continuous_ninf_of_eventually_eq_zero
statement:
lemma continuous_ninf_of_eventually_eq_zero
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] [Zero Y]
    (f : ℕ → Y) (hf : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, f n = 0) :
    Continuous (fun x : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) =>
      match x with
      | ∞ => (0 : Y)
      | OnePoint.some n => f n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro a
  cases a using OnePoint.rec with
  | infty =>
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 hf
      let A : Set (ℕ∪{∞}) :=
        {a | a = ∞ ∨ ∃ n : ℕ, a = (n : ℕ∪{∞}) ∧ N ≤ n}
      have hmem : (∞ : ℕ∪{∞}) ∈ A := by simp [A]
      have hAopen : IsOpen A := by simpa [A] using ninf_tail_open N
      have h_event : (fun x : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) =>
          match x with
          | ∞ => (0 : Y)
          | OnePoint.some n => f n) =ᶠ[nhds (∞ : ℕ∪{∞})] fun _ => (0 : Y) := by
        filter_upwards [hAopen.mem_nhds hmem] with y hy
        rcases hy with h_inf | ⟨n, hn_eq, hn_le⟩
        · cases h_inf
          rfl
        · cases hn_eq
          exact hN n hn_le
      exact continuousAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_event
  | coe n =>
      have hmem : (n : ℕ∪{∞}) ∈ ({(n : ℕ∪{∞})} : Set ℕ∪{∞}) := rfl
      have hopen : IsOpen ({(n : ℕ∪{∞})} : Set ℕ∪{∞}) := finite_nat_singleton_open n
      have h_event : (fun x : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) =>
          match x with
          | ∞ => (0 : Y)
          | OnePoint.some m => f m) =ᶠ[nhds (n : ℕ∪{∞})] fun _ => f n := by
        filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds hmem] with y hy
        have hy' : y = (n : ℕ∪{∞}) := by simpa using hy
        cases hy'
        rfl
      exact continuousAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_event

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.exists_infiniteTailElement_direct
statement:
lemma exists_infiniteTailElement_direct (T : LightProfinite) :
    ∃ x : ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.obj
        ⟨((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite)⟩,
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        (freeHomEquivPoints T ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)).symm
          (((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.map (finiteTensorPoint T n).op x) =
            freeTailEndomorphism T n) ∧
      (freeHomEquivPoints T ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)).symm
        (((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.map (inftyTensorPoint T).op x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let X : LightProfinite := ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite)
  let s : (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed T).obj.obj ⟨X⟩ :=
    LightCondAb.topologicalFreeSectionOfBoundedFiniteProj T X (topologicalTailMeasure T) 2
      (topologicalTailMeasure_totalVariation_le_two T)
      (topologicalTailMeasure_finiteProj_continuous T)
  let x : ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.obj ⟨X⟩ :=
    (LightCondAb.freeTopologicalFreeIso T).symm.hom.hom.app ⟨X⟩ s
  refine ⟨x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n
    apply (freeHomEquivPoints T ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)).injective
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    apply LightCondAb.freeSection_map_eq_of_pointwise_measure_eq T T
    intro t
    rw [LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree_app_map_section_of_iso_symm]
    rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed_section_map_apply]
    rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeSectionOfBoundedFiniteProj_apply]
    rw [freeTailEndomorphism_topologicalFree_apply]
    rfl
  · apply (freeHomEquivPoints T ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)).injective
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    change ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.map (inftyTensorPoint T).op x =
      (0 : ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.obj ⟨T⟩)
    apply LightCondAb.freeSection_map_eq_of_pointwise_measure_eq T T
    intro t
    rw [LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree_app_map_section_of_iso_symm]
    rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed_section_map_apply]
    rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeSectionOfBoundedFiniteProj_apply]
    simp [topologicalTailMeasure]
    rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.finiteDifferencePoint_initial_finite
statement:
lemma finiteDifferencePoint_initial_finite (T : LightProfinite) (k : ℕ) :
    Set.Finite {p : finiteDifferencePoint T | p.1 < k}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI (m : ℕ) : Fintype (T.component m) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let s : Finset (finiteDifferencePoint T) :=
    (Finset.range k).sigma (fun m => (Finset.univ : Finset (T.component m)))
  have hs : {p : finiteDifferencePoint T | p.1 < k} = (s : Set (finiteDifferencePoint T)) := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · intro hp
      rcases p with ⟨m, a⟩
      simpa [s] using hp
    · intro hp
      rcases p with ⟨m, a⟩
      simpa [s] using hp
  rw [hs]
  exact s.finite_toSet

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.exists_nullFiniteDifferenceEnumeration
statement:
lemma exists_nullFiniteDifferenceEnumeration (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T] :
    Nonempty (NullFiniteDifferenceEnumeration T)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : ℕ ≃ finiteDifferencePoint T := finiteDifferencePointEquivNat T
  refine ⟨⟨e, ?_, e.surjective, e.injective⟩⟩
  intro k
  have hbad : Set.Finite {n : ℕ | (e n).1 < k} := by
    have hinit := finiteDifferencePoint_initial_finite T k
    simpa [Set.preimage, e] using Set.Finite.preimage (Equiv.injective e).injOn hinit
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hbad.bddAbove
  refine Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨N + 1, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  by_contra hlt
  have hnmem : n ∈ {n : ℕ | (e n).1 < k} := by
    dsimp
    omega
  have := hN hnmem
  omega

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.finiteDifferenceMeasure_totalVariation_le_two
statement:
lemma finiteDifferenceMeasure_totalVariation_le_two (T : LightProfinite)
    (m : ℕ) (a : T.component m) :
    LightProfinite.FreeImage.totalVariation (finiteDifferenceMeasure T m a) ≤ (2 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases m with
  | zero => exact totalVariation_single_one_le_two (LightProfinite.projSection T 0 a)
  | succ m =>
      exact totalVariation_single_sub_single_le_two
        (LightProfinite.projSection T (m + 1) a)
        (LightProfinite.projSection T m (T.transitionMap m a))

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.finiteDifferenceMeasure_proj_zero
statement:
lemma finiteDifferenceMeasure_proj_zero (T : LightProfinite) {k m : ℕ} (h : k < m)
    (a : T.component m) :
    (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap (T.proj k)).hom (finiteDifferenceMeasure T m a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m =>
      have hle : k ≤ m := by omega
      dsimp [finiteDifferenceMeasure]
      let μ₁ : LightCondAb.topologicalFree T :=
        Finsupp.single (LightProfinite.projSection T (m + 1) a) (1 : ℤ)
      let μ₂ : LightCondAb.topologicalFree T :=
        Finsupp.single (LightProfinite.projSection T m (T.transitionMap m a)) (1 : ℤ)
      change (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap (T.proj k)).hom (μ₁ - μ₂) = 0
      rw [((LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap (T.proj k)).hom).map_sub]
      dsimp [μ₁, μ₂]
      rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap_single]
      rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap_single]
      change Finsupp.single (T.proj k (LightProfinite.projSection T (m + 1) a)) (1 : ℤ) -
          Finsupp.single (T.proj k (LightProfinite.projSection T m (T.transitionMap m a))) (1 : ℤ) = 0
      have h₁ : T.proj k (LightProfinite.projSection T (m + 1) a) =
          T.transitionMapLE (show k ≤ m + 1 by omega) a := by
        have hmap := congrArg (fun f : T.component (m + 1) ⟶ T.component k => f a)
          (LightProfinite.projSection_proj_le T (show k ≤ m + 1 by omega))
        simpa using hmap
      have h₂ : T.proj k (LightProfinite.projSection T m (T.transitionMap m a)) =
          T.transitionMapLE hle (T.transitionMap m a) := by
        have hmap := congrArg
          (fun f : T.component m ⟶ T.component k => f (T.transitionMap m a))
          (LightProfinite.projSection_proj_le T hle)
        simpa using hmap
      have htrans : T.transitionMap m ≫ T.transitionMapLE hle =
          T.transitionMapLE (show k ≤ m + 1 by omega) := by
        change T.diagram.map ⟨homOfLE (Nat.le_succ m)⟩ ≫ T.diagram.map ⟨homOfLE hle⟩ =
          T.diagram.map ⟨homOfLE (show k ≤ m + 1 by omega)⟩
        rw [← T.diagram.map_comp]
        congr 1
      have hpts : T.proj k (LightProfinite.projSection T (m + 1) a) =
          T.proj k (LightProfinite.projSection T m (T.transitionMap m a)) := by
        rw [h₁, h₂]
        change T.transitionMapLE (show k ≤ m + 1 by omega) a =
          (T.transitionMap m ≫ T.transitionMapLE hle) a
        rw [htrans]
      rw [hpts]
      simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.finiteDifferenceValue_topologicalFree_apply
statement:
lemma finiteDifferenceValue_topologicalFree_apply
    (T : LightProfinite) (m : ℕ) (a : T.component m) :
    (show C(↑(LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}).toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
      (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}⟩
        (freeHomEquivPoints (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}) ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)
          (finiteDifferenceValue T m a))) PUnit.unit =
      finiteDifferenceMeasure T m a
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | zero =>
      dsimp [finiteDifferenceValue, finiteDifferenceMeasure, freePointMap]
      exact freeMap_topologicalFree_apply (pointMap T (LightProfinite.projSection T 0 a)) PUnit.unit
  | succ m =>
      dsimp [finiteDifferenceValue, finiteDifferenceMeasure, freePointMap]
      rw [freeHomEquivPoints_sub]
      let pt : LightProfinite := LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}
      let asec := freeHomEquivPoints pt ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)
        ((free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map
          (pointMap T (LightProfinite.projSection T (m + 1) a))))
      let bsec := freeHomEquivPoints pt ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)
        ((free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map
          (pointMap T (LightProfinite.projSection T m (T.transitionMap m a)))))
      have hmap : (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨pt⟩ (asec - bsec) =
          (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨pt⟩ asec -
            (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨pt⟩ bsec := by
        exact ((LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨pt⟩).hom.map_sub asec bsec
      change (show C(↑pt.toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
        (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨pt⟩ (asec - bsec)) PUnit.unit = _
      rw [hmap]
      change (show C(↑pt.toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
          (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨pt⟩ asec) PUnit.unit -
        (show C(↑pt.toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
          (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨pt⟩ bsec) PUnit.unit = _
      rw [freeMap_topologicalFree_apply, freeMap_topologicalFree_apply]
      rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.finiteDifferenceValue_comp_freeProj_zero
statement:
lemma finiteDifferenceValue_comp_freeProj_zero (T : LightProfinite) {k m : ℕ} (h : k < m)
    (a : T.component m) :
    finiteDifferenceValue T m a ≫ freeProj T k = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m =>
      have hle : k ≤ m := by omega
      dsimp [finiteDifferenceValue]
      rw [Preadditive.sub_comp]
      rw [freePointMap_comp_freeProj]
      rw [freePointMap_comp_freeProj]
      have h₁ : T.proj k (LightProfinite.projSection T (m + 1) a) =
          T.transitionMapLE (show k ≤ m + 1 by omega) a := by
        have hmap := congrArg (fun f : T.component (m + 1) ⟶ T.component k => f a)
          (LightProfinite.projSection_proj_le T (show k ≤ m + 1 by omega))
        simpa using hmap
      have h₂ : T.proj k (LightProfinite.projSection T m (T.transitionMap m a)) =
          T.transitionMapLE hle (T.transitionMap m a) := by
        have hmap := congrArg
          (fun f : T.component m ⟶ T.component k => f (T.transitionMap m a))
          (LightProfinite.projSection_proj_le T hle)
        simpa using hmap
      have htrans : T.transitionMap m ≫ T.transitionMapLE hle =
          T.transitionMapLE (show k ≤ m + 1 by omega) := by
        change T.diagram.map ⟨homOfLE (Nat.le_succ m)⟩ ≫ T.diagram.map ⟨homOfLE hle⟩ =
          T.diagram.map ⟨homOfLE (show k ≤ m + 1 by omega)⟩
        rw [← T.diagram.map_comp]
        congr 1
      have hpts : T.proj k (LightProfinite.projSection T (m + 1) a) =
          T.proj k (LightProfinite.projSection T m (T.transitionMap m a)) := by
        rw [h₁, h₂]
        change T.transitionMapLE (show k ≤ m + 1 by omega) a =
          (T.transitionMap m ≫ T.transitionMapLE hle) a
        rw [htrans]
      have hmaps := congrArg (freePointMap (T.component k)) hpts
      rw [hmaps]
      change freePointMap (T.component k)
            (T.proj k (LightProfinite.projSection T m (T.transitionMap m a))) -
          freePointMap (T.component k)
            (T.proj k (LightProfinite.projSection T m (T.transitionMap m a))) = 0
      abel

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.infinitePToFreeFiniteValue_eventually_freeProj_zero

statement:

      (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap (T.proj k)).hom (infinitePToFreeMeasure T n) = 0

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.infinitePToFreeMeasure_finiteProj_continuous
statement:
lemma infinitePToFreeMeasure_finiteProj_continuous (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T] (k : ℕ) :
    Continuous fun x : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) =>
      (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap (T.proj k)).hom
        (match x with
        | ∞ => (0 : LightCondAb.topologicalFree T)
        | OnePoint.some n => infinitePToFreeMeasure T n)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → LightCondAb.topologicalFree (T.component k) := fun n =>
    (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap (T.proj k)).hom (infinitePToFreeMeasure T n)
  have hf : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, f n = 0 := infinitePToFreeMeasure_eventually_proj_zero T k
  have hcont := continuous_ninf_of_eventually_eq_zero f hf
  convert hcont using 1
  ext x
  cases x using OnePoint.rec with
  | infty => simp
  | coe n => simp [f]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.infinitePToFreeFiniteValue_topologicalFree_apply
statement:
lemma infinitePToFreeFiniteValue_topologicalFree_apply
    (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T] (n : ℕ) :
    (show C(↑(LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}).toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
      (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}⟩
        (freeHomEquivPoints (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}) ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)
          (infinitePToFreeFiniteValue T n))) PUnit.unit =
      infinitePToFreeMeasure T n
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [infinitePToFreeFiniteValue, infinitePToFreeMeasure]
  exact finiteDifferenceValue_topologicalFree_apply T ((nullFiniteDifferenceEnumeration T).seq n).1
    ((nullFiniteDifferenceEnumeration T).seq n).2

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.exists_infinitePToFreeElement_direct
statement:
lemma exists_infinitePToFreeElement_direct (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T] :
    ∃ x : ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.obj ⟨(ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)⟩,
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        (freeHomEquivPoints (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1})
          ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)).symm
          (((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.map (natPoint n).op x) =
            infinitePToFreeFiniteValue T n) ∧
      (freeHomEquivPoints (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1})
        ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)).symm
        (((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.map ι.op x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let X : LightProfinite := (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)
  let a : X → LightCondAb.topologicalFree T := fun x =>
    match x with
    | ∞ => 0
    | OnePoint.some n => infinitePToFreeMeasure T n
  let s : (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed T).obj.obj ⟨X⟩ :=
    LightCondAb.topologicalFreeSectionOfBoundedFiniteProj T X a 2 (by
      intro x
      cases x using OnePoint.rec with
      | infty =>
          change LightProfinite.FreeImage.totalVariation (0 : T →₀ ℤ) ≤ (2 : ℤ)
          simp [LightProfinite.FreeImage.totalVariation]
      | coe n => exact infinitePToFreeMeasure_totalVariation_le_two T n) (by
      intro k
      change Continuous fun x : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) =>
        (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap (T.proj k)).hom (a x)
      convert infinitePToFreeMeasure_finiteProj_continuous T k using 1
      ext y
      cases y using OnePoint.rec <;> rfl)
  let x : ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.obj ⟨X⟩ :=
    (LightCondAb.freeTopologicalFreeIso T).symm.hom.hom.app ⟨X⟩ s
  refine ⟨x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n
    apply (freeHomEquivPoints (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1})
      ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)).injective
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    apply LightCondAb.freeSection_map_eq_of_pointwise_measure_eq T (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1})
    intro pt
    change (show C(↑(LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}).toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
        (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}⟩
          (((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.map (natPoint n).op x)) pt =
      (show C(↑(LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}).toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
        (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}⟩
          (freeHomEquivPoints (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}) ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)
            (infinitePToFreeFiniteValue T n))) pt
    rw [LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree_app_map_section_of_iso_symm]
    rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed_section_map_point]
    rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeSectionOfBoundedFiniteProj_apply]
    cases pt
    rw [infinitePToFreeFiniteValue_topologicalFree_apply]
    rfl
  · apply (freeHomEquivPoints (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1})
      ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)).injective
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    change ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.map ι.op x =
      (0 : ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.obj ⟨LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}⟩)
    apply LightCondAb.freeSection_map_eq_of_pointwise_measure_eq T (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1})
    intro pt
    change (show C(↑(LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}).toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
        (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}⟩
          (((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.map ι.op x)) pt =
      (show C(↑(LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}).toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
        (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}⟩
          (0 : ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.obj ⟨LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}⟩)) pt
    rw [LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree_app_map_section_of_iso_symm]
    rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed_section_map_point]
    rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeSectionOfBoundedFiniteProj_apply]
    cases pt
    simp [a]
    rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.exists_infinitePToFreeElement
statement:
lemma exists_infinitePToFreeElement (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T] :
    ∃ x : ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.obj ⟨(ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)⟩,
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        (freeHomEquivPoints (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1})
          ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)).symm
          (((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.map (natPoint n).op x) =
            infinitePToFreeFiniteValue T n) ∧
      (freeHomEquivPoints (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1})
        ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)).symm
        (((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.map ι.op x) = 0
proof:
:=
  exists_infinitePToFreeElement_direct T

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.infinitePToFreeElement_finite
statement:
lemma infinitePToFreeElement_finite (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T] (n : ℕ) :
    (freeHomEquivPoints (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}) ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)).symm
      (((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.map (natPoint n).op (infinitePToFreeElement T)) =
        infinitePToFreeFiniteValue T n
proof:
:=
  ((exists_infinitePToFreeElement_direct T).choose_spec).1 n

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.infinitePToFreeElement_infty
statement:
lemma infinitePToFreeElement_infty (T : LightProfinite) [Infinite T] :
    (freeHomEquivPoints (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}) ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)).symm
      (((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.map ι.op (infinitePToFreeElement T)) = 0
proof:

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedTailFamilyLinear_naturality
statement:
lemma boundedTailFamilyLinear_naturality {S T : LightProfinite}
    (g : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite))
    (m : boundedIntSequences.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :
    boundedIntSequences.obj.map g.op (boundedTailFamilyLinear S f m) =
      boundedTailFamilyLinear T (g ≫ f) (boundedIntSequences.obj.map g.op m)
proof:
:= by
  apply BoundedIntSeqSection.ext_apply
  intro k t
  change (boundedIntSeqSectionComap g
      (boundedTailFamilySection f (show BoundedIntSeqSection S from m))).val k t =
    (boundedTailFamilySection (g ≫ f)
      (boundedIntSeqSectionComap g (show BoundedIntSeqSection S from m))).val k t
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedTailFamilyLinear_naturality'
statement:
lemma boundedTailFamilyLinear_naturality' :
    ∀ {S T : LightProfinite} (g : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite))
      (m : boundedIntSequences.obj.obj ⟨S⟩),
      boundedIntSequences.obj.map g.op (boundedTailFamilyLinear S f m) =
        boundedTailFamilyLinear T (g ≫ f) (boundedIntSequences.obj.map g.op m)
proof:
:= by
  intro S T g f m
  exact boundedTailFamilyLinear_naturality g f m

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeNatBasis_comp_shift
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma freeNatBasis_comp_shift (n : ℕ) :
    freeNatBasis n ≫ (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map LightProfinite.shift =
      freeNatBasis (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [freeNatBasis]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  change (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (natPoint n)) ≫
      (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map LightProfinite.shift) =
    (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (natPoint (n + 1)))
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [natPoint_comp_shift]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeNatBasis_oneMinusShift'
statement:
lemma freeNatBasis_oneMinusShift' (n : ℕ) :
    freeNatBasis n ≫ oneMinusShift' ℤ = freeNatBasis n - freeNatBasis (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [oneMinusShift']
  change freeNatBasis n ≫
      (𝟙 ((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞})) -
        (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map LightProfinite.shift) =
    freeNatBasis n - freeNatBasis (n + 1)
  rw [Preadditive.comp_sub]
  rw [freeNatBasis_comp_shift]
  change freeNatBasis n - freeNatBasis (n + 1) = freeNatBasis n - freeNatBasis (n + 1)
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeInftyBasis_comp_shift
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma freeInftyBasis_comp_shift :
    freeInftyBasis ≫ (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map LightProfinite.shift =
      freeInftyBasis
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [freeInftyBasis, P_map]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  change (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map ι) ≫
      (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map LightProfinite.shift) =
    (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map ι)
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [iota_comp_shift]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeInftyBasis_oneMinusShift'
statement:
lemma freeInftyBasis_oneMinusShift' :
    freeInftyBasis ≫ oneMinusShift' ℤ = 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [oneMinusShift']
  change freeInftyBasis ≫
      (𝟙 ((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞})) -
        (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ⋙ free ℤ).map LightProfinite.shift) = 0
  rw [Preadditive.comp_sub]
  rw [freeInftyBasis_comp_shift]
  change freeInftyBasis - freeInftyBasis = 0
  abel

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.numeratorSlice_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma numeratorSlice_comp (M N K : LightCondAb) (n : ℕ)
    (f : ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ⊗ M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ K) :
    numeratorSlice M K n (f ≫ g) = numeratorSlice M N n f ≫ g
proof:
:= by

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.numeratorSlice_oneMinusShift'
statement:
lemma numeratorSlice_oneMinusShift' (M N : LightCondAb) (n : ℕ)
    (f : ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ⊗ M ⟶ N) :
    numeratorSlice M N n ((oneMinusShift' ℤ ▷ M) ≫ f) =
      numeratorSlice M N n f - numeratorSlice M N (n + 1) f
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [numeratorSlice]
  rw [← comp_whiskerRight_assoc]
  rw [freeNatBasis_oneMinusShift']
  rw [IntProof.sub_whiskerRight]
  rw [Preadditive.sub_comp]
  rw [Preadditive.comp_sub]

    freeInftyValue A ((freeHomEquivPoints (ℕ∪{∞}) A).symm x) = 0

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeNumerator_kills_of_inftyValue_zero
statement:
lemma freeNumerator_kills_of_inftyValue_zero (N : LightCondAb)
    (f : (free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed ⟶ N)
    (h : freeInftyValue N f = 0) :
    P_map ℤ ≫ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso freePointIsoUnit.inv := by infer_instance
  apply (cancel_epi freePointIsoUnit.inv).1
  dsimp [freeInftyValue, freeInftyBasis] at h ⊢
  simpa [Category.assoc] using h

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.basisMap_apply_finite_coord
statement:
@[simp]
lemma basisMap_apply_finite_coord (n i : ℕ) :
    (boundedIntSequencesSectionsEquiv (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1})
      (freeHomEquivPoints (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}) boundedIntSequences
        (freeNatValue boundedIntSequences n (P_proj ℤ ≫ basisMap)))).val i PUnit.unit =
      if n = i then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by

        (freeHomEquivPoints (ℕ∪{∞}) boundedIntSequences (P_proj ℤ ≫ basisMap)))).val i

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedCoord_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma boundedCoord_apply (S : LightProfinite) (x : boundedIntSequences.obj.obj ⟨S⟩)
    (i : ℕ) :
    zdiscSectionsEquiv S ((boundedCoord i).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x) =
      (boundedIntSequencesSectionsEquiv S x).val i
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [boundedCoord]
  change zdiscSectionsEquiv S
      (((productIntLightIsoProductZdisc.hom ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => Zdisc) i).hom.app ⟨S⟩)
        ((boundedToProduct.hom.app ⟨S⟩) x)) =
    (boundedIntSequencesSectionsEquiv S x).val i
  rw [← productIntSectionsEquiv_apply]
  rw [← productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv_apply]
  rw [boundedToProduct_apply_coord]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.P_proj_comp_basisMap_boundedCoord
statement:
lemma P_proj_comp_basisMap_boundedCoord (i : ℕ) :
    P_proj ℤ ≫ basisMap ≫ boundedCoord i =
      zdiscMapOfLocallyConstant (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) (boundedStandardBasisCoord i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [P_proj_comp_basisMap]
  apply (freeHomEquivPoints (ℕ∪{∞}) Zdisc).injective
  apply (zdiscSectionsEquiv (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).injective
  rw [freeHomEquivPoints_comp]
  dsimp [basisMapNumerator]
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [boundedCoord_apply]
  rw [freeHomEquivPoints_zdiscMapOfLocallyConstant]
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedTarget_numerator_ext_of_slices
statement:
lemma boundedTarget_numerator_ext_of_slices
    (g₁ g₂ : ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ⊗ boundedIntSequences ⟶
      boundedIntSequences)
    (hfinite : ∀ n : ℕ,
      numeratorSlice boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences n g₁ =
        numeratorSlice boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences n g₂)
    (hinfty : inftySlice boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences g₁ =
      inftySlice boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences g₂) :
    g₁ = g₂
proof:
:= by
  apply freeTensorHom_ext (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences
  intro S f r m
  conv_lhs => rw [freeTensorHomEval_zsmul]
  conv_rhs => rw [freeTensorHomEval_zsmul]
  congr 1
  apply BoundedIntSeqSection.ext_apply
  intro k s
  let pt : LightProfinite := LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}
  let ps : pt ⟶ S := pointMap S s
  let mpt : boundedIntSequences.obj.obj ⟨pt⟩ := boundedIntSequences.obj.map ps.op m
  have hpt :
      freeTensorHomEval (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences
          g₁ pt (ps ≫ f) 1 mpt =
        freeTensorHomEval (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences
          g₂ pt (ps ≫ f) 1 mpt := by
    cases hfs : f s using OnePoint.rec with
    | infty =>
        have hpoint : ps ≫ f = ι := by
          ext u
          change f s = (∞ : ℕ∪{∞})
          exact hfs
        subst mpt
        rw [hpoint]
        have hto : toPointMap pt ≫ ι = ι := by ext u; rfl
        rw [← hto]
        have hs := congrArg (fun q => q.hom.app ⟨pt⟩ (boundedIntSequences.obj.map ps.op m)) hinfty
        rw [freeTensorHomEval_point_one, freeTensorHomEval_point_one]
        simpa [inftySlice, freeInftyBasis, P_map, pt] using hs
    | coe n =>
        have hpoint : ps ≫ f = natPoint n := by
          ext u
          change f s = (n : ℕ∪{∞})
          exact hfs
        subst mpt
        rw [hpoint]
        have hto : toPointMap pt ≫ natPoint n = natPoint n := by ext u; rfl
        rw [← hto]
        have hs := congrArg (fun q => q.hom.app ⟨pt⟩ (boundedIntSequences.obj.map ps.op m))
          (hfinite n)
        rw [freeTensorHomEval_point_one, freeTensorHomEval_point_one]
        simpa [numeratorSlice, freeNatBasis, pt] using hs
  have hnat₁ := freeTensorHomEval_naturality_one (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)
    boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences g₁ ps f m
  have hnat₂ := freeTensorHomEval_naturality_one (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)
    boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences g₂ ps f m
  have hmap : boundedIntSequences.obj.map ps.op
        (freeTensorHomEval (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences
          g₁ S f 1 m) =
      boundedIntSequences.obj.map ps.op
        (freeTensorHomEval (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences
          g₂ S f 1 m) := by
    rw [hnat₁, hnat₂]
    exact hpt
  have hcoord := congrArg (fun y : boundedIntSequences.obj.obj ⟨pt⟩ =>
      (boundedIntSequencesSectionsEquiv pt y).val k PUnit.unit) hmap
  change (boundedIntSeqSectionComap ps
      (show BoundedIntSeqSection S from freeTensorHomEval
        (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences g₁ S f 1 m)).val k
        PUnit.unit =
    (boundedIntSeqSectionComap ps
      (show BoundedIntSeqSection S from freeTensorHomEval
        (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences g₂ S f 1 m)).val k
        PUnit.unit at hcoord
  change ((show BoundedIntSeqSection S from freeTensorHomEval
        (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences g₁ S f 1 m).val k)
        (ps PUnit.unit) =
    ((show BoundedIntSeqSection S from freeTensorHomEval
        (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences g₂ S f 1 m).val k)
        (ps PUnit.unit) at hcoord
  have hps_apply : ps PUnit.unit = s := rfl
  rw [hps_apply] at hcoord
  change ((show BoundedIntSeqSection S from freeTensorHomEval
        (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences g₁ S f 1 m).val k) s =
    ((show BoundedIntSeqSection S from freeTensorHomEval
        (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences g₂ S f 1 m).val k) s
  exact hcoord

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.numerator_kills_of_inftySlice_zero
statement:
lemma numerator_kills_of_inftySlice_zero (M N : LightCondAb)
    (f : ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ⊗ M ⟶ N)
    (h : inftySlice M N f = 0) :
    (P_map ℤ ▷ M) ≫ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  let u : M ⟶ (free ℤ).obj (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}).toCondensed ⊗ M :=
    (λ_ M).inv ≫ freePointIsoUnit.inv ▷ M
  haveI : IsIso u := by dsimp [u]; infer_instance
  apply (cancel_epi u).1
  calc
    u ≫ ((P_map ℤ ▷ M) ≫ f)
        = inftySlice M N f := by
          dsimp [u, inftySlice, freeInftyBasis]
          simp only [Category.assoc]
          rw [comp_whiskerRight]
          simp [Category.assoc]
    _ = u ≫ (0 : (free ℤ).obj (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}).toCondensed ⊗ M ⟶ N) := by
          rw [h]
          simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pTensorDesc_comp_proj
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma pTensorDesc_comp_proj (M N : LightCondAb)
    (f : ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ⊗ M ⟶ N)
    (hf : (P_map ℤ ▷ M) ≫ f = 0) :
    (P_proj ℤ ▷ M) ≫ pTensorDesc M N f hf = f
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [pTensorDesc, P_proj]
  simpa using (map_π_preserves_coequalizer_inv_desc (G := tensorRight M)
    (f := P_map ℤ) (g := 0) (k := f) (by rw [Functor.map_zero, zero_comp]; exact hf))

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pTensorDesc_slice
statement:
lemma pTensorDesc_slice (M N : LightCondAb)
    (f : ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ⊗ M ⟶ N)
    (hf : (P_map ℤ ▷ M) ≫ f = 0) (n : ℕ) :
    ((λ_ M).inv ≫ pBasis n ▷ M) ≫ pTensorDesc M N f hf =
      numeratorSlice M N n f
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [pBasis, numeratorSlice]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [comp_whiskerRight]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [pTensorDesc_comp_proj]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedTailFamilyMap_natPoint
statement:
lemma boundedTailFamilyMap_natPoint (n : ℕ) :
    freeTensorFamilyMap (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences
      boundedTailFamilyLinear boundedTailFamilyLinear_naturality' (natPoint n) =
    boundedTailProjection n
proof:
:= by
  ext S x
  change boundedTailFamilyLinear S.unop (toPointMap S.unop ≫ natPoint n) x =
    (boundedTailProjection n).hom.app S x
  apply BoundedIntSeqSection.ext_apply
  intro k s
  dsimp [boundedTailFamilyLinear, boundedTailProjection, boundedTailProjectionSection]
  change boundedTailFamilyCoord k ((toPointMap S.unop ≫ natPoint n) s) * x.val k s =
    (if n ≤ k then x.val k else 0) s
  change boundedTailFamilyCoord k (n : ℕ∪{∞}) * x.val k s = _
  rw [boundedTailFamilyCoord_finite]
  by_cases h : n ≤ k <;> simp [h]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedTailNumerator_slice
statement:
lemma boundedTailNumerator_slice (n : ℕ) :

proof:

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedTailFamilyMap_infty
statement:
lemma boundedTailFamilyMap_infty :
    freeTensorFamilyMap (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences boundedIntSequences
      boundedTailFamilyLinear boundedTailFamilyLinear_naturality' ι =
    0
proof:
:= by
  ext S x
  change boundedTailFamilyLinear S.unop (toPointMap S.unop ≫ ι) x =
    (0 : boundedIntSequences ⟶ boundedIntSequences).hom.app S x
  apply BoundedIntSeqSection.ext_apply
  intro k s
  change boundedTailFamilyCoord k ((toPointMap S.unop ≫ ι) s) * x.val k s = 0
  change boundedTailFamilyCoord k (∞ : ℕ∪{∞}) * x.val k s = 0
  rw [boundedTailFamilyCoord_infty]
  simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorIsoInt_hom_naturality_left
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma freeTensorIsoInt_hom_naturality_left {A' A S : LightProfinite} (φ : A' ⟶ A) :
    ((free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map φ) ▷ (free ℤ).obj S.toCondensed) ≫
        (IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt A S).hom =
      (IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt A' S).hom ≫
        (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (φ ⊗ₘ 𝟙 S))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.Monoidal.μIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_left_assoc (free ℤ)
    (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map φ) S.toCondensed
    ((free ℤ).map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ lightProfiniteToLightCondSet A S))]
  slice_lhs 2 4 => rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  slice_rhs 2 4 => rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_left lightProfiniteToLightCondSet]
  simp [MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_id]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorIsoInt_hom_leftUnit
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma freeTensorIsoInt_hom_leftUnit (T : LightProfinite) :
    (λ_ ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)).inv ≫
      freePointIsoUnit.inv ▷ (free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed ≫
      (IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt (LightProfinite.of PUnit.{1}) T).hom =
    (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (λ_ T).inv)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt, freePointIsoUnit]
  simp [← Functor.map_comp]
  change (free ℤ).map
      ((λ_ (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.obj T)).inv ≫
        (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε lightProfiniteToLightCondSet ▷ lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.obj T) ≫
          Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ lightProfiniteToLightCondSet (𝟙_ LightProfinite) T) =
    (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (λ_ T).inv)
  rw [Functor.LaxMonoidal.left_unitality_inv]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorIsoInt_hom_finiteTensorPoint
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma freeTensorIsoInt_hom_finiteTensorPoint (T : LightProfinite) (n : ℕ) :
    (λ_ ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)).inv ≫
      freeNatBasis n ▷ (free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed ≫
      (IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt (ℕ∪{∞}) T).hom =
    (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (finiteTensorPoint T n))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [freeNatBasis]
  rw [comp_whiskerRight]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  slice_lhs 3 5 => rw [freeTensorIsoInt_hom_naturality_left]
  rw [freeTensorIsoInt_hom_leftUnit_assoc]
  dsimp [finiteTensorPoint]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorIsoInt_hom_inftyTensorPoint
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma freeTensorIsoInt_hom_inftyTensorPoint (T : LightProfinite) :

      (IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt (ℕ∪{∞}) T).hom =
    (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (inftyTensorPoint T))
proof:
:= by

  rw [comp_whiskerRight]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  slice_lhs 3 5 => rw [freeTensorIsoInt_hom_naturality_left]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.numeratorSlice_of_freeTensorElement
statement:
lemma numeratorSlice_of_freeTensorElement (T : LightProfinite) (A : LightCondAb) (n : ℕ)
    (x : A.obj.obj ⟨((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite)⟩) :
    numeratorSlice ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) A n
      ((IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt (ℕ∪{∞}) T).hom ≫
        (freeHomEquivPoints ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) A).symm x) =
      (freeHomEquivPoints T A).symm (A.obj.map (finiteTensorPoint T n).op x)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [numeratorSlice]

  rw [freeHomEquivPoints_symm_map]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.inftySlice_of_freeTensorElement
statement:
lemma inftySlice_of_freeTensorElement (T : LightProfinite) (A : LightCondAb)
    (x : A.obj.obj ⟨((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite)⟩) :
    inftySlice ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) A
      ((IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt (ℕ∪{∞}) T).hom ≫
        (freeHomEquivPoints ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) A).symm x) =
      (freeHomEquivPoints T A).symm (A.obj.map (inftyTensorPoint T).op x)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.numeratorSlice_eq_symm_map_finite
statement:
lemma numeratorSlice_eq_symm_map_finite (T : LightProfinite) (A : LightCondAb) (n : ℕ)
    (f : ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ⊗ (free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed ⟶ A) :
    numeratorSlice ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) A n f =
      (freeHomEquivPoints T A).symm
        (A.obj.map (finiteTensorPoint T n).op
          (freeHomEquivPoints ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) A
            ((IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt (ℕ∪{∞}) T).inv ≫ f)))
proof:
:= by
  let x := freeHomEquivPoints ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) A
    ((IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt (ℕ∪{∞}) T).inv ≫ f)
  have hf : f = (IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt (ℕ∪{∞}) T).hom ≫
      (freeHomEquivPoints ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) A).symm x := by
    dsimp [x]
    simp
  change numeratorSlice ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) A n f =
      (freeHomEquivPoints T A).symm (A.obj.map (finiteTensorPoint T n).op x)
  rw [hf]
  rw [numeratorSlice_of_freeTensorElement]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.inftySlice_eq_symm_map_infty
statement:
lemma inftySlice_eq_symm_map_infty (T : LightProfinite) (A : LightCondAb)
    (f : ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ⊗ (free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed ⟶ A) :
    inftySlice ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) A f =
      (freeHomEquivPoints T A).symm
        (A.obj.map (inftyTensorPoint T).op
          (freeHomEquivPoints ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) A
            ((IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt (ℕ∪{∞}) T).inv ≫ f)))
proof:
:= by
  let x := freeHomEquivPoints ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) A
    ((IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt (ℕ∪{∞}) T).inv ≫ f)
  have hf : f = (IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt (ℕ∪{∞}) T).hom ≫
      (freeHomEquivPoints ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) A).symm x := by
    dsimp [x]
    simp
  change inftySlice ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) A f =
      (freeHomEquivPoints T A).symm (A.obj.map (inftyTensorPoint T).op x)
  rw [hf]
  rw [inftySlice_of_freeTensorElement]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv_symm_apply (S : LightProfinite)
    (x : ℕ → C(S, ℝ)) (n : ℕ) :
    realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv S
      (((Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) n).hom.app ⟨S⟩)
        ((productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S).symm x)) = x n
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply (productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S) x) n
  rw [productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv_apply] at h
