name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.productRealRawSectionsEquiv_map
statement:
lemma productRealRawSectionsEquiv_map {S T : LightProfinite} (f : T ⟶ S)
    (x : productRealSequences.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :
    productRealRawSectionsEquiv T (productRealSequences.obj.map f.op x) =
      fun n : ℕ => realCondensedAb.obj.map f.op (productRealRawSectionsEquiv S x n)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [show productRealRawSectionsEquiv T (productRealSequences.obj.map f.op x) n =
      ((Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) n).hom.app ⟨T⟩)
        (productRealSequences.obj.map f.op x) by rfl]
  rw [show productRealRawSectionsEquiv S x n =
      ((Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) n).hom.app ⟨S⟩) x by rfl]
  exact LightCondMod.hom_naturality_apply ℤ (Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) n) f.op x

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv_map {S T : LightProfinite} (f : T ⟶ S)
    (x : productRealSequences.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :
    productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv T (productRealSequences.obj.map f.op x) =
      fun n : ℕ => (productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S x n).comp f.hom.hom
proof:
:= by
  ext n t
  rw [productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv_apply, productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv_apply]
  rw [← realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv_map f
    (((Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) n).hom.app ⟨S⟩) x)]
  exact congrArg (fun g : C(T, ℝ) => g t) (congrArg (realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv T)
    (LightCondMod.hom_naturality_apply ℤ (Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) n) f.op x))

statement:

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.descendContinuousReal_spec
statement:
lemma descendContinuousReal_spec {X B : LightProfinite} (π : X ⟶ B)
    [EffectiveEpi π] (c : PullbackCone π π) (hc : IsLimit c)
    (f : C(X, ℝ))
    (h : f.comp c.fst.hom.hom = f.comp c.snd.hom.hom) :
    (descendContinuousReal π c hc f h).comp π.hom.hom = f
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [descendContinuousReal]
  let xR : realCondensedAb.obj.obj ⟨X⟩ := (realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv X).symm f
  have hxR : ((forget ℤ).obj realCondensedAb).obj.map c.fst.op xR =
      ((forget ℤ).obj realCondensedAb).obj.map c.snd.op xR := by
    change realCondensedAb.obj.map c.fst.op xR = realCondensedAb.obj.map c.snd.op xR
    apply (realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv c.pt).injective
    rw [realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv_map, realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv_map]
    simp [xR, h]
  let target : {x : ((forget ℤ).obj realCondensedAb).obj.obj ⟨X⟩ |
      ((forget ℤ).obj realCondensedAb).obj.map c.fst.op x =
        ((forget ℤ).obj realCondensedAb).obj.map c.snd.op x} := ⟨xR, hxR⟩
  have hbij := (LightCondensed.equalizerCondition ((forget ℤ).obj realCondensedAb)).bijective_mapToEqualizer_pullback' c hc
  let y := Classical.choose (hbij.2 target)
  have hy := Classical.choose_spec (hbij.2 target)
  have hy1 : ((forget ℤ).obj realCondensedAb).obj.map π.op y = xR := by
    have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hy
    change (((forget ℤ).obj realCondensedAb).obj.map π.op y) = xR at hval
    exact hval
  change realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv X (((forget ℤ).obj realCondensedAb).obj.map π.op y) = f
  rw [hy1]
  simp [xR]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedRealSeqPresheaf_equalizerCondition_underlying
statement:
lemma boundedRealSeqPresheaf_equalizerCondition_underlying :
    regularTopology.EqualizerCondition
      (boundedRealSeqPresheaf ⋙ CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  apply regularTopology.EqualizerCondition.mk'
  intro X B π hπ c hc
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    have hmap : boundedRealSeqPresheaf.map π.op a = boundedRealSeqPresheaf.map π.op b := by
      have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hab
      change (boundedRealSeqPresheaf.map π.op a) = boundedRealSeqPresheaf.map π.op b at hval
      exact hval
    apply BoundedRealSeqSection.ext_apply
    intro n s
    haveI : Epi π := inferInstance
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective π := (LightProfinite.epi_iff_surjective π).mp inferInstance
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hsurj s
    have hcoord := congrArg (fun z : BoundedRealSeqSection X => z.val n) hmap
    have hpoint := congrArg (fun f : C(X, ℝ) => f x) hcoord
    change a.val n (π x) = b.val n (π x) at hpoint
    simpa [hx] using hpoint
  · intro target
    let yX : BoundedRealSeqSection X := target.1
    have compat : boundedRealSeqPresheaf.map c.fst.op yX =
        boundedRealSeqPresheaf.map c.snd.op yX := target.2
    let yB : BoundedRealSeqSection B := {
      val := fun n =>
        descendContinuousReal π c hc (yX.val n) (by
          have hcoord := congrArg (fun z : BoundedRealSeqSection c.pt => z.val n) compat
          exact hcoord)
      isBounded := by
        obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := yX.isBounded
        refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
        intro b n
        haveI : Epi π := inferInstance
        have hsurj : Function.Surjective π := (LightProfinite.epi_iff_surjective π).mp inferInstance
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hsurj b
        have hspec := descendContinuousReal_spec π c hc (yX.val n) (by
          have hcoord := congrArg (fun z : BoundedRealSeqSection c.pt => z.val n) compat
          exact hcoord)
        have hpoint := congrArg (fun f : C(X, ℝ) => f x) hspec
        change (descendContinuousReal π c hc (yX.val n) _ (π x)) = yX.val n x at hpoint
        rw [hx] at hpoint
        rw [hpoint]
        exact hN x n }
    refine ⟨yB, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply BoundedRealSeqSection.ext
    intro n
    exact descendContinuousReal_spec π c hc (yX.val n) (by
      have hcoord := congrArg (fun z : BoundedRealSeqSection c.pt => z.val n) compat
      exact hcoord)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.glueContinuousRealBinary_fst
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [glueContinuousRealBinary]
  let F := ((forget ℤ).obj realCondensedAb).obj
  let pair : F.obj S ⨯ F.obj T :=
    (Types.binaryProductIso (F.obj S) (F.obj T)).inv
      ((realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv S.unop).symm xS,
        (realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv T.unop).symm xT)
  erw [← realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv_map (prod.fst : S ⨯ T ⟶ S).unop]
  have h := congrArg (fun f : F.obj S ⨯ F.obj T ⟶ F.obj S => f pair)
    (inv_prodComparison_map_fst (F := F) (A := S) (B := T))
  change realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv S.unop
      ((inv (prodComparison F S T) ≫ F.map (prod.fst : S ⨯ T ⟶ S)) pair) = xS
  rw [h]
  simp [pair]

        (realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv T.unop).symm xT)
  erw [← realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv_map (prod.snd : S ⨯ T ⟶ T).unop]
  have h := congrArg (fun f : F.obj S ⨯ F.obj T ⟶ F.obj T => f pair)
    (inv_prodComparison_map_snd (F := F) (A := S) (B := T))
  change realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv T.unop

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeMeasureEval_clopenIndicator_eq_single
statement:
lemma freeMeasureEval_clopenIndicator_eq_single
    {T : LightProfinite} (δ : FreeMeasure T) {t : T}
    (U : Set T) (hU : IsClopen U) (htU : t ∈ U)
    (hU_support : ∀ u ∈ δ.support, u ≠ t → u ∉ U) :
    freeMeasureEval T (clopenIndicatorInt U hU) δ = δ t
proof:
:= by
  rw [freeMeasureEval_apply]
  classical
  rw [Finsupp.sum]
  change (∑ b ∈ δ.support, δ b * clopenIndicatorInt U hU b) = δ t
  calc
    (∑ b ∈ δ.support, δ b * clopenIndicatorInt U hU b)
        = δ t * clopenIndicatorInt U hU t := by
          refine Finset.sum_eq_single t ?_ ?_
          · intro b hb hbt
            have hbU : b ∉ U := hU_support b hb hbt
            simp [clopenIndicatorInt_of_notMem hU hbU]
          · intro ht_not
            have hδt : δ t = 0 := by
              simpa [Finsupp.mem_support_iff] using ht_not
            simp [hδt]
    _ = δ t := by simp [clopenIndicatorInt_of_mem hU htU]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeMeasure_ext_of_eval
statement:
lemma freeMeasure_ext_of_eval
    {T : LightProfinite} {μ ν : FreeMeasure T}
    (h : ∀ f : LocallyConstant T ℤ,
      freeMeasureEval T f μ = freeMeasureEval T f ν) :
    μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let δ : FreeMeasure T := μ - ν
  have hδ_eval : ∀ f : LocallyConstant T ℤ, freeMeasureEval T f δ = 0 := by
    intro f
    dsimp [δ]
    rw [map_sub, h f, sub_self]
  have hδ : δ = 0 := by
    by_contra hδ_ne
    have hsupport_nonempty : δ.support.Nonempty := by
      rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
      intro hsupp_empty
      apply hδ_ne
      ext t
      have ht : t ∉ δ.support := by simp [hsupp_empty]
      simpa [Finsupp.mem_support_iff] using ht
    obtain ⟨t, ht_support⟩ := hsupport_nonempty
    have ht_ne : δ t ≠ 0 := (Finsupp.mem_support_iff).1 ht_support
    obtain ⟨U, hU, htU, hUavoid⟩ :=
      LightProfinite.exists_clopen_avoiding_finset T (δ.support.erase t) (t := t) (by simp)
    have hU_support : ∀ u ∈ δ.support, u ≠ t → u ∉ U := by
      intro u hu hut
      exact hUavoid u (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hut, hu⟩)
    have heval := hδ_eval (clopenIndicatorInt U hU)
    rw [freeMeasureEval_clopenIndicator_eq_single δ U hU htU hU_support] at heval
    exact ht_ne heval
  simpa [δ, sub_eq_zero] using hδ

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.topologicalFreeCondensed_section_ext_of_eval
statement:
lemma topologicalFreeCondensed_section_ext_of_eval (T S : LightProfinite)
    {x y : (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed T).obj.obj ⟨S⟩}
    (h : ∀ f : LocallyConstant T ℤ,
      (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete T f).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x =
        (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete T f).hom.app ⟨S⟩ y) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro s
  apply freeMeasure_ext_of_eval
  intro f
  have hf := h f
  have hz := congrArg (zdiscSectionsEquiv S) hf
  dsimp [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete, zdiscSectionsEquiv] at hz
  rw [LightCondAb.discreteIntTopModuleCondensedIso_sections,
    LightCondAb.discreteIntTopModuleCondensedIso_sections] at hz
  have hs := congrArg (fun g : LocallyConstant S ℤ => g s) hz
  dsimp [LightCondAb.discreteIntTopModuleSectionsEquiv,
    LightCondAb.discreteIntTopModulePresheafIso,
    LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalCondensed] at hs
  change (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEval T f).hom
      ((show C(↑S.toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from x) s) =
    (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEval T f).hom
      ((show C(↑S.toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from y) s) at hs
  rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEval_apply, LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEval_apply] at hs
  simpa [freeMeasureEval] using hs

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.topologicalFreeCondensed_section_ext_of_finite_proj
statement:
lemma topologicalFreeCondensed_section_ext_of_finite_proj (T S : LightProfinite)
    {x y : (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed T).obj.obj ⟨S⟩}
    (h : ∀ k : ℕ,
      (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensedMap (T.proj k)).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x =
        (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensedMap (T.proj k)).hom.app ⟨S⟩ y) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  apply topologicalFreeCondensed_section_ext_of_eval T S
  intro f
  obtain ⟨k, g, hg⟩ := LightProfinite.exists_locallyConstant_factor_proj T f
  have hk := congrArg
    (fun z => (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete (T.component k) g).hom.app ⟨S⟩ z)
    (h k)
  change ((LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensedMap (T.proj k) ≫
      LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete (T.component k) g).hom.app ⟨S⟩) x =
    ((LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensedMap (T.proj k) ≫
      LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete (T.component k) g).hom.app ⟨S⟩) y at hk
  rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete_naturality] at hk
  simpa [← hg] using hk

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeToTopologicalFree_section_eq_of_zdisc_eval
statement:
lemma freeToTopologicalFree_section_eq_of_zdisc_eval (T S : LightProfinite)
    {x y : ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.obj ⟨S⟩}
    (h : ∀ φ : (free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed ⟶ Zdisc,
      φ.hom.app ⟨S⟩ x = φ.hom.app ⟨S⟩ y) :

      (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨S⟩ y
proof:
:= by

  intro f
  have hf := h (zdiscMapOfLocallyConstant T f)
  rw [zdiscMapOfLocallyConstant_eq_freeToTopologicalFree_eval] at hf
  change (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete T f).hom.app ⟨S⟩
      ((LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x) =
    (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete T f).hom.app ⟨S⟩
      ((LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨S⟩ y)
  simpa using hf

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.lightCondAb_iso_app_injective
statement:
lemma lightCondAb_iso_app_injective {A B : LightCondAb} (e : A ≅ B) (S : LightProfinite) :
    Function.Injective (e.hom.hom.app ⟨S⟩)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have h' := congrArg (fun z => e.inv.hom.app ⟨S⟩ z) h
  change (e.hom ≫ e.inv).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x = (e.hom ≫ e.inv).hom.app ⟨S⟩ y at h'
  simpa using h'

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.finiteFree_section_ext_of_zdisc_eval
statement:
lemma finiteFree_section_ext_of_zdisc_eval (F S : LightProfinite) [Finite F]
    (x y : ((free ℤ).obj F.toCondensed).obj.obj ⟨S⟩)
    (h : ∀ ψ : (free ℤ).obj F.toCondensed ⟶ Zdisc,
      ψ.hom.app ⟨S⟩ x = ψ.hom.app ⟨S⟩ y) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  let M := finiteFreeDiscreteModule F
  let e := finiteFreeIsoDiscrete F
  apply lightCondAb_iso_app_injective e S
  apply (discreteModuleSectionsEquiv S M).injective
  ext s a
  let ℓ : M ⟶ ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ := finiteFreeCoordHom F a
  let ψ : (free ℤ).obj F.toCondensed ⟶ Zdisc :=
    e.hom ≫ (LightCondensed.discrete (ModuleCat ℤ)).map ℓ
  have hh := h ψ
  have hloc := congrArg (discreteModuleSectionsEquiv S (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)) hh
  change discreteModuleSectionsEquiv S (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)
      (((LightCondensed.discrete (ModuleCat ℤ)).map ℓ).hom.app ⟨S⟩
        (e.hom.hom.app ⟨S⟩ x)) =
    discreteModuleSectionsEquiv S (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)
      (((LightCondensed.discrete (ModuleCat ℤ)).map ℓ).hom.app ⟨S⟩
        (e.hom.hom.app ⟨S⟩ y)) at hloc
  rw [discreteModuleSectionsEquiv_map, discreteModuleSectionsEquiv_map] at hloc
  exact congrFun (congrArg LocallyConstant.toFun hloc) s

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeToTopologicalFree_section_injective_finite
statement:
lemma freeToTopologicalFree_section_injective_finite (F S : LightProfinite) [Finite F] :
    Function.Injective ((LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree F).hom.app ⟨S⟩)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply finiteFree_section_ext_of_zdisc_eval F S x y
  intro ψ
  let f : LocallyConstant F ℤ := zdiscSectionsEquiv F (freeHomEquivPoints F Zdisc ψ)
  have hψ : ψ = LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree F ≫ LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete F f := by
    rw [← zdiscMapOfLocallyConstant_of_freeHomEquivPoints F ψ]
    exact zdiscMapOfLocallyConstant_eq_freeToTopologicalFree_eval F f
  rw [hψ]
  change (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete F f).hom.app ⟨S⟩
      ((LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree F).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x) =
    (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete F f).hom.app ⟨S⟩
      ((LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree F).hom.app ⟨S⟩ y)
  rw [hxy]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeProj_section_eq_of_freeToTopologicalFree_eq
statement:
lemma freeProj_section_eq_of_freeToTopologicalFree_eq (T S : LightProfinite)
    {x y : ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.obj ⟨S⟩}
    (hxy : (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x =
      (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨S⟩ y)
    (k : ℕ) :
    (freeProj T k).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x = (freeProj T k).hom.app ⟨S⟩ y
proof:
:= by
  apply freeToTopologicalFree_section_injective_finite (T.component k) S
  have hmap := congrArg
    (fun z => (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensedMap (T.proj k)).hom.app ⟨S⟩ z) hxy
  change ((LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T ≫
      LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensedMap (T.proj k)).hom.app ⟨S⟩) x =
    ((LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T ≫
      LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensedMap (T.proj k)).hom.app ⟨S⟩) y at hmap
  rw [← LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree_naturality (T.proj k)] at hmap
  change (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree (T.component k)).hom.app ⟨S⟩
      ((freeProj T k).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x) =
    (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree (T.component k)).hom.app ⟨S⟩
      ((freeProj T k).hom.app ⟨S⟩ y) at hmap
  exact hmap

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeToTopologicalFree_section_eq_of_freeProj_eq
statement:
lemma freeToTopologicalFree_section_eq_of_freeProj_eq (T S : LightProfinite)
    {x y : ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.obj ⟨S⟩}
    (h : ∀ k : ℕ,
      (freeProj T k).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x = (freeProj T k).hom.app ⟨S⟩ y) :
    (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x =
      (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨S⟩ y
proof:
:= by
  apply topologicalFreeCondensed_section_ext_of_finite_proj T S
  intro k
  change ((LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T ≫
      LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensedMap (T.proj k)).hom.app ⟨S⟩) x =
    ((LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T ≫
      LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensedMap (T.proj k)).hom.app ⟨S⟩) y
  rw [← LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree_naturality (T.proj k)]
  change (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree (T.component k)).hom.app ⟨S⟩
      ((freeProj T k).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x) =
    (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree (T.component k)).hom.app ⟨S⟩
      ((freeProj T k).hom.app ⟨S⟩ y)
  rw [h k]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeProj_section_eq_of_zdisc_eval
statement:
lemma freeProj_section_eq_of_zdisc_eval (T S : LightProfinite)
    {x y : ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.obj ⟨S⟩}
    (h : ∀ φ : (free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed ⟶ Zdisc,
      φ.hom.app ⟨S⟩ x = φ.hom.app ⟨S⟩ y)
    (k : ℕ) :
    (freeProj T k).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x = (freeProj T k).hom.app ⟨S⟩ y
proof:
:=
  freeProj_section_eq_of_freeToTopologicalFree_eq T S
    (freeToTopologicalFree_section_eq_of_zdisc_eval T S h) k

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTarget_section_ext_of_zdisc_eval_obligation
statement:
lemma freeTarget_section_ext_of_zdisc_eval_obligation (T S : LightProfinite)
    (x y : ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.obj ⟨S⟩)

:= by

    ((LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨S⟩) from by

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTarget_section_ext_of_finite_proj
statement:
lemma freeTarget_section_ext_of_finite_proj (T S : LightProfinite)
    (x y : ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.obj ⟨S⟩)
    (h : ∀ k : ℕ,
      (freeProj T k).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x = (freeProj T k).hom.app ⟨S⟩ y) :

proof:
:= by
  apply freeTarget_section_ext_of_zdisc_eval_obligation T S
  intro φ
  obtain ⟨k, ψ, hφ⟩ := zdisc_hom_factors_freeProj T φ

    ψ.hom.app ⟨S⟩ ((freeProj T k).hom.app ⟨S⟩ y)

statement:
lemma freeTarget_section_ext_of_finite_zdisc_eval (T S : LightProfinite)
    (x y : ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.obj ⟨S⟩)

lemma freeTarget_section_ext_of_zdisc_eval (T S : LightProfinite)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTarget_hom_ext_of_points
statement:
lemma freeTarget_hom_ext_of_points (T : LightProfinite)
    (f g : (free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed ⟶ (free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)
    (h : ∀ t : T, freePointMap T t ≫ f = freePointMap T t ≫ g) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply (freeHomEquivPoints T ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)).injective
  apply freeTarget_section_ext_of_zdisc_eval T T
  intro φ
  rw [← freeHomEquivPoints_comp T f φ]
  rw [← freeHomEquivPoints_comp T g φ]
  congr 1
  apply zdisc_hom_ext_of_points
  intro t
  change (freePointMap T t ≫ f) ≫ φ = (freePointMap T t ≫ g) ≫ φ
  rw [h t]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTarget_section_ext_of_slices
statement:
lemma freeTarget_section_ext_of_slices (T : LightProfinite)
    (x y : ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.obj
      ⟨((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite)⟩)
    (hfinite : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.map (finiteTensorPoint T n).op x =
        ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.map (finiteTensorPoint T n).op y)
    (hinfty : ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.map (inftyTensorPoint T).op x =
      ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed).obj.map (inftyTensorPoint T).op y) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  apply freeTarget_section_ext_of_zdisc_eval
  intro φ
  apply zdisc_section_ext_of_slices T
  · intro n
    rw [← LightCondMod.hom_naturality_apply ℤ φ (finiteTensorPoint T n).op x]
    rw [← LightCondMod.hom_naturality_apply ℤ φ (finiteTensorPoint T n).op y]
    rw [hfinite]
  · rw [← LightCondMod.hom_naturality_apply ℤ φ (inftyTensorPoint T).op x]
    rw [← LightCondMod.hom_naturality_apply ℤ φ (inftyTensorPoint T).op y]
    rw [hinfty]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTarget_numerator_ext_of_slices
statement:
lemma freeTarget_numerator_ext_of_slices (T : LightProfinite)
    (f g : ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) ⊗ (free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed ⟶
      (free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)
    (hfinite : ∀ n : ℕ,
      numeratorSlice ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) n f =
        numeratorSlice ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) n g)
    (hinfty : inftySlice ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) f =
      inftySlice ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) g) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  let A := (free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed
  let x := freeHomEquivPoints ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) A
    ((IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt (ℕ∪{∞}) T).inv ≫ f)
  let y := freeHomEquivPoints ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) A
    ((IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt (ℕ∪{∞}) T).inv ≫ g)
  have hxy : x = y := by
    apply freeTarget_section_ext_of_slices T
    · intro n
      have h := congrArg (freeHomEquivPoints T A) (hfinite n)
      rw [numeratorSlice_eq_symm_map_finite, numeratorSlice_eq_symm_map_finite] at h
      simpa [A, x, y] using h
    · have h := congrArg (freeHomEquivPoints T A) hinfty
      rw [inftySlice_eq_symm_map_infty, inftySlice_eq_symm_map_infty] at h
      simpa [A, x, y] using h
  have hmaps : (IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt (ℕ∪{∞}) T).inv ≫ f =
      (IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt (ℕ∪{∞}) T).inv ≫ g := by
    apply (freeHomEquivPoints ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) A).injective
    exact hxy
  apply (cancel_epi (IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt (ℕ∪{∞}) T).inv).1
  exact hmaps

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.zdisc_section_ext_of_slices
statement:
lemma zdisc_section_ext_of_slices (T : LightProfinite)
    (x y : Zdisc.obj.obj ⟨((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite)⟩)
    (hfinite : ∀ n : ℕ,
      Zdisc.obj.map (finiteTensorPoint T n).op x =
        Zdisc.obj.map (finiteTensorPoint T n).op y)
    (hinfty : Zdisc.obj.map (inftyTensorPoint T).op x =
      Zdisc.obj.map (inftyTensorPoint T).op y) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  apply (zdiscSectionsEquiv ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite)).injective
  ext p
  rcases p with ⟨a, t⟩
  cases a using OnePoint.rec with
  | infty =>
      have h := congrArg (zdiscSectionsEquiv T) hinfty
      rw [zdiscSectionsEquiv_map, zdiscSectionsEquiv_map] at h
      exact congrFun (congrArg LocallyConstant.toFun h) t
  | coe n =>
      have h := congrArg (zdiscSectionsEquiv T) (hfinite n)
      rw [zdiscSectionsEquiv_map, zdiscSectionsEquiv_map] at h
      exact congrFun (congrArg LocallyConstant.toFun h) t

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.totalVariation_single_one_le_two
statement:
lemma totalVariation_single_one_le_two {α : Type*} (a : α) :
    LightProfinite.FreeImage.totalVariation (Finsupp.single a (1 : ℤ)) ≤ (2 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LightProfinite.FreeImage.totalVariation]
  simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.totalVariation_single_sub_single_le_two
statement:
lemma totalVariation_single_sub_single_le_two {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (a b : α) :
    LightProfinite.FreeImage.totalVariation
      (Finsupp.single a (1 : ℤ) - Finsupp.single b (1 : ℤ)) ≤ (2 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let μ : α →₀ ℤ := Finsupp.single a (1 : ℤ) - Finsupp.single b (1 : ℤ)
  have hsupp : μ.support ⊆ ({a, b} : Finset α) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff] at hx
    rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have hxzero : μ x = 0 := by simp [μ, h.1, h.2]
    exact hx hxzero
  calc
    LightProfinite.FreeImage.totalVariation μ
        = ∑ x ∈ μ.support, |μ x| := by
          rw [LightProfinite.FreeImage.totalVariation, Finsupp.sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ ({a, b} : Finset α), |μ x| := by
          exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsupp
            (by intro x _ _; positivity)
    _ ≤ 2 := by
          by_cases h : a = b
          · subst h
            simp [μ]
          · simp [μ, h, abs_of_nonneg, abs_of_nonpos]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.topologicalTailMeasure_zero
statement:

lemma topologicalTailMeasure_zero (T : LightProfinite) (t : T) :

statement:
@[simp]
lemma topologicalTailMeasure_succ (T : LightProfinite) (m : ℕ) (t : T) :
    topologicalTailMeasure T (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∪{∞}), t) =
      Finsupp.single t (1 : ℤ) -
        Finsupp.single (LightProfinite.finiteApproxRetraction T m t) (1 : ℤ)

@[simp]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.topologicalTailMeasure_totalVariation_le_two
statement:
lemma topologicalTailMeasure_totalVariation_le_two (T : LightProfinite)
    (x : ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite)) :
    LightProfinite.FreeImage.totalVariation (topologicalTailMeasure T x) ≤ (2 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases x with ⟨a, t⟩
  cases a using OnePoint.rec with
  | infty =>
      change LightProfinite.FreeImage.totalVariation (0 : T →₀ ℤ) ≤ (2 : ℤ)
      simp [LightProfinite.FreeImage.totalVariation]
  | coe n =>
      cases n with
      | zero => simpa [topologicalTailMeasure] using totalVariation_single_one_le_two t
      | succ m =>
          simpa [topologicalTailMeasure] using
            totalVariation_single_sub_single_le_two t
              (LightProfinite.finiteApproxRetraction T m t)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.topologicalTailMeasure_finiteProj_continuous
statement:
lemma topologicalTailMeasure_finiteProj_continuous (T : LightProfinite) (k : ℕ) :
    Continuous fun x : ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⊗ T : LightProfinite) =>
      (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap (T.proj k)).hom (topologicalTailMeasure T x)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → C(↑T.toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree (T.component k)).toModuleCat) :=
    fun n => match n with
    | 0 => ⟨fun t =>
        (show ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree (T.component k)).toModuleCat from
          Finsupp.single (T.proj k t) (1 : ℤ)),
        (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeDirac (T.component k)).hom.continuous.comp
          (T.proj k).hom.hom.continuous⟩
    | m + 1 => ⟨fun t =>
        (show ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree (T.component k)).toModuleCat from
          Finsupp.single (T.proj k t) (1 : ℤ)) -
          (show ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree (T.component k)).toModuleCat from
            Finsupp.single (T.proj k (LightProfinite.finiteApproxRetraction T m t)) (1 : ℤ)),
        by fun_prop⟩
  have hf : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, f n = 0 := by
    refine Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨k + 1, ?_⟩
    intro n hn
    ext t
    cases n with
    | zero => omega
    | succ m =>
        have hle : k ≤ m := by omega
        change (Finsupp.single (T.proj k t) (1 : ℤ) -
          Finsupp.single (T.proj k (LightProfinite.finiteApproxRetraction T m t)) 1 :
            T.component k →₀ ℤ) = 0
        have hpts : T.proj k (LightProfinite.finiteApproxRetraction T m t) = T.proj k t := by
          have hmap := congrArg (fun f : T ⟶ T.component k => f t)
            (LightProfinite.finiteApproxRetraction_proj_le T hle)
          simpa using hmap
        rw [hpts]
        simp
  have hcont := continuous_ninfTensor_of_eventually_eq_zero T f hf
  convert hcont using 1
  ext x
  rcases x with ⟨a, t⟩
  cases a using OnePoint.rec with
  | infty => exact (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap (T.proj k)).hom.map_zero
  | coe n =>
      cases n with
      | zero => simp [f, topologicalTailMeasure, LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap_single]
      | succ m =>
          let μ₁ : LightCondAb.topologicalFree T := Finsupp.single t (1 : ℤ)
          let μ₂ : LightCondAb.topologicalFree T :=
            Finsupp.single (LightProfinite.finiteApproxRetraction T m t) (1 : ℤ)
          change (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap (T.proj k)).hom (μ₁ - μ₂) =
            (show ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree (T.component k)).toModuleCat from
              Finsupp.single (T.proj k t) (1 : ℤ)) -
            (show ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree (T.component k)).toModuleCat from
              Finsupp.single (T.proj k (LightProfinite.finiteApproxRetraction T m t)) (1 : ℤ))
          rw [((LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap (T.proj k)).hom).map_sub]
          dsimp [μ₁, μ₂]
          rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap_single]
          rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap_single]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeFiniteApproxRetraction_topologicalFree_apply
statement:
lemma freeFiniteApproxRetraction_topologicalFree_apply
    (T : LightProfinite) (m : ℕ) (t : T) :
    (show C(↑T.toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
      (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨T⟩
        (freeHomEquivPoints T ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed)
          (freeFiniteApproxRetraction T m))) t =
      Finsupp.single (LightProfinite.finiteApproxRetraction T m t) (1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [freeFiniteApproxRetraction]
  exact freeMap_topologicalFree_apply (LightProfinite.finiteApproxRetraction T m) t

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTailEndomorphism_topologicalFree_apply
statement:
lemma freeTailEndomorphism_topologicalFree_apply
    (T : LightProfinite) (n : ℕ) (t : T) :
    (show C(↑T.toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
      (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨T⟩
        (freeHomEquivPoints T ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) (freeTailEndomorphism T n))) t =
      topologicalTailMeasure T ((n : ℕ∪{∞}), t)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      exact freeToTopologicalFree_id_apply T t
  | succ m =>
      dsimp [freeTailEndomorphism]
      rw [freeHomEquivPoints_sub]
      let a := freeHomEquivPoints T ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) (𝟙 ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed))
      let b := freeHomEquivPoints T ((free ℤ).obj T.toCondensed) (freeFiniteApproxRetraction T m)
      have hmap : (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨T⟩ (a - b) =
          (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨T⟩ a -
            (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨T⟩ b := by
        exact ((LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨T⟩).hom.map_sub a b
      change (show C(↑T.toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
        (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨T⟩ (a - b)) t = _
      rw [hmap]
      change (show C(↑T.toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
          (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨T⟩ a) t -
        (show C(↑T.toTop, ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
          (LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree T).hom.app ⟨T⟩ b) t = _
      rw [freeToTopologicalFree_id_apply, freeFiniteApproxRetraction_topologicalFree_apply]
      rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.topologicalFreeEval_diracDiff
statement:
lemma topologicalFreeEval_diracDiff (T : LightProfinite) (f : LocallyConstant T ℤ) (a b : T) :
    (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEval T f).hom (topologicalFreeDiracDiff T a b) = f a - f b
proof:
:= by
  let μ₁ : LightCondAb.topologicalFree T := Finsupp.single a (1 : ℤ)
  let μ₂ : LightCondAb.topologicalFree T := Finsupp.single b (1 : ℤ)
  change (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEval T f).hom (μ₁ - μ₂) = f a - f b
  rw [map_sub]
  dsimp [μ₁, μ₂]
  rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEval_single]
  rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEval_single]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.topologicalFreeMap_diracDiff
statement:
lemma topologicalFreeMap_diracDiff {T U : LightProfinite} (q : T ⟶ U) (a b : T) :
    (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap q).hom (topologicalFreeDiracDiff T a b) =
      topologicalFreeDiracDiff U (q a) (q b)
proof:
:= by
  let μ₁ : LightCondAb.topologicalFree T := Finsupp.single a (1 : ℤ)
  let μ₂ : LightCondAb.topologicalFree T := Finsupp.single b (1 : ℤ)
  change (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap q).hom (μ₁ - μ₂) =
    (show ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree U).toModuleCat from
      Finsupp.single (q a) (1 : ℤ) - Finsupp.single (q b) (1 : ℤ))
  rw [((LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap q).hom).map_sub]
  dsimp [μ₁, μ₂]
  rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap_single]
  rw [LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap_single]
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.totalVariation_zsmul_diracDiff_le_two_mul_natAbs
statement:
lemma totalVariation_zsmul_diracDiff_le_two_mul_natAbs {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (a b : α) (c : ℤ) :
    LightProfinite.FreeImage.totalVariation
      (c • (Finsupp.single a (1 : ℤ) - Finsupp.single b (1 : ℤ))) ≤
        (2 * (Int.natAbs c : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let μ : α →₀ ℤ := c • (Finsupp.single a (1 : ℤ) - Finsupp.single b (1 : ℤ))
  have hsupp : μ.support ⊆ ({a, b} : Finset α) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff] at hx
    rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have hxzero : μ x = 0 := by simp [μ, h.1, h.2]
    exact hx hxzero
  calc
    LightProfinite.FreeImage.totalVariation μ
        = ∑ x ∈ μ.support, |μ x| := by
          rw [LightProfinite.FreeImage.totalVariation, Finsupp.sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ ({a, b} : Finset α), |μ x| := by
          exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsupp
            (by intro x _ _; positivity)
    _ ≤ 2 * (Int.natAbs c : ℤ) := by
          by_cases h : a = b
          · subst h
            simp [μ]
          · simp [μ, h, abs_of_nonneg, abs_of_nonpos]
            ring_nf
            exact le_rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.ninf_map_eventually_eq_infty
statement:
lemma ninf_map_eventually_eq_infty (F : LightProfinite) [Finite F]
    (q : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⟶ F) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, q (n : ℕ∪{∞}) = q (∞ : ℕ∪{∞})
proof:
:= by
  letI : DiscreteTopology F := Finite.instDiscreteTopology
  have hcont : Continuous (fun a : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) => q a) := q.hom.hom.continuous
  have htend : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => q (n : ℕ∪{∞})) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (q (∞ : ℕ∪{∞}))) :=
    (LightProfinite.continuous_iff_convergent
      (fun a : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) => q a)).mp hcont
  have hsing : {q (∞ : ℕ∪{∞})} ∈ nhds (q (∞ : ℕ∪{∞})) := by
    simp [nhds_discrete]
  filter_upwards [htend hsing] with n hn
  simpa using hn

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceMeasure_add
statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceMeasure_add {S : LightProfinite}
    (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) (x y : BoundedIntSeqSection S) (s : S) :
    boundedDifferenceMeasure f (x + y) s =
      boundedDifferenceMeasure f x s + boundedDifferenceMeasure f y s
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [boundedDifferenceMeasure]
  cases hfs : f s using OnePoint.rec with
  | infty => simp [boundedDifferenceCoeff, hfs]
  | coe n =>
      have hxy : boundedDifferenceCoeff f (x + y) s = x.val n s + y.val n s := by
        simp [boundedDifferenceCoeff, hfs]
      have hx : boundedDifferenceCoeff f x s = x.val n s := by
        simp [boundedDifferenceCoeff, hfs]
      have hy : boundedDifferenceCoeff f y s = y.val n s := by
        simp [boundedDifferenceCoeff, hfs]
      rw [hxy, hx, hy]
      let d := topologicalFreeDiracDiff (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)
        (n : ℕ∪{∞}) (∞ : ℕ∪{∞})
      change ((x.val n s + y.val n s) • d) = (x.val n s) • d + (y.val n s) • d
      rw [add_zsmul]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceMeasure_zsmul
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [boundedDifferenceMeasure]
  cases hfs : f s using OnePoint.rec with
  | infty =>
      dsimp [boundedDifferenceCoeff]
      rw [hfs]
      rw [topologicalFreeDiracDiff_self]
      simp
      exact (smul_zero a : a • (0 : LightCondAb.topologicalFree (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) = 0).symm
  | coe n =>
      have hax : boundedDifferenceCoeff f (a • x) s = a * x.val n s := by
        dsimp [boundedDifferenceCoeff]
        rw [hfs]
      have hx : boundedDifferenceCoeff f x s = x.val n s := by
        simp [boundedDifferenceCoeff, hfs]
      rw [hax, hx]
      let d := topologicalFreeDiracDiff (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)
        (n : ℕ∪{∞}) (∞ : ℕ∪{∞})
      change (a * x.val n s) • d = a • ((x.val n s) • d)
      rw [mul_smul]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceMeasure_comap
statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceMeasure_comap {S T : LightProfinite}
    (g : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) (x : BoundedIntSeqSection S)
    (t : T) :
    boundedDifferenceMeasure (g ≫ f) (boundedIntSeqSectionComap g x) t =
      boundedDifferenceMeasure f x (g t)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [boundedDifferenceMeasure, boundedDifferenceCoeff]
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceMeasure_totalVariation_le
statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceMeasure_totalVariation_le {S : LightProfinite}
    (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) (x : BoundedIntSeqSection S) (s : S) :
    LightProfinite.FreeImage.totalVariation (boundedDifferenceMeasure f x s) ≤
      (2 * x.isBounded.choose : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  dsimp [boundedDifferenceMeasure, topologicalFreeDiracDiff]
  have hcoeff : Int.natAbs (boundedDifferenceCoeff f x s) ≤ x.isBounded.choose := by
    cases hfs : f s using OnePoint.rec with
    | infty => simp [boundedDifferenceCoeff, hfs]
    | coe n =>
        simpa [boundedDifferenceCoeff, hfs] using x.isBounded.choose_spec s n
  have htv := totalVariation_zsmul_diracDiff_le_two_mul_natAbs (f s)
    (∞ : ℕ∪{∞}) (boundedDifferenceCoeff f x s)
  refine le_trans htv ?_
  exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hcoeff

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceMeasure_finiteProj_continuous
statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceMeasure_finiteProj_continuous {S : LightProfinite}
    (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) (x : BoundedIntSeqSection S) (k : ℕ) :
    Continuous fun s : S =>
      (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite).proj k)).hom
        (boundedDifferenceMeasure f x s)
proof:
:= by
  let q : (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite).component k :=
    (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite).proj k
  let g : ℕ → C(↑S.toTop,
      ↑(LightCondAb.topologicalFree ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite).component k)).toModuleCat) := fun n =>
    ⟨fun s => (x.val n s) •
        topologicalFreeDiracDiff ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite).component k)
          (q (n : ℕ∪{∞})) (q (∞ : ℕ∪{∞})),
      by exact ((x.val n).map (fun z : ℤ ↦ z •
        topologicalFreeDiracDiff ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite).component k)
          (q (n : ℕ∪{∞})) (q (∞ : ℕ∪{∞})))).continuous⟩
  have hg : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, g n = 0 := by
    filter_upwards [ninf_map_eventually_eq_infty ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite).component k) q] with n hn
    ext s
    change (x.val n s) •
        topologicalFreeDiracDiff ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite).component k)
          (q (n : ℕ∪{∞})) (q (∞ : ℕ∪{∞})) = 0
    rw [hn]
    rw [topologicalFreeDiracDiff_self]
    exact smul_zero (x.val n s)
  have hcont := continuous_ninfTensor_of_eventually_eq_zero S g hg
  have hgraph : Continuous fun s : S => ((f s), s) := by
    exact f.hom.hom.continuous.prodMk continuous_id
  refine (hcont.comp hgraph).congr ?_
  intro s
  dsimp [boundedDifferenceMeasure, Function.comp_def]
  cases hfs : f s using OnePoint.rec with
  | infty =>
      simp [boundedDifferenceCoeff, hfs]
      exact (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap q).hom.map_zero.symm
  | coe n =>
      have hcoeff : boundedDifferenceCoeff f x s = x.val n s := by
        simp [boundedDifferenceCoeff, hfs]
      rw [hcoeff]
      change (x.val n s) •
          topologicalFreeDiracDiff ((ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite).component k)
            (q (n : ℕ∪{∞})) (q (∞ : ℕ∪{∞})) =
        (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap q).hom
          ((x.val n s) • topologicalFreeDiracDiff (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)
            (n : ℕ∪{∞}) (∞ : ℕ∪{∞}))
      rw [map_smul]
      rw [topologicalFreeMap_diracDiff]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection_add
statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection_add {S : LightProfinite}
    (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) (x y : BoundedIntSeqSection S) :
    boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection f (x + y) =
      boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection f x + boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection f y
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro s
  change boundedDifferenceMeasure f (x + y) s =
    boundedDifferenceMeasure f x s + boundedDifferenceMeasure f y s
  exact boundedDifferenceMeasure_add f x y s

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection_zsmul
statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection_zsmul {S : LightProfinite}
    (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) (a : ℤ) (x : BoundedIntSeqSection S) :
    boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection f (a • x) =
      a • boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection f x
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro s
  change boundedDifferenceMeasure f (a • x) s = a • boundedDifferenceMeasure f x s
  exact boundedDifferenceMeasure_zsmul f a x s

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection_naturality
statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection_naturality {S T : LightProfinite}
    (g : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) (x : BoundedIntSeqSection S) :
    (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).obj.map g.op
      (boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection f x) =
    boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection (g ≫ f) (boundedIntSeqSectionComap g x)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro t
  change boundedDifferenceMeasure f x (g t) =
    boundedDifferenceMeasure (g ≫ f) (boundedIntSeqSectionComap g x) t
  exact (boundedDifferenceMeasure_comap g f x t).symm

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferencePSection_add
statement:
lemma boundedDifferencePSection_add {S : LightProfinite}
    (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) (x y : BoundedIntSeqSection S) :
    boundedDifferencePSection f (x + y) =
      boundedDifferencePSection f x + boundedDifferencePSection f y
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [boundedDifferencePSection]
  rw [boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection_add]
  rw [((LightCondAb.freeTopologicalFreeIso (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).inv.hom.app ⟨S⟩).hom.map_add]
  rw [((P_proj ℤ).hom.app ⟨S⟩).hom.map_add]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferencePSection_zsmul
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [boundedDifferencePSection]
  rw [boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection_zsmul]
  let u := boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection f x
  have hfree :
      ((LightCondAb.freeTopologicalFreeIso (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).inv.hom.app ⟨S⟩).hom
        (a • u) =
      a • ((LightCondAb.freeTopologicalFreeIso (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).inv.hom.app ⟨S⟩).hom u := by
    exact map_zsmul
      (((LightCondAb.freeTopologicalFreeIso (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).inv.hom.app ⟨S⟩).hom) a u
  change ((P_proj ℤ).hom.app ⟨S⟩).hom
      (((LightCondAb.freeTopologicalFreeIso (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).inv.hom.app ⟨S⟩).hom
        (a • u)) =
    a • ((P_proj ℤ).hom.app ⟨S⟩).hom
      (((LightCondAb.freeTopologicalFreeIso (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).inv.hom.app ⟨S⟩).hom u)
  rw [hfree]
  exact map_zsmul (((P_proj ℤ).hom.app ⟨S⟩).hom) a _

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferencePSection_naturality
statement:
lemma boundedDifferencePSection_naturality {S T : LightProfinite}
    (g : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) (x : BoundedIntSeqSection S) :
    (P ℤ).obj.map g.op (boundedDifferencePSection f x) =
      boundedDifferencePSection (g ≫ f) (boundedIntSeqSectionComap g x)
proof:
:= by

  rw [← LightCondMod.hom_naturality_apply ℤ
    (LightCondAb.freeTopologicalFreeIso (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).inv g.op]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear_naturality
statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear_naturality {S T : LightProfinite}
    (g : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite))
    (m : boundedIntSequences.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :
    (P ℤ).obj.map g.op (boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear S f m) =
      boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear T (g ≫ f) (boundedIntSequences.obj.map g.op m)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear_naturality'
statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear_naturality' :

      (m : boundedIntSequences.obj.obj ⟨S⟩),
      (P ℤ).obj.map g.op (boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear S f m) =
        boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear T (g ≫ f) (boundedIntSequences.obj.map g.op m)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceNumerator_slice
statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceNumerator_slice (n : ℕ) :
    numeratorSlice boundedIntSequences (P ℤ) n boundedDifferenceNumerator =
      freeTensorFamilyMap (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences (P ℤ)
        boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear_naturality' (natPoint n)
proof:
:= by

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceFamilyMap_infty
statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceFamilyMap_infty :
    freeTensorFamilyMap (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences (P ℤ)
      boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear_naturality' ι =
    0
proof:
:= by
  ext S x
  change boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear S.unop (toPointMap S.unop ≫ ι) x =
    (0 : boundedIntSequences ⟶ P ℤ).hom.app S x
  dsimp [boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear, boundedDifferencePSection]
  have htop : boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection (toPointMap S.unop ≫ ι)
      (show BoundedIntSeqSection S.unop from x) = 0 := by
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro s
    change boundedDifferenceMeasure (toPointMap S.unop ≫ ι)
        (show BoundedIntSeqSection S.unop from x) s = 0
    dsimp [boundedDifferenceMeasure, boundedDifferenceCoeff]
    have hf : (ConcreteCategory.hom (toPointMap S.unop ≫ ι)) s =
        (∞ : ℕ∪{∞}) := rfl
    rw [hf]
    rw [topologicalFreeDiracDiff_self]
    change (0 : ℤ) • (0 : LightCondAb.topologicalFree (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) = 0
    exact zero_smul ℤ (0 : LightCondAb.topologicalFree (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite))
  rw [htop]
  simp

statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceMap_slice (n : ℕ) :
    ((λ_ boundedIntSequences).inv ≫ pBasis n ▷ boundedIntSequences) ≫ boundedDifferenceMap =
      freeTensorFamilyMap (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences (P ℤ)
        boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear_naturality' (natPoint n)
proof:

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedDifferenceFamilyMap_natPoint_comp_basisMap
statement:
lemma boundedDifferenceFamilyMap_natPoint_comp_basisMap (n : ℕ) :
    freeTensorFamilyMap (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) boundedIntSequences (P ℤ)
      boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear_naturality' (natPoint n) ≫ basisMap =
      boundedTailProjection n - boundedTailProjection (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext S x
  apply BoundedIntSeqSection.ext_apply
  intro k s
  let fconst : S.unop ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) := toPointMap S.unop ≫ natPoint n
  let topSec : (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensed (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).obj.obj S :=
    boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection fconst (show BoundedIntSeqSection S.unop from x)
  let freeSec : ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed).obj.obj S :=
    (LightCondAb.freeTopologicalFreeIso (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).symm.hom.hom.app S topSec
  have hcoord := boundedCoord_apply S.unop
    ((basisMap.hom.app S) (boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear S.unop fconst x)) k
  change zdiscSectionsEquiv S.unop
      (((boundedCoord k).hom.app S)
        ((basisMap.hom.app S) (boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear S.unop fconst x))) =
    (boundedIntSequencesSectionsEquiv S.unop
      ((basisMap.hom.app S) (boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear S.unop fconst x))).val k at hcoord
  have hleft : zdiscSectionsEquiv S.unop
      (((boundedCoord k).hom.app S)
        ((basisMap.hom.app S) (boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear S.unop fconst x))) s =
      (boundedStandardBasisCoord k (n : ℕ∪{∞})) *
        (show BoundedIntSeqSection S.unop from x).val n s := by
    dsimp [boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear, boundedDifferencePSection, fconst, freeSec, topSec]
    change zdiscSectionsEquiv S.unop
        (((P_proj ℤ ≫ basisMap ≫ boundedCoord k).hom.app S) freeSec) s = _
    rw [P_proj_comp_basisMap_boundedCoord]
    rw [zdiscMapOfLocallyConstant_eq_freeToTopologicalFree_eval]
    change zdiscSectionsEquiv S.unop
        ((LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)
            (boundedStandardBasisCoord k)).hom.app S
          ((LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)).hom.app S freeSec)) s = _
    rw [LightCondAb.freeToTopologicalFree_app_section_of_iso_symm]
    rw [zdiscSectionsEquiv_topologicalFreeEvalDiscrete_apply]
    dsimp [topSec, boundedDifferenceTopologicalSection]
    change (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEval (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)
        (boundedStandardBasisCoord k)).hom
        (boundedDifferenceMeasure fconst (show BoundedIntSeqSection S.unop from x) s) = _
    dsimp [boundedDifferenceMeasure, boundedDifferenceCoeff]
    change (LightCondAb.topologicalFreeEval (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)
        (boundedStandardBasisCoord k)).hom
        (((show BoundedIntSeqSection S.unop from x).val n s) •
          topologicalFreeDiracDiff (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) (n : ℕ∪{∞}) (∞ : ℕ∪{∞})) = _
    rw [map_zsmul]
    rw [topologicalFreeEval_diracDiff]
    rw [boundedStandardBasisCoord_infty]
    ring
  have hcoord_point := congrArg (fun lc : LocallyConstant S.unop ℤ => lc s) hcoord
  rw [hleft] at hcoord_point
  change (((boundedIntSequencesSectionsEquiv S.unop
      ((basisMap.hom.app S) (boundedDifferenceFamilyLinear S.unop fconst x))).val k) s) =
    (((boundedIntSequencesSectionsEquiv S.unop
      (((boundedTailProjection n - boundedTailProjection (n + 1)).hom.app S) x)).val k) s)
  rw [← hcoord_point]
  rw [boundedTailProjection_succ_diff_apply_coord]
  rw [boundedStandardBasisCoord_finite]
  by_cases hkn : n = k
  · subst k
    simp
    change (x.val n) s = (x.val n) s
    rfl
  · have hkn' : k ≠ n := by exact fun hk => hkn hk.symm
    simp [hkn, hkn']

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedShiftRetract_numerator_comm
statement:
lemma boundedShiftRetract_numerator_comm :
    (oneMinusShift' ℤ ▷ boundedIntSequences) ≫ boundedTailNumerator =
      boundedDifferenceNumerator ≫ basisMap
proof:
:= by
  apply boundedTarget_numerator_ext_of_slices
  · intro n
    rw [numeratorSlice_oneMinusShift']
    rw [boundedTailNumerator_slice]
    rw [boundedTailNumerator_slice]
    rw [numeratorSlice_comp]
    rw [boundedDifferenceNumerator_slice]
    rw [boundedDifferenceFamilyMap_natPoint_comp_basisMap]
  · rw [inftySlice_oneMinusShift']
    rw [inftySlice_comp]
    rw [boundedDifferenceNumerator_infty]
    simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedShiftRetract_comm
statement:
lemma boundedShiftRetract_comm :
    ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ boundedIntSequences) ≫ boundedTailMap =
      boundedDifferenceMap ≫ basisMap
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Epi (P_proj ℤ ▷ boundedIntSequences) := epi_P_proj_tensor boundedIntSequences
  apply (cancel_epi (P_proj ℤ ▷ boundedIntSequences)).1
  dsimp [boundedTailMap, boundedDifferenceMap]
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [P_proj_tensor_oneMinusShift]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [pTensorDesc_comp_proj]
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [pTensorDesc_comp_proj]
  exact boundedShiftRetract_numerator_comm

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.dyadicBlock_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dyadicBlock_zero : dyadicBlock 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dyadicBlock]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.dyadicBlock_odd
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dyadicBlock_odd (n : ℕ) : dyadicBlock (2 * n + 1) = dyadicBlock n + 1
proof:
:= by
  change dyadicBlock (Nat.succ (2 * n)) = dyadicBlock n + 1
  rw [dyadicBlock]
  simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.dyadicBlock_even
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dyadicBlock_even (n : ℕ) : dyadicBlock (2 * n + 2) = dyadicBlock n + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [show 2 * n + 2 = Nat.succ (2 * n + 1) by omega]
  rw [dyadicBlock]
  have h : (2 * n + 1) / 2 = n := by omega
  rw [h]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.dyadicCoeff_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dyadicCoeff_zero : dyadicCoeff 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [dyadicCoeff]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.dyadicCoeff_pair_sum
statement:
lemma dyadicCoeff_pair_sum (n : ℕ) :
    dyadicCoeff (2 * n + 1) + dyadicCoeff (2 * n + 2) = dyadicCoeff n
proof:
:= by
  simp [dyadicCoeff, pow_succ]
  ring

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.dyadicBlock_ge_of_ge_two_pow_sub_one
statement:
lemma dyadicBlock_ge_of_ge_two_pow_sub_one (K n : ℕ) (h : 2 ^ K - 1 ≤ n) :
    K ≤ dyadicBlock n
proof:
:= by
  induction K generalizing n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ K ih =>
      cases n with
      | zero =>
          have hp : 1 ≤ 2 ^ (K + 1) - 1 := by
            have hp2 : 2 ≤ 2 ^ (K + 1) := by
              rw [pow_succ']
              have hpos : 1 ≤ 2 ^ K := Nat.one_le_two_pow
              omega
            omega
          omega
      | succ m =>
          rw [dyadicBlock]
          apply Nat.succ_le_succ
          apply ih
          have hpow : 2 ^ (K + 1) = 2 * 2 ^ K := by rw [pow_succ']
          rw [hpow] at h
          have hm : (2 ^ K - 1) * 2 ≤ m := by
            have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ K := Nat.two_pow_pos K
            omega
          exact (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by norm_num : 0 < 2)).2 hm

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.tendsto_dyadicBlock_atTop
statement: lemma tendsto_dyadicBlock_atTop : Filter.Tendsto dyadicBlock Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
proof:
:= by
  rw [Filter.tendsto_atTop]
  intro K
  refine Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨2 ^ K - 1, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  exact dyadicBlock_ge_of_ge_two_pow_sub_one K n hn

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeNatBasis_comp_freeOddMap

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pOddMap_pBasis
statement:
lemma pOddMap_pBasis (n : ℕ) :
    pBasis n ≫ pOddMap = pBasis (2 * n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [pBasis]
  calc
    (freeNatBasis n ≫ P_proj ℤ) ≫ pOddMap
        = freeNatBasis n ≫ (P_proj ℤ ≫ pOddMap) := by rw [Category.assoc]
    _ = freeNatBasis n ≫ (freeOddMap ≫ P_proj ℤ) := by rw [P_proj_comp_pOddMap]
    _ = (freeNatBasis n ≫ freeOddMap) ≫ P_proj ℤ := by rw [Category.assoc]
    _ = freeNatBasis (2 * n + 1) ≫ P_proj ℤ := by rw [freeNatBasis_comp_freeOddMap]

        = freeNatBasis n ≫ (P_proj ℤ ≫ pEvenMap) := by rw [Category.assoc]
    _ = freeNatBasis n ≫ (freeEvenMap ≫ P_proj ℤ) := by rw [P_proj_comp_pEvenMap]
    _ = (freeNatBasis n ≫ freeEvenMap) ≫ P_proj ℤ := by rw [Category.assoc]
    _ = freeNatBasis (2 * n + 2) ≫ P_proj ℤ := by rw [freeNatBasis_comp_freeEvenMap]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeSplitMap_comp_oneMinusShift'
statement:
lemma freeSplitMap_comp_oneMinusShift' :
    (freeOddMap + freeEvenMap) ≫ oneMinusShift' ℤ = oneMinusShift' ℤ ≫ freeOddMap
proof:
:= by
  change (freeOddMap + freeEvenMap) ≫
      (𝟙 ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) -
        (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map LightProfinite.shift)) =
    (𝟙 ((free ℤ).obj (ℕ∪{∞}).toCondensed) -
        (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map LightProfinite.shift)) ≫ freeOddMap
  rw [Preadditive.add_comp]
  rw [Preadditive.comp_sub, Preadditive.comp_sub, Preadditive.sub_comp]
  rw [Category.comp_id, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  rw [freeOddMap_comp_shiftFree, freeEvenMap_comp_shiftFree]
  abel

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pSplitMap_comp_oneMinusShift
statement:
lemma pSplitMap_comp_oneMinusShift :
    pSplitMap ≫ oneMinusShift ℤ = oneMinusShift ℤ ≫ pOddMap
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Epi (P_proj ℤ) := by
    change Epi (cokernel.π (P_map ℤ))
    infer_instance
  apply (cancel_epi (P_proj ℤ)).1
  calc
    P_proj ℤ ≫ pSplitMap ≫ oneMinusShift ℤ
        = (freeOddMap + freeEvenMap) ≫ P_proj ℤ ≫ oneMinusShift ℤ := by
          simpa [Category.assoc] using
            congrArg (fun f => f ≫ oneMinusShift ℤ) P_proj_comp_pSplitMap
    _ = (freeOddMap + freeEvenMap) ≫ oneMinusShift' ℤ ≫ P_proj ℤ := by
          simpa [Category.assoc] using
            congrArg (fun f => (freeOddMap + freeEvenMap) ≫ f) P_proj_oneMinusShift
    _ = oneMinusShift' ℤ ≫ freeOddMap ≫ P_proj ℤ := by
          simpa [Category.assoc] using
            congrArg (fun f => f ≫ P_proj ℤ) freeSplitMap_comp_oneMinusShift'
    _ = oneMinusShift' ℤ ≫ P_proj ℤ ≫ pOddMap := by
          simpa [Category.assoc] using
            congrArg (fun f => oneMinusShift' ℤ ≫ f) P_proj_comp_pOddMap.symm
    _ = P_proj ℤ ≫ oneMinusShift ℤ ≫ pOddMap := by
          simpa [Category.assoc] using
            congrArg (fun f => f ≫ pOddMap) P_proj_oneMinusShift.symm

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.presheaf_freeTensor_preservesFiniteLimits
statement:
lemma presheaf_freeTensor_preservesFiniteLimits (X : LightProfinite.{0}) :
    PreservesFiniteLimits (tensorLeft (X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ : lightCondAbPresheaf))
proof:
:= by
  apply preservesFiniteLimits_of_evaluation
  intro S
  have hflat : Module.Flat ℤ ((X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ : lightCondAbPresheaf).obj S) := by
    change Module.Flat ℤ (X.toCondensed.obj.obj S →₀ ℤ)
    infer_instance
  letI := hflat
  exact preservesFiniteLimits_of_natIso
    (F := ((evaluation LightProfinite.{0}ᵒᵖ (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)).obj S ⋙
      tensorLeft ((X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ : lightCondAbPresheaf).obj S)))
    (G := (tensorLeft (X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ : lightCondAbPresheaf) ⋙
      (evaluation LightProfinite.{0}ᵒᵖ (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)).obj S))
    (by
      refine NatIso.ofComponents (fun _ => Iso.refl _) ?_
      intro _ _ f
      ext x
      rfl)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freePresheafTensorFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits
statement:
lemma freePresheafTensorFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits (X : LightProfinite.{0}) :

proof:
:= by
  let F : lightCondAbPresheaf := X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ
  haveI : PreservesFiniteLimits (tensorLeft F) := presheaf_freeTensor_preservesFiniteLimits X
  haveI : PreservesFiniteLimits
      (sheafToPresheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite.{0}) (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)) := inferInstance
  haveI : PreservesFiniteLimits
      (presheafToSheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite.{0}) (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)) := inferInstance
  dsimp [freePresheafTensorFunctor, F]
  infer_instance

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorFunctorIsoApp_hom_naturality
statement:
lemma freeTensorFunctorIsoApp_hom_naturality (X : LightProfinite.{0}) {B C : LightCondAb}
    (f : B ⟶ C) :
    (freeTensorFunctorIsoApp X B).hom ≫ (freePresheafTensorFunctor X).map f =
      (tensorLeft ((free ℤ).obj X.toCondensed)).map f ≫ (freeTensorFunctorIsoApp X C).hom
proof:
:= by
  let L := presheafToSheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)
  let F : lightCondAbPresheaf := X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ
  let cB : L.obj B.obj ⟶ B :=
    (sheafificationAdjunction (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)).counit.app B
  let cC : L.obj C.obj ⟶ C :=
    (sheafificationAdjunction (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)).counit.app C
  haveI : IsIso cB := by
    dsimp [cB, L]
    exact isIso_sheafificationAdjunction_counit B
  haveI : IsIso cC := by
    dsimp [cC, L]
    exact isIso_sheafificationAdjunction_counit C
  dsimp [freeTensorFunctorIsoApp]
  dsimp [freePresheafTensorFunctor, tensorLeft, LightCondensed.free, Sheaf.composeAndSheafify]
  change ((Iso.refl (L.obj F) ⊗ᵢ (asIso cB).symm) ≪≫ Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F B.obj).hom ≫
      L.map (F ◁ f.hom) =
    (L.obj F ◁ f) ≫
      (((Iso.refl (L.obj F) ⊗ᵢ (asIso cC).symm) ≪≫ Functor.Monoidal.μIso L F C.obj).hom)
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, tensorIso_hom, Iso.refl_hom, id_tensorHom,
    Functor.Monoidal.μIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [← Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_right L F f.hom]
  rw [← MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp_assoc]
  have hc : cB ≫ f = L.map f.hom ≫ cC := by
    dsimp [cB, cC]
    exact ((sheafificationAdjunction (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)).counit.naturality f).symm
  have hinv : inv cB ≫ L.map f.hom = f ≫ inv cC := by
    rw [← cancel_mono cC]
    simp [Category.assoc, hc]
  have hinv' : (asIso cB).symm.hom ≫ L.map f.hom = f ≫ (asIso cC).symm.hom := by
    simpa using hinv
  rw [hinv']
  rw [MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp_assoc]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.hom_precomp_oneMinusShift_tensor_bijective
statement:
lemma hom_precomp_oneMinusShift_tensor_bijective
    (X : LightCondAb) (E : Solid) :
    Function.Bijective
      (fun f : P ℤ ⊗ X ⟶ (isSolid.ι).obj E => ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X) ≫ f)
proof:
:= by
  let φ := (MonoidalClosed.pre (oneMinusShift ℤ)).app ((isSolid.ι).obj E)
  haveI : IsIso φ := E.property
  have hcompat : ∀ f : P ℤ ⊗ X ⟶ (isSolid.ι).obj E,
      MonoidalClosed.curry (((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X) ≫ f) =
        MonoidalClosed.curry f ≫ φ := by
    intro f
    dsimp [φ]
    rw [MonoidalClosed.curry_pre_app]
  constructor
  · intro f g hfg
    apply MonoidalClosed.curry_injective
    apply (cancel_mono φ).1
    rw [← hcompat f, ← hcompat g]
    exact congrArg MonoidalClosed.curry hfg
  · intro g
    let a : X ⟶ (ihom (P ℤ)).obj ((isSolid.ι).obj E) := MonoidalClosed.curry g ≫ inv φ
    refine ⟨MonoidalClosed.uncurry a, ?_⟩
    apply MonoidalClosed.curry_injective
    rw [hcompat]
    dsimp [a, φ]
    simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.ext0_precomp_oneMinusShift_tensor_bijective
statement:
lemma ext0_precomp_oneMinusShift_tensor_bijective
    (X : LightCondAb) (E : Solid) :
    Function.Bijective
      (fun α : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext (P ℤ ⊗ X) ((isSolid.ι).obj E) 0 =>
        (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X)).comp α (zero_add 0))
proof:
:= by
  have hhom := hom_precomp_oneMinusShift_tensor_bijective X E
  constructor
  · intro α β hαβ
    rcases (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_bijective (P ℤ ⊗ X) ((isSolid.ι).obj E)).2 α
      with ⟨f, rfl⟩
    rcases (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_bijective (P ℤ ⊗ X) ((isSolid.ι).obj E)).2 β
      with ⟨g, rfl⟩
    simp only [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀] at hαβ ⊢
    apply congrArg CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀
    exact hhom.1 ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_bijective _ _).1 hαβ)
  · intro α
    rcases (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_bijective (P ℤ ⊗ X) ((isSolid.ι).obj E)).2 α
      with ⟨g, rfl⟩
    rcases hhom.2 g with ⟨f, hf⟩
    refine ⟨CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f, ?_⟩
    simp only [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀]
    exact congrArg CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ hf

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.ExtOne.precomp_delta
statement:
lemma precomp_delta {A B : LightCondAb} {S : ShortComplex LightCondAb}
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (σ : A ⟶ B) (q : B ⟶ S.X₃) :
    (Ext.mk₀ σ).comp ((Ext.mk₀ q).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1)) (zero_add 1) =
      (Ext.mk₀ (σ ≫ q)).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero (Ext.mk₀ σ) (Ext.mk₀ q) hS.extClass (zero_add 1)]
  rw [Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.ExtOne.delta_zero_iff
statement:
lemma delta_zero_iff {A : LightCondAb} {S : ShortComplex LightCondAb} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (q : A ⟶ S.X₃) :
    (Ext.mk₀ q).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1) = 0 ↔
      ∃ p : A ⟶ S.X₂, p ≫ S.g = q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hq
    rcases Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃ A hS (Ext.mk₀ q) (rfl : 0 + 1 = 1) hq with ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩
    rcases (Ext.mk₀_bijective A S.X₂).2 x₂ with ⟨p, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
    simp only [Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀] at hx₂
    exact (Ext.mk₀_bijective A S.X₃).1 hx₂
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    rw [← Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀]
    rw [Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero]
    simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.ExtOne.delta_surjective_of_injective_middle
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : α.comp (Ext.mk₀ S.f) (add_zero 1) = 0 := by
    haveI : Subsingleton (Ext A S.X₂ 1) := Ext.subsingleton_of_injective A S.X₂ 0
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rcases Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁ A hS α hzero (rfl : 0 + 1 = 1) with ⟨x₃, hx₃⟩
  rcases (Ext.mk₀_bijective A S.X₃).2 x₃ with ⟨q, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨q, hx₃⟩

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.ExtOne.delta_eq_of_delta_sub_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hqc : q = c + (q - c) := by abel
  rw [hqc, Ext.mk₀_add, Ext.add_comp, h]
  simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.ExtOne.curry_delta_zero_iff
statement:
lemma curry_delta_zero_iff {X : LightCondAb} {S : ShortComplex LightCondAb}
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (q : P ℤ ⊗ X ⟶ S.X₃) :
    (Ext.mk₀ (MonoidalClosed.curry q)).comp
        (hS.map_of_exact (ihom (P ℤ))).extClass (zero_add 1) = 0 ↔
      (Ext.mk₀ q).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hG
    rcases (delta_zero_iff (A := X) (hS.map_of_exact (ihom (P ℤ))) (MonoidalClosed.curry q)).1 hG with
      ⟨pG, hpG⟩
    refine (delta_zero_iff hS q).2 ⟨MonoidalClosed.uncurry pG, ?_⟩
    apply MonoidalClosed.curry_injective
    rw [MonoidalClosed.curry_natural_right]
    rw [MonoidalClosed.curry_uncurry]
    change pG ≫ (ihom (P ℤ)).map S.g = MonoidalClosed.curry q at hpG
    exact hpG
  · intro hF
    rcases (delta_zero_iff hS q).1 hF with ⟨p, hp⟩
    refine (delta_zero_iff (A := X) (hS.map_of_exact (ihom (P ℤ))) (MonoidalClosed.curry q)).2
      ⟨MonoidalClosed.curry p, ?_⟩
    change MonoidalClosed.curry p ≫ (ihom (P ℤ)).map S.g = MonoidalClosed.curry q
    rw [← MonoidalClosed.curry_natural_right]
    rw [hp]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.ExtOne.delta_comp_ihomOneMinusShift
statement:
lemma delta_comp_ihomOneMinusShift {X : LightCondAb} {S : ShortComplex LightCondAb}
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (d : X ⟶ (S.map (ihom (P ℤ))).X₃) :
    (Ext.mk₀ (d ≫ (ihomOneMinusShiftShortComplexHom S).τ₃)).comp
        (hS.map_of_exact (ihom (P ℤ))).extClass (zero_add 1) =
      ((Ext.mk₀ d).comp (hS.map_of_exact (ihom (P ℤ))).extClass (zero_add 1)).comp
        (Ext.mk₀ (ihomOneMinusShiftShortComplexHom S).τ₁) (add_zero 1)
proof:
:= by
  let hGS := hS.map_of_exact (ihom (P ℤ))
  let φS := ihomOneMinusShiftShortComplexHom S
  have hnat := ShortComplex.ShortExact.extClass_naturality hGS hGS φS
  rw [Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero]
  rw [hnat]
  rw [← Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero (Ext.mk₀ d) (Ext.mk₀ φS.τ₃) hGS.extClass (zero_add 1)]
  rw [Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.ExtOne.delta_zero_of_curry_delta_zero
proof:
:=
  (curry_delta_zero_iff hS q).1 hG

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.ExtOne.delta_eq_iff_curry_delta_eq
statement:
lemma delta_eq_iff_curry_delta_eq {X : LightCondAb} {S : ShortComplex LightCondAb}
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (q r : P ℤ ⊗ X ⟶ S.X₃) :
    (Ext.mk₀ q).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1) =
        (Ext.mk₀ r).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1) ↔
      (Ext.mk₀ (MonoidalClosed.curry q)).comp
          (hS.map_of_exact (ihom (P ℤ))).extClass (zero_add 1) =
        (Ext.mk₀ (MonoidalClosed.curry r)).comp
          (hS.map_of_exact (ihom (P ℤ))).extClass (zero_add 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hzero : (Ext.mk₀ (q - r)).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1) = 0 := by
      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Ext.mk₀_add, Ext.mk₀_neg, Ext.add_comp, Ext.neg_comp, h]
      simp
    have hGzero := (curry_delta_zero_iff hS (q - r)).2 hzero
    have hcurry_sub : MonoidalClosed.curry (q - r) =
        MonoidalClosed.curry q - MonoidalClosed.curry r := by
      change (ihom.adjunction (P ℤ)).homEquiv X S.X₃ (q - r) =
        (ihom.adjunction (P ℤ)).homEquiv X S.X₃ q -
          (ihom.adjunction (P ℤ)).homEquiv X S.X₃ r
      exact Adjunction.homAddEquiv_sub (ihom.adjunction (P ℤ)) X S.X₃ q r
    rw [hcurry_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, Ext.mk₀_add, Ext.mk₀_neg, Ext.add_comp, Ext.neg_comp] at hGzero
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using hGzero)
  · intro h
    have hGzero : (Ext.mk₀ (MonoidalClosed.curry (q - r))).comp
          (hS.map_of_exact (ihom (P ℤ))).extClass (zero_add 1) = 0 := by
      have hcurry_sub : MonoidalClosed.curry (q - r) =
          MonoidalClosed.curry q - MonoidalClosed.curry r := by
        change (ihom.adjunction (P ℤ)).homEquiv X S.X₃ (q - r) =
          (ihom.adjunction (P ℤ)).homEquiv X S.X₃ q -
            (ihom.adjunction (P ℤ)).homEquiv X S.X₃ r
        exact Adjunction.homAddEquiv_sub (ihom.adjunction (P ℤ)) X S.X₃ q r
      rw [hcurry_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, Ext.mk₀_add, Ext.mk₀_neg, Ext.add_comp, Ext.neg_comp, h]
      simp
    have hzero := (curry_delta_zero_iff hS (q - r)).1 hGzero
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Ext.mk₀_add, Ext.mk₀_neg, Ext.add_comp, Ext.neg_comp] at hzero
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using hzero)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.ExtOne.ext1_precomp_oneMinusShift_tensor_bijective
statement:
lemma ext1_precomp_oneMinusShift_tensor_bijective
    (X : LightCondAb) (E : Solid) :
    Function.Bijective
      (fun α : Ext (P ℤ ⊗ X) ((isSolid.ι).obj E) 1 =>
        (Ext.mk₀ ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X)).comp α (zero_add 1))
proof:
:= by
  let Y : LightCondAb := (isSolid.ι).obj E
  let φY := (MonoidalClosed.pre (oneMinusShift ℤ)).app Y
  letI : IsIso φY := E.property
  let ip := (EnoughInjectives.presentation Y).some
  let S := ip.shortComplex
  have hS : S.ShortExact := ip.shortExact_shortComplex
  haveI : Injective S.X₂ := by
    dsimp [S, InjectivePresentation.shortComplex]
    exact ip.injective
  let hGS := hS.map_of_exact (ihom (P ℤ))
  haveI : Injective (S.map (ihom (P ℤ))).X₂ := by
    change Injective ((ihom (P ℤ)).obj S.X₂)
    exact Functor.PreservesInjectiveObjects.injective_obj (F := ihom (P ℤ)) (X := S.X₂) inferInstance
  let φS := ihomOneMinusShiftShortComplexHom S
  have hφY : φS.τ₁ = φY := by
    rfl
  haveI : IsIso φS.τ₁ := by
    rw [hφY]
    dsimp [φY, Y]
    exact E.property
  constructor
  · intro α β hαβ
    rcases delta_surjective_of_injective_middle hS α with ⟨q, hq⟩
    rcases delta_surjective_of_injective_middle hS β with ⟨r, hr⟩
    rw [← hq, ← hr]
    apply delta_eq_of_delta_sub_eq_zero hS
    have hαβ' :
        (Ext.mk₀ ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X)).comp
            ((Ext.mk₀ q).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1)) (zero_add 1) =
          (Ext.mk₀ ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X)).comp
            ((Ext.mk₀ r).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1)) (zero_add 1) := by
      rw [hq, hr]
      exact hαβ
    have hσeq :
        (Ext.mk₀ (((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X) ≫ q)).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1) =
          (Ext.mk₀ (((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X) ≫ r)).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1) := by
      simpa [precomp_delta hS ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X) q,
        precomp_delta hS ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X) r] using hαβ'
    have hσzero :
        (Ext.mk₀ (((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X) ≫ (q - r))).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1) = 0 := by
      rw [Preadditive.comp_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, Ext.mk₀_add, Ext.mk₀_neg,
        Ext.add_comp, Ext.neg_comp, hσeq]
      simp
    have hGσzero := (curry_delta_zero_iff hS (((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X) ≫ (q - r))).2 hσzero
    have hcurryσ : MonoidalClosed.curry (((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X) ≫ (q - r)) =
        MonoidalClosed.curry (q - r) ≫ (MonoidalClosed.pre (oneMinusShift ℤ)).app S.X₃ := by
      rw [MonoidalClosed.curry_pre_app]
    rw [hcurryσ] at hGσzero
    let dqr : X ⟶ (S.map (ihom (P ℤ))).X₃ := MonoidalClosed.curry (q - r)
    change (Ext.mk₀ (dqr ≫ φS.τ₃)).comp hGS.extClass (zero_add 1) = 0 at hGσzero
    have hδφ := delta_comp_ihomOneMinusShift hS (d := dqr)
    rw [hδφ] at hGσzero
    change ((Ext.mk₀ dqr).comp hGS.extClass (zero_add 1)).comp
      (Ext.mk₀ φS.τ₁) (add_zero 1) = 0 at hGσzero
    have hGzero : (Ext.mk₀ (MonoidalClosed.curry (q - r))).comp hGS.extClass (zero_add 1) = 0 := by
      change (Ext.mk₀ dqr).comp hGS.extClass (zero_add 1) = 0
      have htmp := congrArg (fun z => z.comp (Ext.mk₀ (inv φS.τ₁)) (add_zero 1)) hGσzero
      simpa only [Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero, Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀,
        IsIso.hom_inv_id, Ext.comp_mk₀_id, Ext.zero_comp] using htmp
    exact (curry_delta_zero_iff hS (q - r)).1 hGzero
  · intro α
    rcases delta_surjective_of_injective_middle hS α with ⟨q, hq⟩
    let δGq : Ext X (S.map (ihom (P ℤ))).X₁ 1 :=
      (Ext.mk₀ (MonoidalClosed.curry q)).comp hGS.extClass (zero_add 1)
    let γ : Ext X (S.map (ihom (P ℤ))).X₁ 1 :=
      δGq.comp (Ext.mk₀ (inv φS.τ₁)) (add_zero 1)
    rcases delta_surjective_of_injective_middle hGS γ with ⟨d, hd⟩
    let d' : X ⟶ (ihom (P ℤ)).obj S.X₃ := d
    let q' : P ℤ ⊗ X ⟶ S.X₃ := MonoidalClosed.uncurry d'
    refine ⟨(Ext.mk₀ q').comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1), ?_⟩
    change (Ext.mk₀ ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X)).comp
        ((Ext.mk₀ q').comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1)) (zero_add 1) = α
    rw [precomp_delta hS ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X) q']
    rw [← hq]
    apply (delta_eq_iff_curry_delta_eq hS (((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X) ≫ q') q).2
    have hcurryσ : MonoidalClosed.curry (((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X) ≫ q') =
        d' ≫ (MonoidalClosed.pre (oneMinusShift ℤ)).app S.X₃ := by
      dsimp [q']
      calc
        MonoidalClosed.curry (((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X) ≫ MonoidalClosed.uncurry d') =
            MonoidalClosed.curry (MonoidalClosed.uncurry d') ≫
              (MonoidalClosed.pre (oneMinusShift ℤ)).app S.X₃ :=
          (MonoidalClosed.curry_pre_app (oneMinusShift ℤ) (MonoidalClosed.uncurry d')).symm
        _ = d' ≫ (MonoidalClosed.pre (oneMinusShift ℤ)).app S.X₃ := by
          rw [MonoidalClosed.curry_uncurry]
    rw [hcurryσ]
    change (Ext.mk₀ (d ≫ φS.τ₃)).comp hGS.extClass (zero_add 1) =
      (Ext.mk₀ (MonoidalClosed.curry q)).comp hGS.extClass (zero_add 1)
    have hδφ := delta_comp_ihomOneMinusShift hS (d := d)
    rw [hδφ, hd]
    change (δGq.comp (Ext.mk₀ (inv φS.τ₁)) (add_zero 1)).comp
      (Ext.mk₀ φS.τ₁) (add_zero 1) = δGq
    simp only [Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero, Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀,
      IsIso.inv_hom_id, Ext.comp_mk₀_id]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.ext1_precomp_oneMinusShift_tensor_bijective
statement:
lemma ext1_precomp_oneMinusShift_tensor_bijective
    (X : LightCondAb) (E : Solid) :
    Function.Bijective
      (fun α : Ext (P ℤ ⊗ X) ((isSolid.ι).obj E) 1 =>
        (Ext.mk₀ ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X)).comp α (zero_add 1))
