  ExtOne.ext1_precomp_oneMinusShift_tensor_bijective X E

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pBasis_comp_oneMinusShift
statement:
lemma pBasis_comp_oneMinusShift (n : ℕ) :
    pBasis n ≫ oneMinusShift ℤ = pBasis n - pBasis (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [pBasis]
  calc
    (freeNatBasis n ≫ P_proj ℤ) ≫ oneMinusShift ℤ
        = freeNatBasis n ≫ (P_proj ℤ ≫ oneMinusShift ℤ) := by rw [Category.assoc]
    _ = freeNatBasis n ≫ (oneMinusShift' ℤ ≫ P_proj ℤ) := by rw [P_proj_oneMinusShift]
    _ = (freeNatBasis n ≫ oneMinusShift' ℤ) ≫ P_proj ℤ := by rw [Category.assoc]
    _ = (freeNatBasis n - freeNatBasis (n + 1)) ≫ P_proj ℤ := by
          rw [freeNatBasis_oneMinusShift']
    _ = freeNatBasis n ≫ P_proj ℤ - freeNatBasis (n + 1) ≫ P_proj ℤ := by
          rw [Preadditive.sub_comp]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pBasisTensorSlice_comp_oneMinusShift
statement:
lemma pBasisTensorSlice_comp_oneMinusShift (X : LightCondAb) (n : ℕ) :
    pBasisTensorSlice X n ≫ ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X) =
      pBasisTensorSlice X n - pBasisTensorSlice X (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pBasisTensorSlice, comp_whiskerRight, IntProof.sub_whiskerRight,
    Preadditive.comp_sub, Category.assoc] using
      congrArg (fun f : 𝟙_ LightCondAb ⟶ P ℤ => (λ_ X).inv ≫ f ▷ X)
        (pBasis_comp_oneMinusShift n)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pBasisTensorSlice_comp_pOddMap
statement:
lemma pBasisTensorSlice_comp_pOddMap (X : LightCondAb) (n : ℕ) :
    pBasisTensorSlice X n ≫ (pOddMap ▷ X) = pBasisTensorSlice X (2 * n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pBasisTensorSlice, comp_whiskerRight, Category.assoc] using
    congrArg (fun f : 𝟙_ LightCondAb ⟶ P ℤ => (λ_ X).inv ≫ f ▷ X)
      (pOddMap_pBasis n)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.pSplitMap_tensor_comp_oneMinusShift_tensor
statement:
lemma pSplitMap_tensor_comp_oneMinusShift_tensor (X : LightCondAb) :
    (pSplitMap ▷ X) ≫ ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X) =
      ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X) ≫ (pOddMap ▷ X)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [comp_whiskerRight] using
    congrArg (fun f => f ▷ X) pSplitMap_comp_oneMinusShift

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.ext_mk₀_sub
statement:
private lemma ext_mk₀_sub {A B : LightCondAb} (f g : A ⟶ B) :
    Ext.mk₀ (f - g) = Ext.mk₀ f - Ext.mk₀ g
proof:
:= by
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg, Ext.mk₀_add, Ext.mk₀_neg]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.ext_eq_zero_of_dyadicContractionData_of_precomp_bijective
statement:
private lemma ext_eq_zero_of_dyadicContractionData_of_precomp_bijective
    (X : LightCondAb) (E : Solid) (n : ℕ)
    (action : P ℤ ⊗ X ⟶ X)
    (firstSlice : pBasisTensorSlice X 0 ≫ action = 𝟙 X)
    (split_action : (pSplitMap ▷ X) ≫ action = action)
    (hσ : Function.Bijective
      (fun α : Ext (P ℤ ⊗ X) ((isSolid.ι).obj E) n =>
        (Ext.mk₀ ((oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X)).comp α (zero_add n)))
    (α : Ext X ((isSolid.ι).obj E) n) :
    α = 0
proof:
:= by
  let Y := (isSolid.ι).obj E
  let σ : P ℤ ⊗ X ⟶ P ℤ ⊗ X := (oneMinusShift ℤ) ▷ X
  let F' : P ℤ ⊗ X ⟶ P ℤ ⊗ X := pSplitMap ▷ X
  let G' : P ℤ ⊗ X ⟶ P ℤ ⊗ X := pOddMap ▷ X
  let ι0 : X ⟶ P ℤ ⊗ X := pBasisTensorSlice X 0
  let ι1 : X ⟶ P ℤ ⊗ X := pBasisTensorSlice X 1
  rcases hσ.2 ((Ext.mk₀ action).comp α (zero_add n)) with ⟨β, hβ⟩
  change (Ext.mk₀ σ).comp β (zero_add n) = (Ext.mk₀ action).comp α (zero_add n)
    at hβ
  have hFG : F' ≫ σ = σ ≫ G' := by
    dsimp [F', σ, G']
    exact pSplitMap_tensor_comp_oneMinusShift_tensor X
  have hσG :
      (Ext.mk₀ σ).comp ((Ext.mk₀ G').comp β (zero_add n)) (zero_add n) =
        (Ext.mk₀ σ).comp β (zero_add n) := by
    calc
      (Ext.mk₀ σ).comp ((Ext.mk₀ G').comp β (zero_add n)) (zero_add n)
          = (Ext.mk₀ (σ ≫ G')).comp β (zero_add n) := by
            rw [Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc]
      _ = (Ext.mk₀ (F' ≫ σ)).comp β (zero_add n) := by rw [← hFG]
      _ = (Ext.mk₀ F').comp ((Ext.mk₀ σ).comp β (zero_add n)) (zero_add n) := by
            rw [Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc]
      _ = (Ext.mk₀ F').comp ((Ext.mk₀ action).comp α (zero_add n)) (zero_add n) := by
            rw [hβ]
      _ = (Ext.mk₀ (F' ≫ action)).comp α (zero_add n) := by
            rw [Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc]
      _ = (Ext.mk₀ action).comp α (zero_add n) := by
            rw [split_action]
      _ = (Ext.mk₀ σ).comp β (zero_add n) := by rw [← hβ]
  have hGβ : (Ext.mk₀ G').comp β (zero_add n) = β := hσ.1 hσG
  let β0 : Ext X Y n := (Ext.mk₀ ι0).comp β (zero_add n)
  let β1 : Ext X Y n := (Ext.mk₀ ι1).comp β (zero_add n)
  have hdiff : β0 - β1 = α := by
    calc
      β0 - β1 = (Ext.mk₀ (ι0 - ι1)).comp β (zero_add n) := by
        dsimp [β0, β1]
        rw [ext_mk₀_sub]
        simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
      _ = (Ext.mk₀ (ι0 ≫ σ)).comp β (zero_add n) := by
        rw [pBasisTensorSlice_comp_oneMinusShift]
      _ = (Ext.mk₀ ι0).comp ((Ext.mk₀ σ).comp β (zero_add n)) (zero_add n) := by
        rw [Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc]
      _ = (Ext.mk₀ ι0).comp ((Ext.mk₀ action).comp α (zero_add n)) (zero_add n) := by
        rw [hβ]
      _ = (Ext.mk₀ (ι0 ≫ action)).comp α (zero_add n) := by
        rw [Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc]
      _ = (Ext.mk₀ (𝟙 X)).comp α (zero_add n) := by
        rw [firstSlice]
      _ = α := by simp
  have hβ10 : β1 = β0 := by
    calc
      β1 = (Ext.mk₀ (ι0 ≫ G')).comp β (zero_add n) := by
        dsimp [β1, ι0, ι1, G']
        rw [pBasisTensorSlice_comp_pOddMap]
      _ = (Ext.mk₀ ι0).comp ((Ext.mk₀ G').comp β (zero_add n)) (zero_add n) := by
        rw [Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc]
      _ = (Ext.mk₀ ι0).comp β (zero_add n) := by rw [hGβ]
      _ = β0 := rfl
  calc
    α = β0 - β1 := hdiff.symm
    _ = 0 := by rw [hβ10]; simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.ext0_eq_zero_of_dyadicContractible
statement:
lemma ext0_eq_zero_of_dyadicContractible
    (X : LightCondAb) [DyadicContractible X]
    (E : Solid) (α : Ext X ((isSolid.ι).obj E) 0) :
    α = 0
proof:
:=
  ext_eq_zero_of_dyadicContractionData_of_precomp_bijective X E 0
    (DyadicContractible.action (X := X))
    (DyadicContractible.firstSlice (X := X))
    (DyadicContractible.split_action (X := X))
    (ext0_precomp_oneMinusShift_tensor_bijective X E) α

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.hom_eq_zero_of_dyadicContractible

lemma hom_eq_zero_of_dyadicContractible
    (X : LightCondAb) [DyadicContractible X]
    (E : Solid) (f : X ⟶ (isSolid.ι).obj E) :
    f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : Ext.mk₀ f = 0 := ext0_eq_zero_of_dyadicContractible X E (Ext.mk₀ f)
  exact (Ext.mk₀_eq_zero_iff f).1 h

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.ext1_eq_zero_of_dyadicContractible
statement:
lemma ext1_eq_zero_of_dyadicContractible
    (X : LightCondAb) [DyadicContractible X]
    (E : Solid) (α : Ext X ((isSolid.ι).obj E) 1) :
    α = 0
proof:
:=
  ext_eq_zero_of_dyadicContractionData_of_precomp_bijective X E 1
    (DyadicContractible.action (X := X))
    (DyadicContractible.firstSlice (X := X))
    (DyadicContractible.split_action (X := X))
    (ext1_precomp_oneMinusShift_tensor_bijective X E) α

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.dyadicCoeffNinf_finite
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dyadicCoeffNinf_finite (n : ℕ) :
    dyadicCoeffNinf (n : ℕ∪{∞}) = dyadicCoeff n
proof: := rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.dyadicCoeffNinf_infty
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dyadicCoeffNinf_infty : dyadicCoeffNinf (∞ : ℕ∪{∞}) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.dyadicCoeff_nonneg
statement: lemma dyadicCoeff_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ dyadicCoeff n
proof:
:= by
  unfold dyadicCoeff
  positivity

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.dyadicCoeff_le_one
statement: lemma dyadicCoeff_le_one (n : ℕ) : dyadicCoeff n ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold dyadicCoeff
  exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.dyadicCoeffNinf_abs_le_one
statement: lemma dyadicCoeffNinf_abs_le_one (a : ℕ∪{∞}) : ‖dyadicCoeffNinf a‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  cases a using OnePoint.rec with
  | infty =>
      change ‖(0 : ℝ)‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ)
      norm_num
  | coe n =>
      change |dyadicCoeff n| ≤ (1 : ℝ)
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (dyadicCoeff_nonneg n)]
      exact dyadicCoeff_le_one n

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.dyadicCoeffNinf_odd_add_even
statement:
lemma dyadicCoeffNinf_odd_add_even (a : ℕ∪{∞}) :
    dyadicCoeffNinf (LightProfinite.oddMap a) +
        dyadicCoeffNinf (LightProfinite.evenMap a) = dyadicCoeffNinf a
proof:
:= by
  cases a using OnePoint.rec with
  | infty =>
      change (0 : ℝ) + 0 = 0
      norm_num
  | coe n =>
      change dyadicCoeff (2 * n + 1) + dyadicCoeff (2 * n + 2) = dyadicCoeff n
      exact dyadicCoeff_pair_sum n

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.dyadicScalarFunction_odd_add_even
statement:
lemma dyadicScalarFunction_odd_add_even {S : LightProfinite}
    (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) (s : S) :
    dyadicScalarFunction (f ≫ LightProfinite.oddMap) s +
        dyadicScalarFunction (f ≫ LightProfinite.evenMap) s =
      dyadicScalarFunction f s
proof:
:= by
  exact dyadicCoeffNinf_odd_add_even (f s)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorHomPresheafComposite_precomp_left_map
statement:
lemma freeTensorHomPresheafComposite_precomp_left_map
    (X Y : LightProfinite) (φ : X ⟶ Y)
    (B C : LightCondAb) (g : ((free ℤ).obj Y.toCondensed) ⊗ B ⟶ C) :
    freeTensorHomPresheafComposite X B C
        ((((free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map φ)) ▷ B) ≫ g) =
      ((Functor.whiskerRight (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map φ).hom (ModuleCat.free ℤ)) ▷
          B.obj) ≫ freeTensorHomPresheafComposite Y B C g
proof:
:= by
  let L := presheafToSheaf (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)
  let FX : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ := X.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ
  let FY : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ := Y.toCondensed.obj ⋙ ModuleCat.free ℤ
  let G : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat ℤ := B.obj
  let η : FX ⟶ FY := Functor.whiskerRight (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map φ).hom
    (ModuleCat.free ℤ)
  let cB : L.obj G ⟶ B :=
    (sheafificationAdjunction (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (ModuleCat ℤ)).counit.app B
  let g' : L.obj FY ⊗ B ⟶ C := g
  dsimp [freeTensorHomPresheafComposite]
  change toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (FX ⊗ G) ≫
      (((Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FX G).inv ≫ (L.obj FX ◁ cB) ≫
        ((L.map η ▷ B) ≫ g')).hom) =
    (η ▷ G) ≫
      (toSheafify (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (FY ⊗ G) ≫
        (((Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FY G).inv ≫ (L.obj FY ◁ cB) ≫ g').hom))
  slice_rhs 1 3 => rw [CategoryTheory.toSheafify_naturality]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  have hμinv : L.map (η ▷ G) ≫ (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FY G).inv =
      (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FX G).inv ≫ (L.map η ▷ L.obj G) := by
    apply (cancel_mono (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FY G).hom).1
    calc
      (L.map (η ▷ G) ≫ (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FY G).inv) ≫
          (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FY G).hom
          = L.map (η ▷ G) := by simp [Category.assoc]
      _ = (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FX G).inv ≫
            ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FX G).hom ≫ L.map (η ▷ G)) := by simp
      _ = (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FX G).inv ≫
            ((L.map η ▷ L.obj G) ≫ (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FY G).hom) := by
              have hμ := Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_left L η G
              change (L.map η ▷ L.obj G) ≫ (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FY G).hom =
                (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FX G).hom ≫ L.map (η ▷ G) at hμ
              rw [← hμ]
      _ = ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FX G).inv ≫ (L.map η ▷ L.obj G)) ≫
            (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FY G).hom := by simp [Category.assoc]
  have hwhisker : (L.map η ▷ L.obj G) ≫ (L.obj FY ◁ cB) =
      (L.obj FX ◁ cB) ≫ (L.map η ▷ B) := by
    rw [whisker_exchange]
  have hsheaf : L.map (η ▷ G) ≫ (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FY G).inv ≫
        (L.obj FY ◁ cB) ≫ g' =
      (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FX G).inv ≫ (L.obj FX ◁ cB) ≫
        ((L.map η ▷ B) ≫ g') := by
    calc
      L.map (η ▷ G) ≫ (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FY G).inv ≫
          (L.obj FY ◁ cB) ≫ g'
          = ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FX G).inv ≫ (L.map η ▷ L.obj G)) ≫
              (L.obj FY ◁ cB) ≫ g' := by rw [← Category.assoc, hμinv]
      _ = (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FX G).inv ≫
              ((L.map η ▷ L.obj G) ≫ (L.obj FY ◁ cB)) ≫ g' := by
            simp [Category.assoc]
      _ = (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FX G).inv ≫
              ((L.obj FX ◁ cB) ≫ (L.map η ▷ B)) ≫ g' := by rw [hwhisker]
      _ = (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FX G).inv ≫ (L.obj FX ◁ cB) ≫
              ((L.map η ▷ B) ≫ g') := by simp [Category.assoc]
  have hinside :
      CategoryTheory.sheafifyMap (coherentTopology LightProfinite) (η ▷ G) ≫
        (((Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FY G).inv ≫ (L.obj FY ◁ cB) ≫ g').hom) =
      (((Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FX G).inv ≫ (L.obj FX ◁ cB) ≫
        ((L.map η ▷ B) ≫ g')).hom) := by
    change (L.map (η ▷ G) ≫ (Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FY G).inv ≫
        (L.obj FY ◁ cB) ≫ g').hom =
      ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso L FX G).inv ≫ (L.obj FX ◁ cB) ≫
        ((L.map η ▷ B) ≫ g')).hom
    exact congrArg (fun q => q.hom) hsheaf
  rw [hinside]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorHomEval_map_left
statement:
lemma freeTensorHomEval_map_left (X Y : LightProfinite) (φ : X ⟶ Y)
    (B C : LightCondAb) (g : ((free ℤ).obj Y.toCondensed) ⊗ B ⟶ C)
    (S : LightProfinite) (f : S ⟶ X) (r : ℤ) (m : B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :
    freeTensorHomEval X B C
        ((((free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map φ)) ▷ B) ≫ g) S f r m =
      freeTensorHomEval Y B C g S (f ≫ φ) r m
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [freeTensorHomEval]
  rw [freeTensorHomPresheafComposite_precomp_left_map]
  change (freeTensorHomPresheafComposite Y B C g).app ⟨S⟩
      (((Functor.whiskerRight (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map φ).hom (ModuleCat.free ℤ) ▷
        B.obj).app ⟨S⟩) ((Finsupp.single f r) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) =
    (freeTensorHomPresheafComposite Y B C g).app ⟨S⟩
      ((Finsupp.single (f ≫ φ) r) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)
  change (freeTensorHomPresheafComposite Y B C g).app ⟨S⟩
      ((((Functor.whiskerRight (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map φ).hom (ModuleCat.free ℤ)).app
        ⟨S⟩) ⊗ₘ (𝟙 (B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩))) ((Finsupp.single f r) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) =
    (freeTensorHomPresheafComposite Y B C g).app ⟨S⟩
      ((Finsupp.single (f ≫ φ) r) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)
  change (freeTensorHomPresheafComposite Y B C g).app ⟨S⟩
      ((TensorProduct.map (Finsupp.lmapDomain ℤ ℤ
        ((lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map φ).hom.app ⟨S⟩))
        (LinearMap.id : B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩ →ₗ[ℤ] B.obj.obj ⟨S⟩))
          ((Finsupp.single f r) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) =
    (freeTensorHomPresheafComposite Y B C g).app ⟨S⟩
      ((Finsupp.single (f ≫ φ) r) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)
  rw [TensorProduct.map_tmul]
  congr 1
  rw [Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply]
  rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.freeTensorHomEval_add
statement:
lemma freeTensorHomEval_add (X : LightProfinite) (B C : LightCondAb)

    freeTensorHomEval X B C (g₁ + g₂) S f r m =
      freeTensorHomEval X B C g₁ S f r m + freeTensorHomEval X B C g₂ S f r m
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.realCondensedAbScalarEndo_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma realCondensedAbScalarEndo_one : realCondensedAbScalarEndo 1 = 𝟙 realCondensedAb
proof:
:= by
  ext S x
  change (ContinuousMap.const S.unop 1) * (show C(S.unop, ℝ) from x) =
    (show C(S.unop, ℝ) from x)
  ext s
  change (1 : ℝ) * ((show C(S.unop, ℝ) from x) s) = _
  exact one_mul _

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.realCondensedAbScalarEndo_add
statement:
lemma realCondensedAbScalarEndo_add (c d : ℝ) :
    realCondensedAbScalarEndo (c + d) = realCondensedAbScalarEndo c +
      realCondensedAbScalarEndo d
proof:
:= by
  ext S x
  change (ContinuousMap.const S.unop (c + d)) * (show C(S.unop, ℝ) from x) =
    (ContinuousMap.const S.unop c) * (show C(S.unop, ℝ) from x) +
      (ContinuousMap.const S.unop d) * (show C(S.unop, ℝ) from x)
  ext s
  change (c + d) * ((show C(S.unop, ℝ) from x) s) =
    c * ((show C(S.unop, ℝ) from x) s) + d * ((show C(S.unop, ℝ) from x) s)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.realDyadicFamilyLinear_naturality
statement:
lemma realDyadicFamilyLinear_naturality {S T : LightProfinite}
    (g : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite))
    (m : realCondensedAb.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :
    realCondensedAb.obj.map g.op (realDyadicFamilyLinear S f m) =
      realDyadicFamilyLinear T (g ≫ f) (realCondensedAb.obj.map g.op m)
proof:
:= by
  change (dyadicScalarFunction f * (show C(S, ℝ) from m)).comp g.hom.hom =
    dyadicScalarFunction (g ≫ f) * ((show C(S, ℝ) from m).comp g.hom.hom)
  ext t
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.realDyadicFamilyLinear_split
statement:
lemma realDyadicFamilyLinear_split (S : LightProfinite)
    (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite)) (m : realCondensedAb.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :
    realDyadicFamilyLinear S (f ≫ LightProfinite.oddMap) m +
        realDyadicFamilyLinear S (f ≫ LightProfinite.evenMap) m =
      realDyadicFamilyLinear S f m
proof:
:= by
  change dyadicScalarFunction (f ≫ LightProfinite.oddMap) * (show C(S, ℝ) from m) +
      dyadicScalarFunction (f ≫ LightProfinite.evenMap) * (show C(S, ℝ) from m) =
    dyadicScalarFunction f * (show C(S, ℝ) from m)
  ext s
  change dyadicScalarFunction (f ≫ LightProfinite.oddMap) s * (show C(S, ℝ) from m) s +
      dyadicScalarFunction (f ≫ LightProfinite.evenMap) s * (show C(S, ℝ) from m) s =
    dyadicScalarFunction f s * (show C(S, ℝ) from m) s
  rw [← add_mul]
  rw [dyadicScalarFunction_odd_add_even]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.realDyadicFamilyMap_natPoint
statement:
lemma realDyadicFamilyMap_natPoint (n : ℕ) :
    freeTensorFamilyMap (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) realCondensedAb realCondensedAb
      realDyadicFamilyLinear realDyadicFamilyLinear_naturality (natPoint n) =
    realCondensedAbScalarEndo (dyadicCoeff n)
proof:
:= by
  ext S x
  change realDyadicFamilyLinear S.unop (toPointMap S.unop ≫ natPoint n) x =
    (realCondensedAbScalarEndo (dyadicCoeff n)).hom.app S x
  change dyadicScalarFunction (toPointMap S.unop ≫ natPoint n) *
      (show C(S.unop, ℝ) from x) =
    (ContinuousMap.const S.unop (dyadicCoeff n)) * (show C(S.unop, ℝ) from x)
  ext s
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.realDyadicFamilyMap_infty
statement:
lemma realDyadicFamilyMap_infty :
    freeTensorFamilyMap (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite) realCondensedAb realCondensedAb
      realDyadicFamilyLinear realDyadicFamilyLinear_naturality ι = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext S x
  change realDyadicFamilyLinear S.unop (toPointMap S.unop ≫ ι) x =
    (0 : realCondensedAb ⟶ realCondensedAb).hom.app S x
  change dyadicScalarFunction (toPointMap S.unop ≫ ι) * (show C(S.unop, ℝ) from x) = 0
  ext s
  change (0 : ℝ) * (show C(S.unop, ℝ) from x) s = 0
  simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.realDyadicNumerator_slice

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.realDyadicNumerator_comp_freeSplit
statement:
lemma realDyadicNumerator_comp_freeSplit :
    ((freeOddMap + freeEvenMap) ▷ realCondensedAb) ≫ realDyadicNumerator =
      realDyadicNumerator
proof:
:= by
  apply freeTensorHom_ext
  intro S f r m
  rw [MonoidalPreadditive.add_whiskerRight, Preadditive.add_comp]
  rw [freeTensorHomEval_add]
  dsimp [freeOddMap, freeEvenMap, realDyadicNumerator]
  rw [freeTensorHomEval_map_left, freeTensorHomEval_map_left]
  rw [freeTensorHomEval_desc, freeTensorHomEval_desc, freeTensorHomEval_desc]
  rw [← zsmul_add]
  rw [realDyadicFamilyLinear_split]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.realDyadicAction_slice
statement:

      realCondensedAbScalarEndo (dyadicCoeff n)
proof:

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.realDyadicAction_split
statement:
lemma realDyadicAction_split :
    (pSplitMap ▷ realCondensedAb) ≫ realDyadicAction = realDyadicAction
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Epi (P_proj ℤ ▷ realCondensedAb) := epi_P_proj_tensor realCondensedAb
  apply (cancel_epi (P_proj ℤ ▷ realCondensedAb)).1
  calc
    (P_proj ℤ ▷ realCondensedAb) ≫ ((pSplitMap ▷ realCondensedAb) ≫ realDyadicAction)
        = ((P_proj ℤ ≫ pSplitMap) ▷ realCondensedAb) ≫ realDyadicAction := by
          rw [comp_whiskerRight]
          simp [Category.assoc]
    _ = (((freeOddMap + freeEvenMap) ≫ P_proj ℤ) ▷ realCondensedAb) ≫ realDyadicAction := by
          rw [P_proj_comp_pSplitMap]
    _ = ((freeOddMap + freeEvenMap) ▷ realCondensedAb) ≫
          (P_proj ℤ ▷ realCondensedAb) ≫ realDyadicAction := by
          rw [comp_whiskerRight]
          simp [Category.assoc]
    _ = ((freeOddMap + freeEvenMap) ▷ realCondensedAb) ≫ realDyadicNumerator := by
          dsimp [realDyadicAction]
          rw [pTensorDesc_comp_proj]
    _ = realDyadicNumerator := realDyadicNumerator_comp_freeSplit
    _ = (P_proj ℤ ▷ realCondensedAb) ≫ realDyadicAction := by
          rw [realDyadicAction, pTensorDesc_comp_proj]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.productRealSequencesScalarEndo_π
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma productRealSequencesScalarEndo_π (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    productRealSequencesScalarEndo c ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j =
      Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j ≫ realCondensedAbScalarEndo c
proof:
:= by
  change (Pi.lift (fun j : ℕ => Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j ≫
      realCondensedAbScalarEndo c)) ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j =
    Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j ≫ realCondensedAbScalarEndo c
  rw [Pi.lift_π]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.productRealSequencesScalarEndo_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma productRealSequencesScalarEndo_one :
    productRealSequencesScalarEndo 1 = 𝟙 productRealSequences
proof:
:= by
  change (Pi.lift (fun j : ℕ => Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j ≫
      realCondensedAbScalarEndo 1)) = 𝟙 (∏ᶜ fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb)
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro j
  rw [Pi.lift_π, realCondensedAbScalarEndo_one]
  simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.productRealSequencesScalarEndo_add
statement:
lemma productRealSequencesScalarEndo_add (c d : ℝ) :
    productRealSequencesScalarEndo (c + d) = productRealSequencesScalarEndo c +
      productRealSequencesScalarEndo d
proof:
:= by
  change (Pi.lift (fun j : ℕ => Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j ≫
      realCondensedAbScalarEndo (c + d))) =
    (Pi.lift (fun j : ℕ => Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j ≫
      realCondensedAbScalarEndo c)) +
    (Pi.lift (fun j : ℕ => Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j ≫
      realCondensedAbScalarEndo d))
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro j
  rw [Pi.lift_π, Preadditive.add_comp, Pi.lift_π, Pi.lift_π,
    realCondensedAbScalarEndo_add]
  simp [Preadditive.comp_add]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.productRealDyadicAction_π
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma productRealDyadicAction_π (j : ℕ) :
    productRealDyadicAction ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j =
      (P ℤ ◁ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j) ≫ realDyadicAction
proof:
:= by
  change (Pi.lift (fun j : ℕ => (P ℤ ◁ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j) ≫
      realDyadicAction)) ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j =
    (P ℤ ◁ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j) ≫ realDyadicAction
  rw [Pi.lift_π]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.productRealDyadicAction_slice
statement:
lemma productRealDyadicAction_slice (n : ℕ) :
    pBasisTensorSlice productRealSequences n ≫ productRealDyadicAction =
      productRealSequencesScalarEndo (dyadicCoeff n)
proof:
:= by
  change pBasisTensorSlice (∏ᶜ fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) n ≫
      (Pi.lift (fun j : ℕ => (P ℤ ◁ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j) ≫
        realDyadicAction)) =
    Pi.lift (fun j : ℕ => Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j ≫
      realCondensedAbScalarEndo (dyadicCoeff n))
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro j
  rw [Category.assoc, Pi.lift_π, Pi.lift_π]
  rw [← Category.assoc, pBasisTensorSlice_naturality]
  rw [Category.assoc, realDyadicAction_slice]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.productRealDyadicAction_split
statement:
lemma productRealDyadicAction_split :
    (pSplitMap ▷ productRealSequences) ≫ productRealDyadicAction = productRealDyadicAction
proof:
:= by
  change (pSplitMap ▷ (∏ᶜ fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb)) ≫
      (Pi.lift (fun j : ℕ => (P ℤ ◁ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j) ≫
        realDyadicAction)) =
    Pi.lift (fun j : ℕ => (P ℤ ◁ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j) ≫
      realDyadicAction)
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro j
  rw [Category.assoc, Pi.lift_π]
  calc
    (pSplitMap ▷ (∏ᶜ fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb)) ≫
        ((P ℤ ◁ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j) ≫ realDyadicAction)
        = ((P ℤ ◁ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j) ≫
            (pSplitMap ▷ realCondensedAb)) ≫ realDyadicAction := by
          rw [← Category.assoc]
          rw [whisker_exchange]
    _ = (P ℤ ◁ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) j) ≫ realDyadicAction := by
          rw [Category.assoc, realDyadicAction_split]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedRealSequencesScalarEndo_one

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedRealDyadicFamilyLinear_naturality
statement:
lemma boundedRealDyadicFamilyLinear_naturality {S T : LightProfinite}
    (g : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite))
    (m : boundedRealSequences.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedRealDyadicFamilyLinear_split
statement:
lemma boundedRealDyadicFamilyLinear_split (S : LightProfinite)
    (f : S ⟶ (ℕ∪{∞} : LightProfinite))
    (m : boundedRealSequences.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :
    boundedRealDyadicFamilyLinear S (f ≫ LightProfinite.oddMap) m +
        boundedRealDyadicFamilyLinear S (f ≫ LightProfinite.evenMap) m =
      boundedRealDyadicFamilyLinear S f m
proof:
:= by
  apply BoundedRealSeqSection.ext_apply
  intro n s
  change (dyadicScalarFunction (f ≫ LightProfinite.oddMap) s) *
        (show BoundedRealSeqSection S from m).val n s +
      (dyadicScalarFunction (f ≫ LightProfinite.evenMap) s) *
        (show BoundedRealSeqSection S from m).val n s =
    (dyadicScalarFunction f s) * (show BoundedRealSeqSection S from m).val n s
  rw [← add_mul]
  rw [dyadicScalarFunction_odd_add_even]

      boundedRealDyadicNumerator
proof:
:= by

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedRealDyadicAction_split
statement:
lemma boundedRealDyadicAction_split :
    (pSplitMap ▷ boundedRealSequences) ≫ boundedRealDyadicAction = boundedRealDyadicAction
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Epi (P_proj ℤ ▷ boundedRealSequences) := epi_P_proj_tensor boundedRealSequences
  apply (cancel_epi (P_proj ℤ ▷ boundedRealSequences)).1
  calc
    (P_proj ℤ ▷ boundedRealSequences) ≫
        ((pSplitMap ▷ boundedRealSequences) ≫ boundedRealDyadicAction)
        = ((P_proj ℤ ≫ pSplitMap) ▷ boundedRealSequences) ≫ boundedRealDyadicAction := by
          rw [comp_whiskerRight]
          simp [Category.assoc]
    _ = (((freeOddMap + freeEvenMap) ≫ P_proj ℤ) ▷ boundedRealSequences) ≫
          boundedRealDyadicAction := by
          rw [P_proj_comp_pSplitMap]
    _ = ((freeOddMap + freeEvenMap) ▷ boundedRealSequences) ≫
          (P_proj ℤ ▷ boundedRealSequences) ≫ boundedRealDyadicAction := by
          rw [comp_whiskerRight]
          simp [Category.assoc]
    _ = ((freeOddMap + freeEvenMap) ▷ boundedRealSequences) ≫ boundedRealDyadicNumerator := by
          dsimp [boundedRealDyadicAction]
          rw [pTensorDesc_comp_proj]
    _ = boundedRealDyadicNumerator := boundedRealDyadicNumerator_comp_freeSplit
    _ = (P_proj ℤ ▷ boundedRealSequences) ≫ boundedRealDyadicAction := by
          rw [boundedRealDyadicAction, pTensorDesc_comp_proj]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.isIso_solidification_map_of_isSolidificationEquivalence
statement:
lemma isIso_solidification_map_of_isSolidificationEquivalence
    {A B : LightCondAb} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (hf : IsSolidificationEquivalence f) :
    IsIso (solidification.map f)
proof:
:= by
  apply isIso_of_coyoneda_map_bijective
  intro E
  let eA := solidificationAdjunction.homEquiv A E
  let eB := solidificationAdjunction.homEquiv B E
  let φ : (solidification.obj B ⟶ E) ≃ (B ⟶ (isSolid.ι).obj E) := eB
  let ψ : (solidification.obj A ⟶ E) ≃ (A ⟶ (isSolid.ι).obj E) := eA
  have hcompat : ∀ g : solidification.obj B ⟶ E,
      ψ (solidification.map f ≫ g) = f ≫ φ g := by
    intro g
    exact solidificationAdjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left f g
  constructor
  · intro g h hgh
    apply φ.injective
    apply (hf E).1
    simpa only [hcompat] using congrArg ψ hgh
  · intro h
    rcases (hf E).2 (ψ h) with ⟨g, hg⟩
    refine ⟨φ.symm g, ?_⟩
    apply ψ.injective
    simpa only [hcompat, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hg

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.isSolidificationEquivalence_of_mono_cokernel_ext01
statement:
lemma isSolidificationEquivalence_of_mono_cokernel_ext01
    {A B : LightCondAb} (f : A ⟶ B) [Mono f]
    (hHom : ∀ E : Solid, ∀ q : cokernel f ⟶ (isSolid.ι).obj E, q = 0)
    (hExt : ∀ E : Solid, ∀ α : Abelian.Ext (cokernel f) ((isSolid.ι).obj E) 1,
      α = 0) :
    IsSolidificationEquivalence f
proof:
:= by
  intro E
  let Y : LightCondAb := (isSolid.ι).obj E
  constructor
  · intro g h hgh
    have hdiff : f ≫ (g - h) = 0 := by
      rw [Preadditive.comp_sub]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hgh
    have hfactor : cokernel.π f ≫ cokernel.desc f (g - h) hdiff = g - h :=
      cokernel.π_desc f (g - h) hdiff
    have hzero : cokernel.desc f (g - h) hdiff = 0 := hHom E _
    have hdiffzero : g - h = 0 := by
      rw [← hfactor, hzero, comp_zero]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hdiffzero
  · intro a
    let S := ShortComplex.mk f (cokernel.π f) (cokernel.condition f)
    have hS : S.ShortExact := ⟨ShortComplex.exact_cokernel f⟩
    have hδ : hS.extClass.comp (Ext.mk₀ a) (rfl : 1 + 0 = 1) = 0 :=
      hExt E (hS.extClass.comp (Ext.mk₀ a) (rfl : 1 + 0 = 1))
    rcases Ext.contravariant_sequence_exact₁ hS Y (Ext.mk₀ a) (rfl : 1 + 0 = 1) hδ
      with ⟨β, hβ⟩
    rcases (Ext.mk₀_bijective B Y).2 β with ⟨b, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    simp only [Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀] at hβ
    exact (Ext.mk₀_bijective A Y).1 hβ

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.descendLocallyConstantInt_spec
statement:
lemma descendLocallyConstantInt_spec {X B : LightProfinite} (π : X ⟶ B)
    [EffectiveEpi π] (c : PullbackCone π π) (hc : IsLimit c)
    (f : LocallyConstant X ℤ)
    (h : f.comap c.fst.hom.hom = f.comap c.snd.hom.hom) :
    (descendLocallyConstantInt π c hc f h).comap π.hom.hom = f
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [descendLocallyConstantInt]
  let xZ : Zdisc.obj.obj ⟨X⟩ := (zdiscSectionsEquiv X).symm f
  have hxZ : ((forget ℤ).obj Zdisc).obj.map c.fst.op xZ =
      ((forget ℤ).obj Zdisc).obj.map c.snd.op xZ := by
    change Zdisc.obj.map c.fst.op xZ = Zdisc.obj.map c.snd.op xZ
    apply (zdiscSectionsEquiv c.pt).injective
    rw [zdiscSectionsEquiv_map, zdiscSectionsEquiv_map]
    simp [xZ, h]
  let target : {x : ((forget ℤ).obj Zdisc).obj.obj ⟨X⟩ |
      ((forget ℤ).obj Zdisc).obj.map c.fst.op x =
        ((forget ℤ).obj Zdisc).obj.map c.snd.op x} := ⟨xZ, hxZ⟩
  have hbij := (LightCondensed.equalizerCondition ((forget ℤ).obj Zdisc)).bijective_mapToEqualizer_pullback' c hc
  let y := Classical.choose (hbij.2 target)
  have hy := Classical.choose_spec (hbij.2 target)
  have hy1 : ((forget ℤ).obj Zdisc).obj.map π.op y = xZ := by
    have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hy
    change (((forget ℤ).obj Zdisc).obj.map π.op y) = xZ at hval
    exact hval
  change LocallyConstant.comap π.hom.hom ((zdiscSectionsEquiv B) y) = f
  rw [← zdiscSectionsEquiv_map π y]
  change zdiscSectionsEquiv X (((forget ℤ).obj Zdisc).obj.map π.op y) = f
  rw [hy1]
  simp [xZ]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedIntSeqPresheaf_equalizerCondition_underlying
statement:
lemma boundedIntSeqPresheaf_equalizerCondition_underlying :
    regularTopology.EqualizerCondition
      (boundedIntSeqPresheaf ⋙ CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  apply regularTopology.EqualizerCondition.mk'
  intro X B π hπ c hc
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    have hmap : boundedIntSeqPresheaf.map π.op a = boundedIntSeqPresheaf.map π.op b := by
      have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hab
      change (boundedIntSeqPresheaf.map π.op a) = boundedIntSeqPresheaf.map π.op b at hval
      exact hval
    apply BoundedIntSeqSection.ext_apply
    intro n s
    haveI : Epi π := inferInstance
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective π := (LightProfinite.epi_iff_surjective π).mp inferInstance
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hsurj s
    have hcoord := congrArg (fun z : BoundedIntSeqSection X => z.val n) hmap
    have hpoint := congrArg (fun f : LocallyConstant X ℤ => f x) hcoord
    change a.val n (π x) = b.val n (π x) at hpoint
    simpa [hx] using hpoint
  · intro target
    let yX : BoundedIntSeqSection X := target.1
    have compat : boundedIntSeqPresheaf.map c.fst.op yX =
        boundedIntSeqPresheaf.map c.snd.op yX := target.2
    let yB : BoundedIntSeqSection B := {
      val := fun n =>
        descendLocallyConstantInt π c hc (yX.val n) (by
          have hcoord := congrArg (fun z : BoundedIntSeqSection c.pt => z.val n) compat
          exact hcoord)
      isBounded := by
        obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := yX.isBounded
        refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
        intro b n
        haveI : Epi π := inferInstance
        have hsurj : Function.Surjective π := (LightProfinite.epi_iff_surjective π).mp inferInstance
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hsurj b
        have hspec := descendLocallyConstantInt_spec π c hc (yX.val n) (by
          have hcoord := congrArg (fun z : BoundedIntSeqSection c.pt => z.val n) compat
          exact hcoord)
        have hpoint := congrArg (fun f : LocallyConstant X ℤ => f x) hspec
        change (descendLocallyConstantInt π c hc (yX.val n) _ (π x)) = yX.val n x at hpoint
        rw [hx] at hpoint
        rw [hpoint]
        exact hN x n }
    refine ⟨yB, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply BoundedIntSeqSection.ext
    intro n
    exact descendLocallyConstantInt_spec π c hc (yX.val n) (by
      have hcoord := congrArg (fun z : BoundedIntSeqSection c.pt => z.val n) compat
      exact hcoord)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.binaryProduct_jointly_surjective
statement:
lemma binaryProduct_jointly_surjective {S T : LightProfiniteᵒᵖ} (p : (S ⨯ T).unop) :
    (∃ s : S.unop, (prod.fst : S ⨯ T ⟶ S).unop s = p) ∨
      (∃ t : T.unop, (prod.snd : S ⨯ T ⟶ T).unop t = p)
proof:
:= by
  let hc := isColimitOfPreserves (LightProfinite.toTopCat ⋙ CategoryTheory.forget TopCat)
    (BinaryFan.IsLimit.unop (prodIsProd S T))
  obtain ⟨j, y, hy⟩ := Types.jointly_surjective_of_isColimit hc p
  rcases j with ⟨j⟩
  cases j
  · left
    exact ⟨y, hy⟩
  · right
    exact ⟨y, hy⟩

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.glueZdiscBinary_fst
proof:
:= by
  let F := ((forget ℤ).obj Zdisc).obj
  dsimp [glueZdiscBinary]
  let pair : F.obj S ⨯ F.obj T :=
    (Types.binaryProductIso (F.obj S) (F.obj T)).inv (xS, xT)
  have h := congrArg (fun f : F.obj S ⨯ F.obj T ⟶ F.obj S => f pair)
    (inv_prodComparison_map_fst (F := F) (A := S) (B := T))
  change F.map (prod.fst : S ⨯ T ⟶ S)
      (inv (prodComparison F S T)
        ((Types.binaryProductIso (F.obj S) (F.obj T)).inv (xS, xT))) = xS
  simpa [pair] using h

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.glueZdiscBinary_snd
proof:
:= by
  let F := ((forget ℤ).obj Zdisc).obj
  dsimp [glueZdiscBinary]
  let pair : F.obj S ⨯ F.obj T :=
    (Types.binaryProductIso (F.obj S) (F.obj T)).inv (xS, xT)
  have h := congrArg (fun f : F.obj S ⨯ F.obj T ⟶ F.obj T => f pair)
    (inv_prodComparison_map_snd (F := F) (A := S) (B := T))
  change F.map (prod.snd : S ⨯ T ⟶ T)
      (inv (prodComparison F S T)
        ((Types.binaryProductIso (F.obj S) (F.obj T)).inv (xS, xT))) = xT
  simpa [pair] using h

proof:
:= by

  rw [← zdiscSectionsEquiv_map]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedTailProjection_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma boundedTailProjection_zero :
    boundedTailProjection 0 = 𝟙 boundedIntSequences
proof:
:= by
  ext S x
  change boundedTailProjectionSection 0 (show BoundedIntSeqSection S.unop from x) = x
  apply BoundedIntSeqSection.ext

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedTailProjection_succ_diff_apply_coord
statement:
@[simp]
lemma boundedTailProjection_succ_diff_apply_coord (n : ℕ) (S : LightProfinite)
    (x : boundedIntSequences.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) (k : ℕ) :
    (boundedIntSequencesSectionsEquiv S
      (((boundedTailProjection n - boundedTailProjection (n + 1)).hom.app ⟨S⟩) x)).val k =
      if k = n then (boundedIntSequencesSectionsEquiv S x).val n else 0
proof:
:= by
  change ((boundedIntSequencesSectionsEquiv S ((boundedTailProjection n).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x) -
        boundedIntSequencesSectionsEquiv S ((boundedTailProjection (n + 1)).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x)).val k) =
      if k = n then (boundedIntSequencesSectionsEquiv S x).val n else 0
  rw [BoundedIntSeqSection.val_sub]
  rw [boundedTailProjection_apply_coord, boundedTailProjection_apply_coord]
  by_cases hkn : k = n
  · subst k
    ext s
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hkn]
    by_cases hnk : n ≤ k
    · have hn1k : n + 1 ≤ k := by omega
      ext s
      simp [hnk, hn1k]
    · have hn1k : ¬ n + 1 ≤ k := by omega
      ext s
      simp [hnk, hn1k]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedTailProjection_eventually_coord_zero
statement:
lemma boundedTailProjection_eventually_coord_zero (S : LightProfinite)

      (boundedIntSequencesSectionsEquiv S ((boundedTailProjection n).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x)).val k = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨k + 1, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  rw [boundedTailProjection_apply_coord]
  simp [show ¬ n ≤ k by omega]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.zdiscToReal_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zdiscToReal_apply (S : LightProfinite) (x : Zdisc.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :
    realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv S ((zdiscToReal.hom.app ⟨S⟩) x) =
      locallyConstantIntToRealLinear S (zdiscSectionsEquiv S x)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [zdiscToReal, realCondensedAb, LightCondensed.topModuleToLightCondAbMap]
  let y0 := LightCondAb.discreteIntTopModuleCondensedIso.inv.hom.app ⟨S⟩ x
  have hx : LightCondAb.discreteIntTopModuleCondensedIso.hom.hom.app ⟨S⟩ y0 = x := by
    dsimp [y0]
    change (LightCondAb.discreteIntTopModuleCondensedIso.inv ≫
      LightCondAb.discreteIntTopModuleCondensedIso.hom).hom.app ⟨S⟩ x = x
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id]
    rfl
  have hy : zdiscSectionsEquiv S x = LightCondAb.discreteIntTopModuleSectionsEquiv S y0 := by
    have h := LightCondAb.discreteIntTopModuleCondensedIso_sections S y0
    rw [← hx]
    change ((LightCondMod.LocallyConstant.functorIsoDiscrete ℤ).inv.app (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).hom.app ⟨S⟩
      (LightCondAb.discreteIntTopModuleCondensedIso.hom.hom.app ⟨S⟩ y0) =
        LightCondAb.discreteIntTopModuleSectionsEquiv S y0
    exact h
  ext s
  change (intTopModuleToReal.hom ((show C(S, ℤ) from y0) s) : ℝ) =
    (locallyConstantIntToRealLinear S (zdiscSectionsEquiv S x)) s
  rw [locallyConstantIntToRealLinear_apply, hy]
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.productIntToProductReal_π
statement:
@[simp]
lemma productIntToProductReal_π (n : ℕ) :
    productIntToProductReal ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) n =
      productIntLightIsoProductZdisc.hom ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => Zdisc) n ≫ zdiscToReal
proof:
:= by
  exact Pi.lift_π (fun n : ℕ =>
    productIntLightIsoProductZdisc.hom ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => Zdisc) n ≫ zdiscToReal) n

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.productIntToProductReal_apply_coord
statement:
@[simp]
lemma productIntToProductReal_apply_coord (S : LightProfinite)
    (x : productIntLight.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) (n : ℕ) :
    productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S ((productIntToProductReal.hom.app ⟨S⟩) x) n =
      locallyConstantIntToRealLinear S (productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S x n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv_apply]
  change realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv S
      (((productIntToProductReal ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => realCondensedAb) n).hom.app ⟨S⟩) x) =
    locallyConstantIntToRealLinear S (productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S x n)
  rw [productIntToProductReal_π n]
  change realCondensedAbSectionsEquiv S
      ((zdiscToReal.hom.app ⟨S⟩)
        (((productIntLightIsoProductZdisc.hom ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : ℕ => Zdisc) n).hom.app ⟨S⟩) x)) =
    locallyConstantIntToRealLinear S (productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S x n)
  rw [zdiscToReal_apply]
  rfl

      locallyConstantIntToRealLinear S ((boundedIntSequencesSectionsEquiv S x).val n)

    BoundedRealSeqSection.subtypeLinearEquiv]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.exists_int_abs_sub_le_half
statement:
lemma exists_int_abs_sub_le_half (x : ℝ) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, |x - (z : ℝ)| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let z : ℤ := ⌊x + (1 / 2 : ℝ)⌋
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  have hfloor_le : (z : ℝ) ≤ x + (1 / 2 : ℝ) := Int.floor_le _
  have hlt : x + (1 / 2 : ℝ) < (z : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hleft : -(1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ x - (z : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hright : x - (z : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by linarith
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨hleft, hright⟩

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.exists_locallyConstant_int_approx
statement:
lemma exists_locallyConstant_int_approx (S : LightProfinite) (f : C(S, ℝ)) :
    ∃ g : LocallyConstant S ℤ, ∀ s : S, ‖f s - (g s : ℝ)‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let R : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {p | |p.1 - p.2| < (1 / 2 : ℝ)}
  have hRopen : IsOpen R := by
    dsimp [R]
    exact isOpen_lt (by fun_prop : Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ => |p.1 - p.2|) continuous_const
  have hRdiag : R ∈ nhdsSet (Set.diagonal ℝ) := by
    rw [mem_nhdsSet_iff_forall]
    intro p hp
    rcases p with ⟨x, y⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_diagonal_iff] at hp
    subst y
    exact IsOpen.mem_nhds hRopen (by simp [R])
  obtain ⟨n, idx, hval, hidx_cont, happrox⟩ :=
    ContinuousMap.exists_finite_approximation_of_mem_nhds_diagonal f hRdiag
  let idxLC : LocallyConstant S (Fin n) :=
    ⟨idx, (IsLocallyConstant.iff_continuous idx).2 hidx_cont⟩
  let z : Fin n → ℤ := fun i => (exists_int_abs_sub_le_half (hval i)).choose
  let g : LocallyConstant S ℤ := idxLC.map z
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  intro s
  have hdist : |f s - hval (idx s)| < (1 / 2 : ℝ) := happrox s
  have hnear : |hval (idx s) - (z (idx s) : ℝ)| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    (exists_int_abs_sub_le_half (hval (idx s))).choose_spec
  change ‖f s - (z (idx s) : ℝ)‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  calc
    |f s - (z (idx s) : ℝ)| =
        |(f s - hval (idx s)) + (hval (idx s) - (z (idx s) : ℝ))| := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ |f s - hval (idx s)| + |hval (idx s) - (z (idx s) : ℝ)| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) := add_le_add hdist.le hnear
    _ = (1 : ℝ) := by norm_num

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.productRealIntApprox_apply_coord
statement:
@[simp]
lemma productRealIntApprox_apply_coord (S : LightProfinite)
    (x : productRealSequences.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) (n : ℕ) :
    productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S (productRealIntApprox S x) n =
      (exists_locallyConstant_int_approx S (productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S x n)).choose
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [productRealIntApprox]
  exact congrFun (LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply (productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S)
    (fun n => (exists_locallyConstant_int_approx S (productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S x n)).choose)) n

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.productRealBoundedCorrection_apply_coord
statement:
@[simp]
lemma productRealBoundedCorrection_apply_coord (S : LightProfinite)
    (x : productRealSequences.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) (n : ℕ) :
    (boundedRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S (productRealBoundedCorrection S x)).1 n =
      productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S x n -
        locallyConstantIntToRealLinear S
          (productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S (productRealIntApprox S x) n)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedIntToBoundedReal_comp_boundedRealToProductReal
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma boundedIntToBoundedReal_comp_boundedRealToProductReal :
    boundedIntToBoundedReal ≫ boundedRealToProductReal =
      boundedToProduct ≫ productIntToProductReal
proof:
:= by
  ext S x
  apply (productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S.unop).injective
  ext n s
  change (productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S.unop
      ((boundedRealToProductReal.hom.app S) ((boundedIntToBoundedReal.hom.app S) x)) n) s =
    (productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S.unop
      ((productIntToProductReal.hom.app S) ((boundedToProduct.hom.app S) x)) n) s
  rw [boundedRealToProductReal_apply_coord, boundedIntToBoundedReal_apply_coord,
    productIntToProductReal_apply_coord, boundedToProduct_apply_coord]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.productRealIntApprox_add_correction
statement:
lemma productRealIntApprox_add_correction (S : LightProfinite)
    (x : productRealSequences.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :
    x = (productIntToProductReal.hom.app ⟨S⟩) (productRealIntApprox S x) +
      (boundedRealToProductReal.hom.app ⟨S⟩) (productRealBoundedCorrection S x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S).injective
  ext n s
  rw [(productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S).map_add]
  change (productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S x n) s =
      (productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S
          ((productIntToProductReal.hom.app ⟨S⟩) (productRealIntApprox S x)) n) s +
        (productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S
          ((boundedRealToProductReal.hom.app ⟨S⟩) (productRealBoundedCorrection S x)) n) s
  rw [productIntToProductReal_apply_coord, boundedRealToProductReal_apply_coord,
    productRealBoundedCorrection_apply_coord]
  simp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.exists_boundedInt_of_productIntToProductReal_eq_boundedReal
statement:
lemma exists_boundedInt_of_productIntToProductReal_eq_boundedReal (S : LightProfinite)
    (y : productIntLight.obj.obj ⟨S⟩) (b : boundedRealSequences.obj.obj ⟨S⟩)
    (h : (productIntToProductReal.hom.app ⟨S⟩) y =
      (boundedRealToProductReal.hom.app ⟨S⟩) b) :
    ∃ a : boundedIntSequences.obj.obj ⟨S⟩,
      (boundedToProduct.hom.app ⟨S⟩) a = y ∧
        (boundedIntToBoundedReal.hom.app ⟨S⟩) a = b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := (boundedRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S b).2
  let aSec : BoundedIntSeqSection S := {
    val := productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S y
    isBounded := by
      refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
      intro s n
      have hcoord := congrArg (fun x => productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S x n) h
      rw [productIntToProductReal_apply_coord, boundedRealToProductReal_apply_coord] at hcoord
      have hp := congrArg (fun f : C(S, ℝ) => f s) hcoord
      have hb : ‖((productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S y n s : ℤ) : ℝ)‖ ≤ (N : ℝ) := by
        change ‖(locallyConstantIntToRealLinear S
          (productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S y n)) s‖ ≤ (N : ℝ)
        rw [hp]
        exact hN s n
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← Int.cast_abs, Int.abs_eq_natAbs] at hb
      exact_mod_cast hb }
  let a : boundedIntSequences.obj.obj ⟨S⟩ := aSec
  refine ⟨a, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S).injective
    ext n
    rw [boundedToProduct_apply_coord]
    rfl
  · apply BoundedRealSeqSection.ext_apply
    intro n s
    have hcoord := congrArg (fun x => productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S x n) h
    rw [productIntToProductReal_apply_coord, boundedRealToProductReal_apply_coord] at hcoord
    have hp := congrArg (fun f : C(S, ℝ) => f s) hcoord
    change (((aSec.val n s : ℤ) : ℝ)) = (show BoundedRealSeqSection S from b).val n s
    simpa [aSec, locallyConstantIntToRealLinear_apply] using hp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedIntPullbackLift_fac_left
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma boundedIntPullbackLift_fac_left {W : LightCondAb}
    (fst : W ⟶ productIntLight) (snd : W ⟶ boundedRealSequences)
    (h : fst ≫ productIntToProductReal = snd ≫ boundedRealToProductReal) :
    boundedIntPullbackLift fst snd h ≫ boundedToProduct = fst
proof:
:= by
  ext S w
  apply (productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S.unop).injective
  ext n s
  change (productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S.unop
      ((boundedToProduct.hom.app S) ((boundedIntPullbackLift fst snd h).hom.app S w)) n) s =
    (productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S.unop ((fst.hom.app S) w) n) s
  rw [boundedToProduct_apply_coord]
  rfl

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedIntPullbackLift_fac_right
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma boundedIntPullbackLift_fac_right {W : LightCondAb}
    (fst : W ⟶ productIntLight) (snd : W ⟶ boundedRealSequences)
    (h : fst ≫ productIntToProductReal = snd ≫ boundedRealToProductReal) :
    boundedIntPullbackLift fst snd h ≫ boundedIntToBoundedReal = snd
proof:
:= by
  ext S w
  apply BoundedRealSeqSection.ext_apply
  intro n s
  have happ := congrArg (fun e : W ⟶ productRealSequences => e.hom.app S w) h
  change (productIntToProductReal.hom.app S ((fst.hom.app S) w)) =
    (boundedRealToProductReal.hom.app S ((snd.hom.app S) w)) at happ
  have hcoord := congrArg (fun x => productRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S.unop x n) happ
  rw [productIntToProductReal_apply_coord, boundedRealToProductReal_apply_coord] at hcoord
  have hp := congrArg (fun f : C(S.unop, ℝ) => f s) hcoord
  change (((productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S.unop ((fst.hom.app S) w) n s : ℤ) : ℝ)) =
    ((boundedRealSequencesSectionsEquiv S.unop ((snd.hom.app S) w)).1 n) s
  simpa [boundedIntPullbackLift, boundedIntPullbackLiftSection,
    locallyConstantIntToRealLinear_apply] using hp

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedIntPullbackLift_unique
statement:
lemma boundedIntPullbackLift_unique {W : LightCondAb}
    (fst : W ⟶ productIntLight) (snd : W ⟶ boundedRealSequences)
    (h : fst ≫ productIntToProductReal = snd ≫ boundedRealToProductReal)
    (m : W ⟶ boundedIntSequences) (hm_left : m ≫ boundedToProduct = fst) :
    m = boundedIntPullbackLift fst snd h
proof:
:= by
  ext S w
  apply BoundedIntSeqSection.ext_apply
  intro n s
  have hcoord := congrArg (fun e : W ⟶ productIntLight => e.hom.app S w) hm_left
  change (boundedToProduct.hom.app S ((m.hom.app S) w)) = (fst.hom.app S w) at hcoord
  have hn := congrArg (fun x => productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S.unop x n) hcoord
  rw [boundedToProduct_apply_coord] at hn
  change (boundedIntSequencesSectionsEquiv S.unop ((m.hom.app S) w)).val n s =
    productIntLocallyConstantSectionsEquiv S.unop ((fst.hom.app S) w) n s
  exact congrArg (fun f : LocallyConstant S.unop ℤ => f s) hn

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.boundedInt_real_pullback
statement:
lemma boundedInt_real_pullback :
    IsPullback boundedToProduct boundedIntToBoundedReal
      productIntToProductReal boundedRealToProductReal
proof:
:= by
  refine IsPullback.mk (CommSq.mk ?_) ⟨?_⟩
  · exact boundedIntToBoundedReal_comp_boundedRealToProductReal.symm
  · refine PullbackCone.IsLimit.mk _ (fun s => boundedIntPullbackLift s.fst s.snd s.condition) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro s
      exact boundedIntPullbackLift_fac_left s.fst s.snd s.condition
    · intro s
      exact boundedIntPullbackLift_fac_right s.fst s.snd s.condition
    · intro s m hm₁ _hm₂
      exact boundedIntPullbackLift_unique s.fst s.snd s.condition m hm₁

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.productIntQuotientToRealQuotient_π
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma productIntQuotientToRealQuotient_π :
    cokernel.π boundedToProduct ≫ productIntQuotientToRealQuotient =
      productIntToProductReal ≫ cokernel.π boundedRealToProductReal
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [productIntQuotientToRealQuotient]
  rw [cokernel.π_desc]

name: LightCondensed.Solid.ProjectiveGeneratorProof.epi_productIntToProductReal_cokernelπ
statement:
lemma epi_productIntToProductReal_cokernelπ :
    Epi (productIntToProductReal ≫ cokernel.π boundedRealToProductReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LightCondMod.epi_iff_locallySurjective_on_lightProfinite]
  intro S q
  have hπepi : Epi (cokernel.π boundedRealToProductReal) := inferInstance
  have hloc := (LightCondMod.epi_iff_locallySurjective_on_lightProfinite ℤ
    (cokernel.π boundedRealToProductReal)).mp hπepi
  obtain ⟨S', φ, hφ, x, hx⟩ := hloc S q
  refine ⟨S', φ, hφ, productRealIntApprox S' x, ?_⟩
  have hdecomp := productRealIntApprox_add_correction S' x
  calc
    ((productIntToProductReal ≫ cokernel.π boundedRealToProductReal).hom.app ⟨S'⟩)
        (productRealIntApprox S' x)
        = (cokernel.π boundedRealToProductReal).hom.app ⟨S'⟩
          ((productIntToProductReal.hom.app ⟨S'⟩) (productRealIntApprox S' x)) := rfl
    _ = (cokernel.π boundedRealToProductReal).hom.app ⟨S'⟩ x := by
      conv_rhs => rw [hdecomp]
      rw [map_add]
      have hzero : (cokernel.π boundedRealToProductReal).hom.app ⟨S'⟩
          ((boundedRealToProductReal.hom.app ⟨S'⟩) (productRealBoundedCorrection S' x)) = 0 := by
        change ((boundedRealToProductReal ≫ cokernel.π boundedRealToProductReal).hom.app ⟨S'⟩)
          (productRealBoundedCorrection S' x) = 0
        rw [cokernel.condition]
        rfl
      simp [hzero]
    _ = (cokernel boundedRealToProductReal).obj.map φ.op q := hx

name: LightCondAb.topologicalFreeMap_single
statement:
@[simp]
lemma topologicalFreeMap_single {S T : LightProfinite.{0}} (f : S ⟶ T) (s : S) :
    (topologicalFreeMap f).hom (Finsupp.single s (1 : ℤ)) = Finsupp.single (f s) (1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  change (Finsupp.mapDomain (LightProfinite.toTopCat.map f).hom (Finsupp.single s (1 : ℤ))) =
    Finsupp.single (f s) (1 : ℤ)
  exact Finsupp.mapDomain_single

name: LightCondAb.topologicalFreeDiracSection_yoneda_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma topologicalFreeDiracSection_yoneda_apply (s : S) :
    ((show C(↑S.toTop, ↑(topologicalFree S).toModuleCat) from
      (coherentTopology LightProfinite).yonedaEquiv (topologicalFreeDiracSection S)) s) =
      Finsupp.single s (1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrothendieckTopology.yonedaEquiv_apply]
  dsimp [topologicalFreeDiracSection, topologicalFreeDirac]
  change (show C(↑S.toTop, ↑(topologicalFree S).toModuleCat) from
    (LightCondensed.topModuleToLightCondAbForgetIso (topologicalFree S)).inv.hom.app ⟨S⟩
      ((topCatToLightCondSet.map ((TopModuleCat.freeAdj ℤ).unit.app S.toTop)).hom.app ⟨S⟩
        ((lightProfiniteToLightCondSetIsoTopCatToLightCondSet.hom.app S).hom.app ⟨S⟩ (𝟙 S)))) s =
      Finsupp.single s (1 : ℤ)
  rw [LightCondensed.topModuleToLightCondAbForgetIso_inv_app]
  rfl

name: LightCondAb.topologicalFreeDiracSection_naturality
statement:
lemma topologicalFreeDiracSection_naturality {S T : LightProfinite.{0}} (f : S ⟶ T) :
    lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map f ≫ topologicalFreeDiracSection T =
      topologicalFreeDiracSection S ≫ (forget ℤ).map (topologicalFreeCondensedMap f)
proof:
:= by
  ext U g
  letI : TopologicalSpace ((topologicalFree T).toModuleCat : Type) := (topologicalFree T).topologicalSpace
  change (show C(↑U.unop.toTop, ↑(topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
      (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map f ≫ topologicalFreeDiracSection T).hom.app U g) =
    (show C(↑U.unop.toTop, ↑(topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
      (topologicalFreeDiracSection S ≫ (forget ℤ).map (topologicalFreeCondensedMap f)).hom.app U g)
  let g' : C(↑U.unop.toTop, ↑S.toTop) :=
    (lightProfiniteToLightCondSetIsoTopCatToLightCondSet.hom.app S).hom.app U g
  ext u
  dsimp [topologicalFreeDiracSection, topologicalFreeCondensedMap]
  change Finsupp.single (f (g' u)) (1 : ℤ) =
    (topologicalFreeMap f).hom (Finsupp.single (g' u) (1 : ℤ))
  exact (topologicalFreeMap_single f (g' u)).symm

name: LightCondAb.topologicalFreeCondensedMap_diracSection_apply
statement:
lemma topologicalFreeCondensedMap_diracSection_apply {S T : LightProfinite.{0}} (f : S ⟶ T) :
    (topologicalFreeCondensed T).obj.map f.op
        ((coherentTopology LightProfinite).yonedaEquiv (topologicalFreeDiracSection T)) =
      (topologicalFreeCondensedMap f).hom.app ⟨S⟩
        ((coherentTopology LightProfinite).yonedaEquiv (topologicalFreeDiracSection S))
proof:
:= by
  letI : TopologicalSpace ((topologicalFree T).toModuleCat : Type) := (topologicalFree T).topologicalSpace
  change (show C(↑S.toTop, ↑(topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
      (topologicalFreeCondensed T).obj.map f.op
        ((coherentTopology LightProfinite).yonedaEquiv (topologicalFreeDiracSection T))) =
    (show C(↑S.toTop, ↑(topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
      (topologicalFreeCondensedMap f).hom.app ⟨S⟩
        ((coherentTopology LightProfinite).yonedaEquiv (topologicalFreeDiracSection S)))
  ext s
  dsimp [topologicalFreeCondensedMap]
  change ((show C(↑T.toTop, ↑(topologicalFree T).toModuleCat) from
      (coherentTopology LightProfinite).yonedaEquiv (topologicalFreeDiracSection T)) (f s)) =
    (topologicalFreeMap f).hom
      ((show C(↑S.toTop, ↑(topologicalFree S).toModuleCat) from
        (coherentTopology LightProfinite).yonedaEquiv (topologicalFreeDiracSection S)) s)
  rw [topologicalFreeDiracSection_yoneda_apply]
  rw [topologicalFreeDiracSection_yoneda_apply]
  exact (topologicalFreeMap_single f s).symm

name: LightCondAb.discreteIntTopModuleCondensedIso_sections
statement:
lemma discreteIntTopModuleCondensedIso_sections (T : LightProfinite.{0})
    (x : (LightCondensed.topModuleToLightCondAbObj discreteIntTopModule).obj.obj ⟨T⟩) :
    ((LightCondMod.LocallyConstant.functorIsoDiscrete ℤ).inv.app (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).hom.app ⟨T⟩
      (discreteIntTopModuleCondensedIso.hom.hom.app ⟨T⟩ x) =
    discreteIntTopModuleSectionsEquiv T x
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [discreteIntTopModuleSectionsEquiv, discreteIntTopModuleCondensedIso,
    discreteIntTopModuleLocallyConstantIso]
  let e := (LightCondMod.LocallyConstant.functorIsoDiscrete ℤ).app (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)
  change (e.hom ≫ e.inv).hom.app ⟨T⟩
      ((discreteIntTopModulePresheafIso.hom.app ⟨T⟩) x) =
    (discreteIntTopModulePresheafIso.hom.app ⟨T⟩) x
  rw [Iso.hom_inv_id]
